bluejetty:00065583:ios.description:
■ Latest Awards
• Healthline.com: Best Allergy Apps of the Year 2020
• Focus Money 2019: "Best App" in the health category
• MeinAllergiePortal – Digital Health Heroes Award 2018 & 2021
The app Food Intolerances helps you if you have to stick to a restricted diet after being diagnosed with food intolerances, sensitivities or allergies. It offers you an extensive food list with more than 1,300 foods, tables with comprehensive data and detailed comments for assessing the tolerance.
The most important applications are histamine intolerance, mastocytosis, a low FODMAP diet for IBS, fructose malabsorption, sorbitol intolerance, lactose intolerance, salicylate intolerance or gluten sensitivity.
Our app has been reviewed by the medical jury of MeinAllergiePortal and was awarded the Digital Health Heroes Award twice.
■ The best app for your needs
• Configure the app to fit your specific needs
• Check your favorite meals with the recipe calculator
• Track your diet with the food diary and export detailed analyses as PDF
• Add your own notes and manually adjust ratings where necessary
• Add foods to your list of favorites
• Filter and sort by various criteria
■ Low FODMAP diet and IBS
• Fructose intolerance
• Lactose intolerance
• Sorbitol and other sugar alcohols
• Oligosaccharides (e.g. fructans and galactans)
• Total FODMAP content
■ Histamine and tyramine intolerance
• Content of histamine, tyramine and other biogenic amines
• Histamine liberators and DAO inhibitors
• Problematic medicines and food additives
■ More intolerances and allergies
• Salicylate or Aspirin intolerance
• Benzoic acid and benzoates
• Balsam of Peru allergy
• Nickel allergy and nickel content
• Oxalic acid and oxalates
• Additional profiles for gluten, wheat, corn, soy, yeast, sulfites, dairy, egg, fish, meat, pork, beef, honey, treenuts and nightshades
► Free version
• Basic information for 8 out of 15 intolerances
• Access to our food database with more than 1,300 entries
• Detailed articles about food intolerances
• Search function with barcode scanner
• Shopping list
• Creation of five recipes
• Creation of five entries in the food diary
• Personal notes, ratings and favorites
• Free blog with interesting articles*
• Direct link to Wikipedia articles
• Dark Mode
• No internet connection required
► PRO version (in-app purchase)
• Access to all information and data
• Filter and sorting function
• Recipe nutrition calculator
• Unlimited number of entries in the food diary
• Access to all 15 sensitivities and additional 14 allergens
• Adjustable portion sizes
• Assessment of the total sugar content
• One time purchase, no subscription
► Nutritional values (in-app purchase)
With an additional in-app users of the PRO version can unlock 46 nutritional values.
• General nutrition facts
• Vitamins A, B1, B2, B3, B5, B6, B9 (folic acid), B12, C, D, E and K
• Minerals and micronutrients (e.g. iron, zinc, calcium, magnesium, ...)
• Recommended daily intake
• Omega-6/Omega-3 ratio, glycemic index and glycemic load
• Alcohol content
• Calculation and tracking of nutritional values
■ About us
At Baliza, we have been developing nutritional apps that provide tailored nutritional recommendations to people with special dietary needs since 2011. Our award-winning apps are helpful guides that combine carefully researched information from scientific sources with all the capabilities offered by modern smartphones. You get all of our apps as a fair one-time purchase without a subscription.
* https://www.baliza.de/en/blog/index.html

bluejetty:00065260:ios.description:
Meet the refreshed RCBC Pulz, your digital banking app for everyday banking. Enjoy a new, more personal experience for sending money online, managing your cards, growing your savings, and more.
BECOME A HEXAGON CLUB MEMBER ONLINE
Enjoy the privileges that come with being a Hexagon Club member. Join in-app to unlock exclusive rewards, lifestyle perks, and personalized support tailored to your banking needs.
RECEIVE US DOLLARS AND CONVERT ON DEMAND
Have more flexibility with your US funds through your US Virtual Account. Receive US dollars and convert them to Philippine pesos whenever it suits you, giving you greater control over your money.
SEND MONEY ONLINE FOR FREE
Enjoy unlimited free transfers to local banks through InstaPay, PESONet, and QRPh, and conveniently send money online for everyday payments or move funds between accounts.
DEPOSIT CHECKS FROM YOUR PHONE
No need to make a trip to the branch just to deposit a check. With mobile check deposit, you can submit checks through the app and take care of it wherever you are.

LET YOUR SAVINGS DO MORE
Give your money more room to grow with an online Time Deposit. Open your account digitally, keep track of your deposits, and make the most of your savings as you work toward your financial goals.
GET SUPPORT THAT KNOWS YOU
When you need assistance, connect with your dedicated Hexagon Club support team for personalized help from people who understand your banking relationship.
MORE WAYS TO BANK WITH PULZ
Go beyond the essentials with more digital banking services designed around your everyday needs. Send or request payments, pay bills, buy load, deposit or withdraw cash, and manage your loans and investments through Pulz. bluejetty:00024250:ios.description:
Struggling to explain the plan for the day to your kids?
Are you dealing with constant questions like “When is lunch?” or “When can I play?”
Finding it hard to keep daily tasks on track?
Visual Schedule helps parents and kids plan the day using pictures, icons, and timers — making routines easy to understand and follow.
THIS APP WILL HELP YOU:
● Plan the day for children and adults who struggle with focus
● Keep kids on track with clear visual routines
● Explain the daily schedule without long explanations
● Motivate kids to complete tasks — even the less enjoyable ones
● Manage routines for the whole family — each child gets their own profile
FEATURES:
● Create daily schedules and tasks
● Choose from over 130 icons to visually represent activities
● Add your own task photos from the photo library
● Use images from Pixabay to personalize tasks
● Create task icons using Apple Image Playground (available on select devices with Apple Intelligence)
● Mark tasks as completed to show progress
● Full-screen task timer for better focus
● Alerts and reminders for scheduled activities
● Create a separate profile for each child
● Start in minutes with ready-made templates: Morning, Bedtime, Chores, and more
● Motivate kids with achievements for completed tasks
— — —
How can I visually explain the daily plan to my kids?
The day is displayed as a visual schedule using icons, photos, and timers, helping kids clearly see what comes next.
Is this helpful for kids who struggle with focus or routines?
Yes. Predictable visual tasks and clear structure help reduce confusion and improve focus throughout the day.
Does it use pictures and icons instead of long text?
Yes. Tasks can be represented using icons, custom photos, or images from Pixabay, minimizing the need for reading.
How does marking tasks as done motivate kids to finish them?
Seeing tasks marked as completed gives children a sense of progress and achievement, encouraging them to continue.
Is this suitable for families dealing with attention challenges or ADHD?
Yes. Visual cues, timers, and reminders are designed to support attention, structure, and daily motivation.
Is Visual Schedule free?
The app is free to download and use, with optional premium features available through in-app purchases.
— — —
If you enjoy the app, please leave a review on the App Store. Your feedback really helps.
Questions or suggestions? We’d love to hear from you.
Support Email: AppsForParents@gmail.com
Terms of Use:
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy:

bluejetty:00121519:ios.description:
Fight to become the biggest crab on the island.
Intense multiplayer fun, battle with up to 100 real players per game!
Scrap, scavenge and slaughter your way to becoming the King of Crabs!
Collect weird and wonderful crab species, upgrade and customise them to help you climb the ranks. Team Up with friends to help or fight each other - it's up to you!

Incredibly detailed 3D graphics, animation and sound make the experience come alive.
BECOME THE KING
Climb to the top of the leader-board to prove you’re the mightiest crab in the land!
CRAB ‘EM ALL
Collect, upgrade and grow a variety of Crabs. Discover advanced skills and collect unique skins.
WEAPONS GALORE
Find an array of crazy and deadly weaponry to help skew the odds in your favour. 
MULTIPLE GAME MODES
Test your worth in the intense PvP game mode, or try PvE for a more friendly time!
REGULAR UPDATES
Look out for new Crabs, skins, maps, special events and games modes in the future.
* Game requires a persistent internet connection. 
Please note: King of Crabs is free to download and play, however, certain items are available to be purchased for real money. 
If you have any questions or concerns, please contact us at: support@robotsquid.com

bluejetty:00078009:ios.summary: Embark on an adventure in Stranded Island: Survival Games, where you're stranded on an archipelago. As a castaway, survival hinges on exploration, resource management, and thrilling rescue missions. As the ultimate castaway, explore lush la
bluejetty:00078009:ios.description:
Embark on an adventure in Stranded Island: Survival Games, where you're stranded on an archipelago. As a castaway, survival hinges on exploration, resource management, and thrilling rescue missions. As the ultimate castaway, explore lush landscapes, aid survivors, and build a vibrant community. Delve deep into the forest island's mysteries and master the art of rescue. Craft a seaworthy boat to explore the archipelago and save fellow castaways. As an island castaway stranded deep on a wild island, your fate rests in your hands.
Island Survival:
Navigate through the untamed beauty of the archipelago, discovering hidden resources crucial for your survival. Adapt to the environment and master the art of crafting tools, shelters, and weapons to brave the dangers of the castaway island.
Castaway Rescue:
Rescue survivors scattered across the stranded island. Collaborate with your castaway team and put your efforts together to build a boat, explore the islands of the archipelago, gather resources and rebuild your village! 
Stranded Island Challenges:
Face unique challenges specific to each island in the archipelago - gather crafting resources, get fruits to cook for your castaway team, mine in the depths of a cave, and cut through wild vegetation!
Rebuild your village:
Help your fellow castaways by rebuilding their homes - build, upgrade and decorate your stranded island village and bring it to its full glory!
If you're looking for island survival games then Stranded Island: Survival Games is the one for you! Test your survival skills, rescue your castaway team, explore the castaway island and experience the thrill of island life! Can you turn your castaway story into an epic tale of survival and rescue? Find out in this captivating survival adventure!

bluejetty:00033670:ios.summary:
［Key Features of LUMIX Lab］
■ LUT (*1) Functions for Creating the Look You Want
• Create and Save LUTs
In addition to basic brightness and contrast adjustments, LUMIX Lab supports tone curves, HSL adjustments (individual control of hue, sat
bluejetty:00033670:ios.description:
［Key Features of LUMIX Lab］
■ LUT (*1) Functions for Creating the Look You Want
• Create and Save LUTs
In addition to basic brightness and contrast adjustments, LUMIX Lab supports tone curves, HSL adjustments (individual control of hue, saturation, and luminance), color adjustments for highlights and shadows, and a wide range of advanced editing options.
Your edits can be saved as LUTs, and you can also add effects such as grain and sharpness.
• Magic LUT (*2)
Select a photo with your preferred color style from your smartphone’s camera roll.
Based on the selected reference photo, AI generates a LUT, making it easy to achieve the look you want.
• Creator LUTs
Download from around 200 LUTs created by over 40 well-known creators from around the world.
These LUTs can be used for editing and with the real-time LUT function.
• Real-Time LUT
Transfer LUTs to your camera and shoot photos and videos with the selected LUT applied and saved directly.
*1 A LUT (Look Up Table) is a color filter that transforms the color values of photos and videos.
*2 *Please use images that do not violate license terms, applicable laws and regulations, or legal rights such as copyright and portrait rights.
 To use Magic LUT, please ensure that your device is supported and verified.
■ Editing Features That Expand Your Creative Expression
• RAW Editing
Edit and export RAW files shot with supported LUMIX cameras at no cost.
• S&Q (Slow & Quick) Video Creation
Easily create slow-motion effects up to 5x speed or quick-motion (time-lapse-style) effects up to 10x speed.
• Photo Frames
Add original frames to your photos and customize colors, size, Exif information, and text.
■ Camera Connectivity and Integration
• Photo / Video Transfer
Transfer photos and videos shot with LUMIX cameras to your smartphone.
In addition to wireless connections via Bluetooth® and Wi-Fi, wired transfer using a USB cable is also supported.
• Remote Shooting
Control the camera remotely via Wi-Fi. 
Use your smartphone screen to see your camera live view and capture photos.
• Firmware Update(*3)
Update your camera’s firmware directly through the app without a PC.
You will also receive update notifications within the app.
*3 Requires the latest firmware as of May 2026.
［Compatible Cameras］
DC-S1M2, DC-S1M2NT, DC-S1M2ES , DC-S1RM2, DC-S5M2, DC-S5M2X, DC-S9,
DC-GH7, DC-G9M2, DC-L10
［Supported OS］
iOS17 - 26
［Notes］
• Some features may not be available depending on the camera model.
For details on how to use the app and supported models, please visit the support page below:
https://panasonic.jp/support/global/cs/soft/lumix_lab/en/index.html
• When using location data recording, continuous use of GPS may significantly reduce battery life.

bluejetty:00121432:ios.description:
Make the hottest beats in hip-hop. Make them on your mobile.
Create and drop the freshest hip-hop beats with Hip-Hop Beat Maker. Hip-Hop Beat Maker is the ultimate tool for hip-hop beat creation with accessible design, an extensive collection of sound packs (with more added all the time!) and a rich selection of studio features. It's the only app you’ll need to create the hottest hip-hop beats, wherever you are. 
Hip-Hop Beat Maker looks and sounds perfect as it executes all of its features to a professional standard. Here's the full rundown of what's under the hood: 
- Free Hip-Hop sound packs with regular updates;
- High-quality samples (uncompressed 16-bit, 44.1 KHz);
- 32 sound pads in two banks;
- Predefined beat loops in every sound preset;
- Create loops to use in future beats;
- Up to 4 custom loops on iPhone and up to 5 on iPad;
- BPM control;
- Music session recording and sharing.
Whether you’re a beginner or an expert Hip-Hop Beat Maker is the beat making app for you. You’ll start by choosing a sound pack, and from here you’ll drop into the slickest mobile drum pad you can find. We’ve worked with top producers and DJs to ensure that this is the most accurate virtual drum pad in both looks and features. Real-time audio configuration ensures that everything is customisable on the fly. If you’re into making beats live, or performing your latest killer tracks, you’re going to want to make changes while you’re playing, and Hip-Hop Beat Maker is going to let you.
Hip-Hop Beat Maker has the sound packs every hip-hop head needs - if it's hip-hop, it’s in Hip-Hop Beat Maker!
Come up with an awesome beat? You can save it to your library and come back to it at any time. You can also take any beat you’ve created and remix it, or use it to make some fresh loops to use in future tracks. If you can think it, you can do it!
Once you’ve crafted your masterpiece, it’s time to share it. Hip-Hop Beat Maker has all the sharing capabilities you need to get your music to the ears you want to reach and beyond! 
Use pads, create loops, remix and record with ease! Hip-Hop Beat Maker is the beat making app hip-hop heads have been waiting for.

bluejetty:00186499:ios.name: ABC Happy Shark Games for Kids
bluejetty:00186499:ios.summary: ***** Developed by an award-winning education studios, 22learn, the creator of the best-selling apps for kids, in cooperation with educational specialists to best prepare your children for success in preschool and kindergarten curriculum.
bluejetty:00186499:ios.description:
***** Developed by an award-winning education studios, 22learn, the creator of the best-selling apps for kids, in cooperation with educational specialists to best prepare your children for success in preschool and kindergarten curriculum. 
Dive into the depths of the ocean to discover letters and alphabet. With its 7 fun games, Letters and Alphabet Adventure is the best way to teach children letter recognition, association of words with their beginning letter, and alphabetical order. 
The application features a bright, colorful, child-friendly interface that is appealing to children yet does not distract from learning. Learn with jellyfish and cute sharks, jump on the alphabet when the alphabet song is playing and more!
To develop your child’s skills, we included the following seven games that cater to different skill levels and stages of learning:
* Letter Flash Cards
Choose from four different types of flash cards based on what you want to learn. For example, select flash cards that feature uppercase letters on one side and lowercase letters on the other and learn the lowercase form of uppercase letters. Flash cards are ideal especially in the early stages of learning when children are becoming acquainted with the letters but can also be well used once children already mastered the material and self-test their knowledge.
* Alphabet Song
Sing along! A, B, C, D… Listen to the song and learn the alphabet as the letters in the song are highlighted; play with the letters once the song ends.
* Jumbled Alphabet
Practice the alphabetical order with Jumbled Alphabet. Based on your child’s skills, choose an easy, medium, or challenge level. Fill in the gaps in the alphabet by dragging letters to their correct place.
* Letter Quiz
Learn to recognize letters. Tap on the letters called!
* Matching: A—Apple
Learn beginning letters of words. Drag the letter next to the picture that depicts a word that begins with that letter.

bluejetty:00043272:ios.description:
CoinMeta - The World's Trusted Authority on Web3 Data and Video Aggregator
As a trusted authority on web3 data and video aggregation, CoinMeta provides web3 enthusiasts, individual investors, and institutional users with a one-stop, cutting-edge web3 information service covering the entire cryptocurrency ecosystem. Here, you can instantly access core data such as global cryptocurrency market capitalization rankings, real-time quotes, trading volumes, currency conversions, RWA, and prediction market data. Track your assets and make detailed comparisons through a dedicated investment portfolio. Enjoy a wealth of video, news, and breaking news content, and achieve real-time communication through IM chat groups. Build a first-hand web3 resource sharing and SocialFi community with CoinMeta, an essential and authoritative tool for navigating the web3 ecosystem.
In CoinMeta you will get:
I. Core Contract Indicators + Full Currency Coverage
Focusing on core indicators for BTC, ETH, and BNB contracts, providing long/short ratios, open interest, price alerts, and tracking of new on-chain projects. Supports tracking 30,000+ cryptocurrencies, equipped with tools such as market capitalization ranking, accurate price alerts, candlestick charts, portfolio trackers, and multi-dimensional converters. Customize price and abnormal transaction alerts; data is real-time and accurate.
II. Global Crypto Market Panorama Tracking, Core Data at Your Fingertips
What CoinMeta can do: In-depth project and contract insights. One-stop access to project descriptions, OHLCV charts, official updates, and precise queries for key data such as BTC liquidations, open interest, Grayscale Trust, large investor long/short ratios, and funding rates, helping to assess project potential and market trends.
We provide a comprehensive ranking and details of top global exchanges, tracking over 38,000 active markets across major exchanges including Binance, OKX, HTX, Bitget, MEXC, Gateio, Bybit, BitMart, LBank, and Coinbase. It displays exchange rankings, trading volume trends, trading pairs, fees, and real-time liquidation and large-scale transaction clearing maps for a clear understanding of market anomalies.
III. Intelligent Portfolio Management 
We support real-time valuation of over 30,000 crypto assets, including BTC, ETH, XRP, LTC, BSV, USDT, BNB, ADA, DOGE, ETC, and ZEC. Users can select from over 90 fiat currencies (such as USD, EUR, JPY, KRW, CNY, etc.), various cryptocurrencies (such as BTC, ETH, XRP, LTC, etc.), and precious metals such as gold and palladium as pricing units, clearly viewing asset status. We also provide a convenient interface for adding and subtracting holdings, support creating a watchlist of custom cryptocurrencies, and offer efficient and worry-free management.
IV. Multifunctional and Practical Tools
Cryptocurrency Comparison: Supports comparison of prices, market capitalization, trading volume, and historical performance data for different cryptocurrencies across timeframes (15 minutes, 1 hour, 4 hours, 1 week, 1 month, 3 months). Intuitively track differences and quickly filter high-quality assets.
Unlimited AI Tools for Market Prediction: Innovative built-in blockchain AI tools support unlimited interactive experiences. Quickly query in-depth cryptocurrency data, analyze market trends, generate investment reference reports, interpret industry policies.
V. Social Ecosystem and Value Monetization
Web3-exclusive SocialFi community IM group chat function allows you to build social communities, join themed groups to exchange market information, share resources, and expand your industry network.
Read to Earn: Earn rewards while reading and browsing news and watching content, achieving a win-win situation of information acquisition and value monetization.
Download and register on CoinMeta now to start your web3 ecosystem exploration journey!

bluejetty:00175292:ios.name: Opera Browser with VPN
bluejetty:00175292:ios.summary:
Fast, safe and private, Opera is a beautifully-designed web browser with a Red Dot Award-winning interface. Loved by millions worldwide, Opera is built for people on the go, delivering lightning-fast browsing with powerful privacy tools.
T
bluejetty:00175292:ios.description:
Fast, safe and private, Opera is a beautifully-designed web browser with a Red Dot Award-winning interface. Loved by millions worldwide, Opera is built for people on the go, delivering lightning-fast browsing with powerful privacy tools.
The All-New Opera One for iOS
Experience a browser that moves with you, with a sleek bottom search bar for effortless thumb-driven browsing. Enjoy a more immersive full-screen experience and fluid navigation with intuitive, smooth-swipe gestures.
Ad-Free Browsing with an Enhanced Native Ad Blocker
Say goodbye to distractions and hello to faster page loading. Opera’s built-in Ad Blocker removes intrusive ads and pop-ups automatically, helping pages load faster and making browsing smoother and cleaner.
Built-in VPN
Enjoy enhanced privacy. Opera’s built-in VPN encrypts your browsing traffic and masks your location with a strict no-logs policy. No subscriptions, logins, or extra extensions required. Just turn it on with a single tap to shield your personal data on any network.
Sync
Stop leaving your tabs behind. Whether you’re stepping out for coffee or switching to the couch, Opera makes life easy. Sync your mobile and desktop browsers to access your open tabs, bookmarks, and speed dials instantly. Pick up exactly where you left off, no searching, no re-typing, just seamless browsing.
Meet Opera AI
Discover a smarter way to explore the web with Opera AI, seamlessly integrated into your browsing experience. You can now search with AI directly from the address bar, making it easier than ever to ask questions, explore topics, and find information instantly while browsing.
Your Browser, Your Design
Customize your browser with beautiful wallpapers or upload your own images to match your style. Whether you prefer minimal, colorful, or personal designs, Opera lets you shape your browsing environment exactly the way you like it.
Designed for One-Hand Browsing
Choose between sleek Bottom Navigation or the Fast Action Button (FAB) for total control of your browsing experience. Swipe gestures make it easy to switch tabs, reload pages, share links, or return to recent tabs. All with one hand.
ABOUT OPERA
Founded in 1995 in Norway on the idea that everyone should have fast access to the web, we have spent the last 30+ years helping millions browse in a safe, private, and innovative way. We care about the internet, about open standards, and about people. 
By downloading this application, you are agreeing to the End User Licence Agreement at https://www.opera.com/eula/mobile. Also, you can learn how Opera handles and protects your data in our Privacy Statement at https://www.opera.com/privacy

bluejetty:00016551:ios.description:
Become the lord and master of a real medieval castle! Accept new subjects, assign them to their duties, train and protect your men and women! Defy your rivals and laws of physics as you build and upgrade your fortress!
Your pudgy warriors look great in their shining armor! Nourish and train your troops, and they’ll crush the armies of Grav the Mighty Brainpan, find the shelter of the fearsome OM-NOM, put the Abyss Lord back in his place, and also burn down a couple of enemies’ castles!
All day long your scribes scratch their heads with quills, treasurers spill coins on the floor and blacksmiths drop anvils on their feet for the sake of your prosperity! Prepare true specialists, become wealthy and influential! Build a dating room and watch your subjects have children who’ll soon grow up and serve you too!
Assume command, my lord! Here are some of the opportunities you get in the game:
- Story-driven campaign. In hundreds of missions your heroes fight orcs, giants, skeletons and even dragons! Battle magic, cold steel and cunning strategy – the end justifies the means! 
- Castle construction. Build new rooms for your stronghold and upgrade the existing ones. You’ve got all you need to create a dream castle! Begin the construction now! 
- Developing the villagers. Each of your subjects can learn new skills and wear any equipment. Train great warriors and scribes… and then swap them with each other! 
- Multiplayer. Get medieval! Burn and plunder the castle of someone you don’t like… And you don’t like all of them, right?
Brought to you by MY.GAMES B.V.
In-App purchases may include random items.

bluejetty:00024674:ios.name: Idle Medieval Merchant Tycoon
bluejetty:00024674:ios.summary:
Welcome to Idle Medieval Merchant Tycoon! 
In this little idle game you can craft, transport and improve products to sell them for a profit. Discover manufacturers, settlements and new regions to expand your idle trading empire! 
- Establi
bluejetty:00024674:ios.description:
Welcome to Idle Medieval Merchant Tycoon! 
In this little idle game you can craft, transport and improve products to sell them for a profit. Discover manufacturers, settlements and new regions to expand your idle trading empire! 
- Establish settlements to produce goods
- Build trade routes and create complex production chains
- Hire guild members to work in your facilities
- Upgrade your transporters and your trading posts 
- Discover new islands and continents
- Unlock Achievements to multiply your output
- Participate in special events with unique rewards
- Unlock a huge empire with beautiful art style and atmosphere
We at Bling Bling Games wanted to create a medieval simulation game that revolves around the Hanseatic League, a medieval trading guild in an empire that is today’s north Germany. Tap your way through difficult challenges, collect achievements and upgrade all your business establishments to become the richest trading tycoon in this idle clicker simulation. 
This is an idle or incremental game with clicker elements and an explorative world map. This means you will generate income and products even when you are not actively playing. 
Thank you to all testers and to all people who sent us their feedback! We couldn’t do it without you.
Got a problem in the app? Send us a ticket by going to the settings, tap the “FAQ & Support”- button, tap the blue question mark and enter your info. Or send us an email to support@blingblinggames.com! 
Feel free to send any feedback to feedback@blingblinggames.com!
This game can partially be played offline. An internet connection is needed to play events, claim rewards and connect your Game Center account for achievements and leaderboards. 
This mobile game is completely free to play. Some in-game items can be purchased for real money. If you wish to disable this feature of the app, please turn off the in-app purchases in your phone or tablet's Settings. This app includes in-game advertising. 
Generative AI tools were used during development to assist in creating marketing and promotional graphics, localized text, and visual assets for game updates and new features (such as icons, UI elements, and seasonal content). All AI-assisted assets are reviewed, edited, and integrated by human developers prior to release.
Privacy Policy
https://idletradingempire.net/privacy.html 
Supported by the German Federal Ministry of Transport and Digital Infrastructure.

bluejetty:00088976:ios.description:
Routinsie is your entire daily planner meets entire productivity system & color coded calendar all in one. Making productivity, a ritual one day at a time. The calendar the combines your routines, to do lists, tasks, events & big ideas into one daily timeline.
Meet the app making Google Calendar jealous. Say NO to ugly calendars & planners. Designed for busy brains, ambitious users, ADHD & big dreams welcome.
The all in ONE daily platform. Your ritual planner and color-coded calendar for ambitious women done choosing between their dreams and their routines. Gorgeous, fully customizable. Your calendar, time blocking, to do list, habits, goals, wellness, affirmations, and the version of yourself you're becoming. All in one place that finally feels like you.
Open it every morning. 10 Minutes For You. That's the whole method. Load tasks and routines right into your time-blocked day.
YOUR HOME SCREEN IS YOUR RITUAL
Today's affirmation, mood check-in, color-coded calendar, time blocks, routines, to do list, habits, and goals. Not five apps. One scroll. Your whole day, beautifully organized before you've even had your coffee.
THE DAILY RITUAL METHOD™
The 8-step framework for high-functioning women who refuse to sacrifice their routines for their dreams. Move your body. Set intentions. Brain dump. Plan your day. Time block your hours. Check your habits. Repeat. 10 minutes every morning.
BUILT FOR BUSY BRAINS & BIG PLANS
Visual task management. Multiple to-do lists with custom categories. Drag and sort. Time blocking that actually sticks. No overwhelm. The aesthetic daily planner and color-coded calendar for creative thinkers, ambitious women, and anyone who needs their productivity system to work with them, not against them.
YOUR FULL CALENDAR, FINALLY BEAUTIFUL
Color-coded time blocks. Time blocking made beautiful. Repeating routines. Shared calendars. Sync with Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, and Outlook. Daily, weekly, and monthly views. The most beautiful color-coded calendar app you've ever used.
YOUR TO DO LIST, TASK MANAGER & PROJECT PLANNER
Create multiple to-do lists with custom categories. Drag and sort tasks between lists. Build your weekly task board. Aesthetic task manager. Personal project planner. Daily task tracker. Everything top of mind has a home, and it's beautiful.
YOUR ROUTINE PLANNER, HABITS & SELF CARE
Build morning, evening, and custom rituals inside your color-coded calendar. Time block your routines into your day. Track habits daily. Build streaks. Set big goals. Track your mood. Journal. Gratitude. Daily affirmations. Routinsie is a self care practice built into the app you're already opening every morning.
THE AESTHETIC IS THE POINT
Choose your colors. Design custom palettes. Customize layouts and themes. Aesthetic daily planner. Time blocking planner. Color-coded calendar. Beautiful habit tracker. Mature, minimal, completely yours. A productivity app with an aesthetic that grows with you.
WHAT'S INSIDE:
Color-coded calendar. Time blocking. Routine planner. Multiple to-do lists with drag-and-sort. Habit tracker with streaks. Goal setting. Daily affirmations. Mood tracker and journal. Gratitude practice. Shared calendars. Google, Apple, Outlook sync. Event countdowns. Customizable aesthetic. Visual task manager. Personal project planner. Weekly task board.
Built by Rachel Marie, creator of Go Getter Girl, the original all in one paper planner now in app form.
For women who don't sacrifice their routines for their dreams. We do both.
Where Dreams Become Routines. Making Productivity, a Ritual.

Payment charged to iTunes account on confirmation.

bluejetty:00015257:ios.description:
Através do Gestor Escolar, a Computex oferece ao mercado uma solução moderna e ágil, que proporciona às Escolas a ferramenta certa para a sua gestão.
Nossa experiência e especialização em soluções para escolas são benefícios incorporados ao Gestor Escolar, sistema testado, instalado e aprovado em diversas instituições nos estados do NORTE e NORDESTE do Brasil.
COMUNICADOS
Pais e alunos receberão avisos, convites e cartões comemorativos, dentre outros informes.
AGENDA
Acesso à agenda diária dos alunos. Pais e alunos poderão verificar toda a programação e eventos da escola.
BOLETIM
Disponibiliza a consulta, on-line, ao boletim de notas e ao relatório de acompanhamento dos alunos da educação infantil.
OCORRÊNCIAS
Consulta on-line a fatos ocorridos com o aluno durante o ano letivo. Os pais terão acesso a todas as atividades extracurriculares de seus filhos.
BIBLIOTECA
Acesso ao acerco da biblioteca, possibilitando reservas on-line.
BOLETO BANCÁRIO
Envio direto para os pais dos alunos.
PORTARIA
Os pais podem, diariamente, consultar os horários de entrada e saída de seus filhos.
HORÁRIO
Consulta aos horários das aulas.
CHAT
Possibilita conversas on-line entre pais e coordenadores para resolver, de forma rápida e eficaz, questões que envolvam os alunos.
RECIBO PARA IMPOSTO DE RENDA
Os pais podem receber a declaração de pagamentos das mensalidades para o imposto de renda.
GALERIA DE FOTOS
Disponibiliza imagens de eventos e atividades escolares em álbuns digitais
MATRÍCULA
Os pais podem receber contrato, lista de documentos, boleto de matrícula e matricular seus filhos sem sair de casa.
DIGITAÇÃO DE NOTAS E FALTAS
Os professores podem digitar as notas e as faltas dos alunos.

bluejetty:00187820:ios.description:
● Download Easy Scanner for free and turn your phone into powerful PDF scanner & converter in a second!
Easily scan your documents, receipts, photos, business cards, QR Codes, and more on the go, and save them as multi-page, high-quality PDF, JPEG, or TXT files 
Scanned documents can be emailed, printed, faxed, exported to camera roll or uploaded to cloud services like Dropbox, Evernote, Google Drive, iCloud. 
Easy Scanner's built-in advanced scanning algorithm automatically detects borders of the page, corrects perspective and distortion, eliminates shadows and sets a perfect contrast for text - black on white. 
Easy Scanner FEATURES: 
● Automatic document edge detection and perspective correction 
● Advanced image processing with enhancement and color correction, noise removing and more
● Multipage scanning(Batch mode) and document managing
● Document naming, storage inside the app, and smart search
● Document sorting by date and name
● Adding or reordering pages in a document
● Page size options for PDF (Letter, Legal, A4, A5, Business Card)
● Email the scans as PDF, JPEG, TXT or save to Camera Roll 
● Add signatures to scans
● Extract text from documents with OCR
● Upload the scans to cloud services like Dropbox, Evernote, Google Drive and more
● Fax scans to 30 countries with one tap
● Printing via AirPrint 
● Lock documents or PDF files with password 
Documents are processed on the phone without an internet connection. Your scans remain fully private always and not sent to a third-party server.
We are constantly improving Easy Scanner to create the best scanner app and help you digitize your documents easier and faster than ever. ▼ For daily schedule management and visualization of records to look back on the day ▼
Enter your 24-hour schedule for the next day and have a meaningful day.
With automatic analysis, you can also display the total time and bar graph, so you can look back on the schedule of the day at the end of the day.
You can visualize the wasted time, improve your vague life, and spend a well-balanced day toward your goals.
▼ Full of functions ▼
It is equipped with all the functions necessary for schedule management, such as automatic totaling of total time, display of transitions by bar graph, registration of diary and goals, and remind function by push notification.
▼ Features / Differences from similar apps ▼
[free]
The usage fee is free. (With in-app purchase)

You can easily register an appointment with "1 tap", so scheduling does not take time.
[Pie chart]
The schedule is displayed as a pie chart, so you can visualize the flow of the day.
[Schedule tittle can be freely described]
You can add as many schedules as you like, so you can use them according to your purpose.
[Automatic total time]
Since the total time can be calculated automatically for each schedule, you can immediately see "how many hours you have studied in total".
You can view the total time for breaks and games to improve the way you spend your day when scheduling the next day.
[Transition by bar graph]
You can see the transition for one month on the bar chart.
[List display]
The schedule can be displayed not only in the pie chart but also in the list, so you can check the detailed schedule at a glance.
[Over 100 colors ]
We have more than 100 color variations so that you can choose the color that suits your schedule.
[Time is in 5 minute increments]
Schedules can be registered in 5-minute increments, so detailed schedules can be registered and visualized.
[Notification function]
You can turn on push notifications to receive notifications at the scheduled start time.
[Registration of diary]
You can write down your daily records and hard work as a diary.
[Visualization of goals]
Since you can register goals, you will be able to manage the time to achieve the goals.

Get Ready to Fill the Void Hole... With Brilliant Gems!
Welcome to Hole Gems All, where every move counts and every perfectly placed gem brings you closer to sweet victory. Forget ordinary puzzles; this is where logic, space, and dazzling strategy collide in a way you’ve never experienced before.

Here’s Where the Magic Happens:

√ The Color Conundrum: Brace yourself for the delightful challenge of color blocking! Same space can’t host the different gem color. This intricate rule forces you to meticulously plan your gem placements, weaving a complex web of strategy that will test your problem-solving prowess to its limits.

• The Ultimate Brain Workout: This isn't just a game; it's a daily mental polish. Enhance your logical deduction, spatial awareness, and forward-thinking skills with every satisfying move.

• Endless Strategic Journeys: Explore a vast collection of meticulously crafted levels. Each one is a fresh puzzle, a new arrangement, and an exciting opportunity to push your strategic limits.
• Play On Your Terms: No frantic timers here! Focus on precision, enjoy the process, and strategize at your own pace.

bluejetty:00138072:ios.description:
"Screw Pin Jam Puzzle" is an incredibly creative and strategic puzzle game designed to enhance players' spatial imagination and strategic planning abilities. In this game, players face a board composed of complex and intricately placed screws and pins. Each screw and pin could be key to solving the puzzle, requiring careful consideration with every move.
Game features include:
Diverse level designs: Ranging from simple to complex, each level has a unique layout and difficulty, requiring players to constantly adjust their solution strategies.
Intuitive interface: Clear graphics and smooth animation make it easy for players to pick up, while still providing enough challenge.
Combination of logic and creativity: Challenges players not only in logical reasoning but also inspires them to use creativity to find multiple possible solutions.
Enhanced replay value: Due to the varying positions of screws and pins in each game, the solution differs each time, greatly enhancing the game's replay value.
Scoring and reward system: Completing levels earns players points and rewards, motivating them to solve puzzles more efficiently.
"Screw Pin Jam Puzzle" is more than just a simple pastime game; it challenges players to think quickly and act precisely under pressure. Successfully unlocking each level brings players a great sense of satisfaction and accomplishment. Whether challenging oneself alone or competing with friends for high scores, this game provides rich entertainment and educational value.

bluejetty:00061152:ios.summary: On the battlefield of Kurukshetra, Lord Krishna gave an inspiring message to Arjuna, which became known as Bhagvad Gita, Bhagawat Geeta or Srimad Bhagavad Gita - the song celestial. The 700 verses rendered by Lord Krishna are considered as
bluejetty:00061152:ios.description:
On the battlefield of Kurukshetra, Lord Krishna gave an inspiring message to Arjuna, which became known as Bhagvad Gita, Bhagawat Geeta or Srimad Bhagavad Gita - the song celestial. The 700 verses rendered by Lord Krishna are considered as quintessence of Hinduism and reflects the wisdom of Upanishads. Bhagavad Gita is part of epic Mahabharata and is contained in Bhishma Parva, chapter 23-40.
The message of Gita was not delivered on banks of Ganges, nor inside caves, monasteries or at the outset of any hermit's dwelling place but was conferred on the battlefield filled with belligerent armies, awaiting fierce encounter. When Arjuna saw revered teachers, beloved friends and close relatives on his enemy side, he was overtaken by grief and despair. As a result he chose to lay down his arms and sought counsel from his charioteer and friend, Krishna. In his unique and mesmerizing style, Krishna answered Arjun's array of questions covering sin, slander and siblings to death, duty, desire, duality and divinity. Arjuna was convinced that death on the battlefield was that merely of physical frame and not of the inner immortal soul. listings.name: Bhagavad Gita In Gujarati .
listings.description:
On the battlefield of Kurukshetra, Lord Krishna gave an inspiring message to Arjuna, which became known as Bhagvad Gita, Bhagawat Geeta or Srimad Bhagavad Gita - the song celestial. The 700 verses rendered by Lord Krishna are considered as quintessence of Hinduism and reflects the wisdom of Upanishads. Bhagavad Gita is part of epic Mahabharata and is contained in Bhishma Parva, chapter 23-40.
The message of Gita was not delivered on banks of Ganges, nor inside caves, monasteries or at the outset of any hermit's dwelling place but was conferred on the battlefield filled with belligerent armies, awaiting fierce encounter. When Arjuna saw revered teachers, beloved friends and close relatives on his enemy side, he was overtaken by grief and despair. As a result he chose to lay down his arms and sought counsel from his charioteer and friend, Krishna. In his unique and mesmerizing style, Krishna answered Arjun's array of questions covering sin, slander and siblings to death, duty, desire, duality and divinity. Arjuna was convinced that death on the battlefield was that merely of physical frame and not of the inner immortal soul. The conversation between Krishna and Arjuna threw light on many important aspects of Hinduism such as life and death, karma, devotion, jnana, yoga, supreme reality and duality.

The only available Gujarati translation of BhagavadGita, this great poem is made available on this application for the first time. It is a humble attempt made by webmaster to present it in this way to facilitate easy reference. One would derive great pleasure by just reading the Gujarati version as it keep intact the storyline. The tune and meters of poetry are also not exactly replicated in Gujarati yet, in their own they are pretty consistent.

В приложении есть более 10 000 машин для быстрой аренды на минуты, часы, дни, и есть десяток моделей для долгой аренды от месяца. Авто можно взять в Москве, Петербурге, Калининграде, Казани, Екатеринбурге, Перми, Саратове и Сочи.
А зачем нужен каршеринг?
Чтобы утром поездить по делам, успеть на работу, вечером в бар, а там уже оставить машину и уехать на такси. Чтобы на выходных отвезти что-нибудь на дачу или устроить роад-трип по области. Чтобы закрывать задачи с коллегами быстрее, если у вас свой бизнес.
А чем каршеринг особенно хорош?
Тем, что в аренду авто входят платные парковки, мойка, заправка, ремонт и страхование.
А что ещё есть?
Есть Клуб Драйва. Он даёт скидку до 20% на поездки по базовым тарифам, которая суммируется с другими скидками, ночное ожидание за наш счёт, до 20 минут бесплатного ожидания, фильтры «Только помыли» и «Почти новая». Чего только в Клубе нет.
А подписка тогда зачем?
Чтобы машина была вашей надолго. Это аренда от месяца с оплатой по частям и бесплатным ТО, ШМ и ремонтом. Хотите — продлевайте до года, хотите — выкупайте авто. Есть машины разных классов без оклейки. Так что никто ни о чём не догадается. Подписку можно оплачивать и с корпоративного счёта, если надо. 
А как зарегистрироваться?
Всё в приложении, ехать никуда не нужно. Главное — иметь права категории В и быть старше 18 лет, а стаж хоть какой. Когда скачаете приложение, вас встретит робот. Он проведёт через всю регистрацию, а вы просто пришлёте фотографии документов и свои данные ему в чат. И вы в Драйве.
А что за страховки?
Есть ОСАГО, страхование жизни водителя и пассажиров до 2 000 000 ₽ и франшиза «Виновника». С ней вы не заплатите больше 100 000 ₽ за ущерб обычной машины, 130 000 ₽ за электромашину и 200 000 ₽ за особую. А если подключить акцию «Полное спокойствие», то есть полное покрытие ущерба, то все риски мы возьмём на себя, и при любых повреждениях с вас вообще ничего не спишем, если ДТП оформлено верно. Так что в Драйве вы прикрыты со всех сторон. После любой поездки можно подгрузить фото машины с четырёх сторон — так будут пруфы, что всё хорошо, и покой на душе. Все детали в приложении.
А какие машины в Драйве?
У нас более 10 000 машин 20 разных моделей. Есть классика — Geely, Chery, Haval, Škoda, Volkswagen, Audi, Mercedes, BMW. Фургоны и микроавтобусы тоже есть, мыслим масштабно.
А что за тарифы?
Есть «Фикс», где вы ставите конечную точку, и стоимость поездки фиксируется. За завершение поездки в указанной зоне будет скидка. Есть «Минуты», цена каждой из которых динамическая и зависит от спроса. Есть «Часы и дни» — это тариф-конструктор, где вы сами выбираете, сколько нужно времени и километров. Тут чем дольше аренда, тем выгоднее минута. В процессе пакетные тарифы можно докупать, если не хватит. А ещё есть «Межгород», чтобы ездить, не поверите, между городами.
А в чём технологичность Драйва?
Во всём. Доступы к машинам выдают алгоритмы. Радар может сам забронировать машину. Прогреть, охладить или открыть авто можно через приложение. Свой навигатор с Алисой. С двойной арендой можно пересесть из обычного авто в грузовое. Можно передать руль близкому с регистрацией в Драйве. Даже двери открываются и закрываются по блютусу.
А если я с детьми?
Мы только рады: для мини пассажиров есть специальные кресла и бустеры.
А скидки и промокоды есть?
Есть сразу несколько способов экономить или ездить вообще бесплатно. Первый — вступить в Клуб Драйва, который даёт скидку 20% на поездки. Второй — приводить в Драйв друзей, получать баллы за их поездки и оплачивать ими свои. Третий — подключить Яндекс Плюс и получать кешбэк баллами, который потом снова тратить на Драйв, чтобы снова получать кэшбэк, и так бесконечно. Четвёртый — следить за партнёрскими акциями, устраиваем регулярно. Кстати, баллы Драйва можно дарить друзьям, пусть катаются на здоровье.

• My Contacts

bluejetty:00035561:ios.description:
Fomz: Artistic Light Retro Camera
Redefine "retro" with "trend"
Every camera has its own color
Each design has its own style
Every photo has its own story
Fomz is a camera app that incorporates trendy elements into retro film.
Each camera theme retains the unique texture of film cameras, but also gives it more meaning and scenes, so that no matter what occasion in your life, there is always a Fomz Film that can fit it.
● Artistic film theme
Just as every camera has a story behind it, every Fomz camera theme will also have its own characteristics and meanings. Different shooting interfaces will bring you a different mood every time you shoot.
● Classic film filter
A selection of classic film filters, each theme is matched with different film grains, time watermarks, light leakage effects, film photo paper and other imaging effects according to the style, so that you will be full of surprises every time you take pictures;
● Document our story
Remember when you were a kid, your parents would write a story about the photo on the back of the photo you developed? Sometimes it's a "small diary", sometimes it's a sentence, sometimes it's just a special date... These are all treasured records about that moment in the photo. Fomz deliberately kept this "old tradition", as long as the back of the photo was turned upside down, he could write a written record about the photo.
"We record frequently because life is worth it."
Text and photos are the most convenient and direct way to record life
I hope that Fomz can go through the romance of the world with you and taste the bitters and sweets of life
If you have any comments or suggestions during use
Welcome to send us feedback in the APP
Or please contact 2061531363@qq.com
Fomz is still improving and improving, bringing you more surprises
Thanks for every love and support

bluejetty:00159795:ios.name: Levels - Metabolic Health
bluejetty:00159795:ios.summary:
Levels helps you understand your body through comprehensive lab testing, glucose monitoring, and AI-powered habit tracking—so you can take daily action and improve what matters most.
Levels is backed by advisors who are key leaders in meta
bluejetty:00159795:ios.description:
Levels helps you understand your body through comprehensive lab testing, glucose monitoring, and AI-powered habit tracking—so you can take daily action and improve what matters most.
Levels is backed by advisors who are key leaders in metabolic health: Dr. David Perlmutter; Dr. Robert Lustig; Dr. Sara Gottfried; Dr. Terry Wahls; Ben Bikman, PhD; Dom D'Agostino, PhD, and was co-founded by Dr. Casey Means.
LEVELS CHANGES HOW PEOPLE LIVE THEIR LIVES:
- "I'm far more aware of my body and its reactions to food, exercise, sleep, and stress. I feel better when I have more food choices than when I was limiting myself too much." —Laurel Touby, 59, New York
- "I was focused on course correcting my dietary and lifestyle choices to improve my metabolic health, but I realized very quickly that it was much more than that. This is not about deprivation and what I cannot eat." —Celia Chen, 49, Los Angeles
- "It's the combination of intermittent fasting and using the CGM that has accelerated my metabolic health optimization. I finally feel like I've cracked the code on my body." —Chris Wise, 42, Los Angeles
Everybody has health goals. Whether you're tuning your diet, optimizing your exercise, or just trying to stay healthy, monitoring your blood glucose with Levels can help—you'll finally be able to unlock what will work best for YOUR body.
NUTRITION
Your favorite "healthy" foods may be holding you back from feeling your best. Learn exactly how your diet affects your glucose so you can cut through diet and nutrition advice and find what works for you. 
FITNESS
To stay energized throughout your workouts, you have to know how to fuel properly. Levels helps you eat the right food at the right time to help you improve metabolic flexibility, which can give you stable energy outside of the gym.
LONGEVITY
By monitoring your blood glucose to see what your diet does to your body in real-time, you may be able to reduce the risk of developing chronic diseases, and you may maximize long-term health.
FEATURES
- Connect compatible glucose biosensors to track your levels
- Log food and exercise to see how they correlate to your glucose levels
- In-app, personalized suggestions to improve your glucose stability
- Compare meals to see how food swaps affect blood glucose
- Track your progress with Zone Scores and daily reports
- Challenge yourself to keep your glucose levels stable throughout the day
- View lab results alongside your glucose data
- Levels integrates with Apple Health to sync exercise logs automatically, which creates personalized insights for how your glucose is trending based on your Apple Health metrics like sleep hours, step count, heart rate, weight, and age
DISCLAIMER
The Levels app is not designed or intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease or condition; it is intended for general-wellness purposes only. Users should make medical decisions only through consultation with their physicians, and not based on any information presented in the Levels app. For additional information:
Privacy Policy: https://levels.link/privacy
Terms of Service: https://levels.link/terms
Levels Glucose and Lifestyle Data Patterns in the General Population Study: https://levels.link/study

bluejetty:00161270:ios.description:
Walk into your next interview ready. Huru is your personal AI interview coach: talk with a live AI interviewer or answer real interview questions out loud on video, get a score on every answer, and learn exactly what to say next time. Completely free.
NEW: LIVE AI INTERVIEWS
• Have a real conversation with an AI interviewer who listens, asks follow-up questions and adapts to what you say
• Choose video or audio only; on video you also get feedback on eye contact and presence
• Pick your interviewer, the length (5 to 20 minutes) and the pressure level
• Get a full debrief: a score for every answer, your conversation skills and what to work on next
PRACTICE LIKE IT'S THE REAL THING
• Record your answers on video, just like a real interview
• Hear each question read aloud by a natural female or male interviewer voice
• Take a moment to think, then answer in up to two minutes
GET SCORED ON EVERY ANSWER
• An overall score plus five skills: relevance, structure, specificity, impact and articulation
• Clear coaching: what worked, what to work on, and a stronger way to structure your answer
• Replay your video to see how you come across
240+ CAREER ROLES, OR YOUR OWN
• Mock interviews for 240+ roles across 29 career families, from marketing and finance to engineering, healthcare and hospitality
• Paste any job post and Huru writes the questions that job will ask
• Write up to five of your own questions and rehearse them until they feel easy
• Behavioral interview practice with the STAR method (situation, task, action, result)
WATCH YOUR PROGRESS
• Interview readiness score and trends over time
• Your strongest skill and the one to focus on next
• Daily practice reminders and streaks keep you on track
SKILLS AGENT
• A guided assessment of the skills recruiters look for, with levels, badges and a personal plan
100% FREE
Everything is included: no subscription, no paywall, no trial. Huru works in English, Spanish, French, German and Portuguese.
Whether it's your first job, a career change or a final-round interview, Huru helps you build the confidence to answer any question.

bluejetty:00158112:ios.description:
Someone unfollowed you. Find out who and clean up everyone who doesn't follow back, 15x faster.
Mass Unfollow Cleaner is the fastest way to take control of your Instagram: see exactly who unfollowed you, clear out non-followers in bulk, and keep an eye on any account's activity.
WHO UNFOLLOWED YOU
Get an alert the moment someone leaves — with their name, not just a number. See new followers, lost followers, and who quietly removed you.
MASS UNFOLLOW — 15× FASTER
Select every account that doesn't follow you back and unfollow them in one tap. Built-in rate limits pace everything safely, so you don't have to think about it.
SMART CAMPAIGNS
Unfollowing hundreds of accounts? Campaigns split the job into safe batches that run over time — start it, close the app, and we'll notify you as it progresses. You approve every step; nothing happens without you.
NOT FOLLOWING BACK
Instantly see everyone you follow who doesn't follow you back, plus ghost and inactive followers who never engage.
FOLLOW SPY
Add any public account to your watchlist and see their new follows and unfollows in one feed, updated around the clock.
STORY VIEWER
Watch stories without appearing in the viewers list, and browse any public profile's picture in full HD.
INSTANT NOTIFICATIONS
Customizable push alerts for new followers, unfollowers, and campaign progress — know the moment anything changes.
Questions or issues? Our support team is a tap away inside the app.
SUBSCRIPTION
Mass Unfollow Cleaner offers a premium subscription for access to additional features. Payment is charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your account settings.

This app is an independent tool and is not sponsored, endorsed, or administered by Instagram. Instagram is a trademark of Instagram, LLC.

bluejetty:00100442:ios.description:
You think you know the world. GeoHunter proves how well.
Each round gives you eight countries and eight ranking categories: population, coffee production, football, tourism, GDP, crime, and a few you won't expect. Match every country to a category, then guess where it ranks globally. The closer your guesses, the lower your score, and the lower the better.
Classic teaches you the ropes. World, Special, Voyage and Atlas dig into deeper, weirder data, where a single category you've never thought about can make or break your run.
Then it opens up. Unlock the US states, Canada, Europe, Footy Clubs, a Nations Cup, and forty ancient empires if you want to see how Rome stacks up against the Mongols.
A new Daily Challenge drops every morning, the same one for everyone. One country doesn't fit any category, so remember to skip it. Play, compare, and climb the global leaderboard.
Think a friend knows the world better? Duel them. Choose a difficulty from Easy to Expert and settle it head to head, live or on their own time.
Level up, earn tiers across every mode, and sharpen the kind of instinct that makes you the person everyone checks with at pub quiz.
For the curious, the competitive, and anyone who's ever wondered where their country really ranks.
Terms of Use & Privacy Policy: https://www.geohuntergame.com/terms

bluejetty:00179104:ios.name: my Sun Life (Canada)
bluejetty:00179104:ios.summary:
Your benefits, insurance and savings – right at your fingertips. 
Designed for Clients. Powered by Sun Life.
The my Sun Life mobile app is your all-in-one digital hub to manage your benefits, insurance, and investments with ease—anytime, an
bluejetty:00179104:ios.description:
Your benefits, insurance and savings – right at your fingertips. 
Designed for Clients. Powered by Sun Life.
The my Sun Life mobile app is your all-in-one digital hub to manage your benefits, insurance, and investments with ease—anytime, anywhere. Whether you’re tracking your group retirement savings, submitting health claims, or checking your investment performance, the app puts you in control of your financial and personal well-being.
Take care of your health, on the go.
Whether you have personal insurance or workplace benefits, the app makes it easy to manage your health coverage. *
• Access health services* and products.
• Submit medical and dental claims for faster repayments. **
• Get real-time updates on your claim statuses with notifications.
• Snap photos of receipts and documents for quick uploads.
• Review your coverage and access your digital benefit card.
• Track your Health Spending Account (HSA) and Personal Spending Account (PSA) balance.
*Coverage and features depend on your specific benefits plan.
**Most claims are processed within 1-2 business days when direct deposit is set up. 
See your money in real time.
From RRSPs to group savings plans or individual products, the app helps you stay on top of your investments.
• Check account balances and view history of contributions and withdrawals.
• Track the rate of returns of your investments.
• Make contributions when it’s convenient for you. 
Get more from your health-care experience. 
The app goes beyond claims bringing you tools to save time and money on care: 
• Conveniently access health care services and offerings including virtual health care and pharmacy services, right in the app to support your well-being.
• Integrate with Health Connect to monitor your daily steps, active minutes, and progress over time, helping you stay on track with wellness goals and challenges.
• Join community steps and fitness challenges to stay motivated alongside friends, family, or colleagues.
• Use provider search to explore and find local practitioners like psychologists, chiropractors, and dentists. 
• Explore Sun Life’s health services and offerings based on your plan.
• Look up medications with the Drug Lookup tool.
• Explore special offers on mental-health resources, fitness, eyewear, and more! 
Support and updates when you need them. 
Stay in the loop and get personalized health with just a few taps.
• Get push notifications for claim status and important updates.
• Receive helpful reminders, product updates, and special offers.
• Call Sun Life directly from the app and your info will be ready when we answer.
• Use our chat function for quick support and answers to commonly asked questions.
• Connect with your advisor or find one nearby. 
Easy to use. Made specifically for you. 
Download the app and log in with your my Sun Life ID and password. New user? You can register directly in the app or at mysunlife.ca 
Learn more at sunlife.ca/mobile
Note: Data charges may apply when using this app.
Can’t use the app? You can still view your account by signing in to mysunlife.ca or contacting us at 1-877-SUN-LIFE (1-877-786-5433). 
Any use of this application is subject to the terms of the End User License Agreement available on mysunlife.ca/mobilelicence

Marquee TV brings you the most prestigious performing arts and cultural programs from around the world. Discover brand new works or rediscover your favorite performances from the world of opera, theater, music and dance plus fascinating documentaries about the arts.

A Marquee TV subscription is your passport to arts and culture on demand and includes: 
- Contemporary Dance, Theater, Opera, Ballet, Docs & more. 
- Curated collections from acclaimed theater companies, venues, directors & choreographers.
- Unlimited HD 
- Watch on your big screen using AirPlay, and Chromecast
- Download the app & watch on the go 
- Create personal watchlists of your favorite content.

bluejetty:00175744:ios.summary:

-「Splicing and sound mixing」: One-key switching; support free drag, easy to operate 
-「 Record 」:
bluejetty:00175744:ios.description:
[Audio Editor] A simple and powerful audio editing tool. It can complete the professional audio clips work easily on iPhone and iPad 
[Edit] 
-「Splicing and sound mixing」: One-key switching; support free drag, easy to operate 
-「 Record 」: Support wired or wireless (AirPods and Pro) earphones and in-ear monitor; support accompaniment play; 
-「 Cut」: Cut the audio fast and freely 
-「 Rate 」: 0.2 times ~ 4 times, control the playback speed freely 
-「 Balance 」: Support R-CH and L-CH settings 
-「 Fade 」: 1s~5s, set the fade-in fade-out as one wishes 
-「Loop」: Extend the audio "tile" to any duration
[Effects] 
-「Pitch」: Rising and falling, change the voice into that of "Lolita" and "uncle" and so on within one second 
-「Reverb」: Room, living room and church, etc., switch the scenario as one wishes 
-「Distortion」: Electronic, echo and metal, etc., feel different audio 
-「Delay」: Support max 2s delay special-effects; a single can also have chorus 
-「Equalizer」: Bass boost and human voice resonance, etc., custom equalizer with 10 sections of frequency. It makes your audio voice clear, high pitch transparent and low pitch "rhythmic" 
[Player]
-「Streaming Playback」: Supports SMB, WebDAV, Navidrome, and Audio Station, letting you enjoy music from multiple sources anytime
-「Synced Lyrics」: Supports synchronized line-by-line and word-by-word lyrics
-「Multi-Source Music Library」: Manage music from NAS, servers, and local cache in one place
-「Equalizer」: Includes multiple built-in EQ presets and a customizable 10-band equalizer
-「Smart Caching」: Supports manual or automatic song caching, so you can keep listening without a network connection
-「Play History」: Automatically records recently played and most-played songs, making your favorite music easy to find
[Characteristics] 
-「Audio Toolbox」: Noise reduction, vocal enhancement, vocal/accompaniment separation...
-「Setting as ringtone」: Set the audio as the phone ringtone 
-「Format conversion」: Support many audio formats with free conversion, such as mp3, m4a, m4r, wav, aiff, etc. 
-「Audio import」: Support more than 6 ways to import audio: Video extract, WiFi, UTI, Apple music, file and clipboard 
-「Auto-draft」: Autosave the draft with more efficient re-editing 
-「Undo/Redo」: Support unlimited times of undo and redo 
-「Tag group」: Set the color mark to group the audio easily 
-「Delete/Withdraw」: Provide "repentance" operation after the audio is deleted 
* The APP is carefully optimized to offer comprehensive features at just one-third the size of similar products. It also includes a built-in storage management feature, allowing efficient file management and maintaining minimal storage usage.
[Contact us] 
Mail: contact@iuuapp.com
Your suggestion is very important to me, you can contact me using the feedback in the app.
Automatic renewal statement:
1. Payment: "Continuous monthly / year" products are auto-renewable products. After confirming the purchase, you will be charged from your Apple iTunes account;
2. Renewal: 24 hours before the expiration of your subscription period, Apple will automatically deduct the charge from your ITunes account, and the validity period of "Remove ads" will be automatically extended after success;
3. If you need to cancel the automatic renewal, please turn off the automatic renewal manually in the Apple ID account settings at least 24 hours before the subscription period expires. No charge will be made after closing.
Terms of Service:
http://common.iuuapp.com/terms_service_env1_audio.html
Privacy Policy:

bluejetty:00049635:android.description:
piupiu.io is a real-time, online multiplayer io game. 
Hide in the grass, Shoot as a sniper and Fight to survive!
In battle royale and other game modes, massive io game lovers are having fun every day here. piupiu.io is a totally online io game with minimum data cost however maximum online pleasure, you may feel it like other offline io game because there is no lag(if there is, please let us know and we will optimize the network connection for you). 
Control your tank to move and attack the enemies on various maps. As you level up, you gain ability points and upgrade your abilities to gain more power of attack or defense etc. Upgrade your tank at certain levels so you have multiple forms and attack styles.
Five exciting game modes that you can join at any time: infinity battle, color conquest, time attack, battle royale and Lost Temple in which you create a private room for you and your friends. If you would like to challenge the high score rank, you would play infinity battle, if you like the fast-paced sweeping the whole map, then play battle royale, in short, play different modes you need different stratigy, and you will be amused in this high quality io game.
It is worth mentioning Lost Temple Mode, because you can't find private room in other io games (^_^)v "The Lost Temple" was the most favorite game map of the millions-players-loved Starr Crraft...Open a private room in the game, call your friends to join, split into teams to start the war! .... "You Are Under Attack!" any one remember that sound? don't worry, We don't have same sound in the game. But, anyway, it's definitly worth a try, feel free to tell us your experience in the review section! we hope everyone loves 
In addition to entering the game by youself at anytime, you can also team up with friends to have more fun, team members will enter the game automatically teleported to the location of teammates, team members also respawn at points close to teammates. Team members can not hurt each other, they fight with the rest of the world together!
If you had clicked "Install" when you started reading this, the game should has been installed! welcome to immediately enter the game!
Feel free to leave comments, reviews, suggestion! Feel free to email us at play@piupiu.io, I'm waiting for you!

[FaceSwapper: Your Ultimate App for Realistic AI Face Swaps!]
Want to see yourself as a movie superstar or create lifelike AI face swaps? FaceSwapper is the ultimate app for crafting stunning composite photos, videos, and GIFs. Powered by advanced AI and face swap technology, it’s your go-to tool for seamless editing and boundless creativity. 
[Features: ]
[Video & Photo Face Swap]
• Upload your videos and photos for a one-click face swap.
• Explore a vast library of daily updated templates for endless creativity.
• Swap faces for up to four people at once in a single image or video.
• Randomly swap faces among multiple people in a photo.
• Enjoy lightning-fast processing and high-quality results.
[Try On Any Outfits]
• Upload a photo or use a virtual avatar, and let AI recognize the clothes and "dress" you, simulating a realistic try-on experience.
• AI detects body contours for accurate and tailored fits.
• Visualize your look in real-time, try on various outfits and styles, and enhance your shopping experience.
[Voice Swap]
• Choose from a variety of tones and input text to generate a realistic, natural-sounding speech.
• Clone your own voice and add your unique vocal tone to any audio, giving it a personal touch.
[What You Can Do with FaceSwapper]
Celebrity Lookalike: Step into the spotlight! With the cutting-edge face swap tool, replace your face with famous actors and relive iconic movie moments like the Titanic. Transform into characters from other worlds—the possibilities are endless.
Funny Clips: Make hilarious videos and photos using face morphing and gender swap tools. Create trending GIFs and memes or swap faces with iconic artworks like the Mona Lisa. Share your creations effortlessly on social media!
[Safe & Secure]
Your privacy is our priority. FaceSwapper processes all data locally on your device, ensuring that no facial data is transmitted or stored on servers. Enjoy face swaps and AI creations worry-free!
#About subscription
Start your FaceSwapper journey with a free trial, available once per Apple account. After the trial, a nominal subscription fee applies. Membership auto-renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.
For inquiries, reach us at facereplacerapp@gmail.com.

bluejetty:00088943:ios.description:
Winston is the ultimate game tracker to help you organize, track, and discover video games. With features like gameplay tracking, custom lists, and a release calendar, it helps you to stay on top of your games. Whether you're a casual gamer or a hardcore enthusiast, Winston ensures you never miss a game and always know what to play next.
Key Features:
- Privacy-focused: No sign-in required and none of your data is collected.
- Detailed Game Info: Access trailers, screenshots, and more. Powered by IGDB.
- Release Date Alerts: Never miss a release date again.
- Game Tracking: Mark progress, track playtime, and decide what you're going to play next.
- Sale Tracking: See which games in your Wishlist are on sale. Supports prices from Steam, GOG, and more. Powered by IsThereAnyDeal.
Track Your Gameplay
- Add games to your queue
- Mark games as "Started," "Paused," "Completed," or "Stopped"
- Track playtime for all your games
Discover New Games
- Browse trending games or filter by platform (PS5, Xbox, Switch, PC, and more)
- Search for a specific game on IGDB by title
- Automatically find games by pasting links from Steam, Reddit, IGDB, Wikipedia, Twitch, and Fandom
- See trailers, screenshots, critic ratings, release dates, keywords, and more
Stay on Top of Releases
- Add upcoming games to your calendar
- Get notified when your tracked games launch
Create Lists & Add Notes
- Organize your games with custom lists
- Keep a gaming journal with one or more notes for each game
- Rate your games and remember which games you’ve enjoyed the most
Start tracking your games today with Winston!
Video game data is provided by igdb.com and isthereanydeal.com. Winston is not endorsed or certified by any of the listed services.

bluejetty:00071465:ios.name: Garmin Explore™
bluejetty:00071465:ios.summary:
OFF-GRID NAVIGATION
When paired with your compatible Garmin device(1), the Garmin Explore app lets you use your mobile device for outdoor navigation, trip planning, mapping and more — with or without Wi-Fi® connectivity or cellular service.
bluejetty:00071465:ios.description:
OFF-GRID NAVIGATION
When paired with your compatible Garmin device(1), the Garmin Explore app lets you use your mobile device for outdoor navigation, trip planning, mapping and more — with or without Wi-Fi® connectivity or cellular service.
SEARCH TOOL
Easily locate geographic points — such as trailheads or mountain summits — associated with your adventure.
STREAMING MAPS
For pre-trip planning, you can use the Garmin Explore app to stream maps when you’re within cellular or Wi-Fi range — saving valuable time as well as storage space on your mobile device. Download maps for offline use when venturing outside cellular range.
PAIR, SYNC AND SHARE
With Garmin Explore, you can pair your smartphone or tablet with your compatible Garmin device to sync and share data for off-grid adventures. Use downloadable maps for navigation anywhere.
EASY TRIP PLANNING
Plan your next trip by downloading maps and creating courses. Specify your start and finish points, and automatically create a course you can sync with your compatible Garmin device.
ACTIVITY LIBRARY
Under the Saved tab, review and edit your organized data, including your saved waypoints, tracks, courses and activities. See map thumbnails to easily recognize your trips.
SAVED COLLECTIONS 
The collections list allows you to quickly find all data related to any trip — making it easy to sort and locate the course or location you’re looking for.
CLOUD STORAGE
The waypoints, courses and activities you’ve created will automatically sync to your Garmin Explore web account when you’re within cellular or 
Wi-Fi range, preserving your activity data with cloud storage. A Garmin account is required for storing your data in the cloud.
LIVETRACK™
With the use of the LiveTrack™ feature, loved ones can follow your location in real time(2) and see data such as distance, time and elevation.
What You Get with Garmin Explore
• Unlimited map downloads; access topographic maps, USGS quad sheets and more
• Aerial imagery
• Waypoints, tracking and route navigation
• High-detail GPS trip logging and location sharing
• Unlimited cloud storage of routes, waypoints, tracks, and activities
• Online trip planning
1. https://explore.garmin.com/appcompatibility
2. When used with your compatible smartphone, the Garmin Explore® app and your compatible inReach® technology-enabled Garmin device.
The Bluetooth word mark and logos are registered trademarks owned by Bluetooth SIG, Inc. and any use of such marks by Garmin is under license.

bluejetty:00041310:ios.summary:
