TRACK YOUR PET IN REAL TIME WITH UNLIMITED RANGE
Stay connected with your pet wherever they are. Get background locat
bluejetty:00041310:ios.description:
Companion app for FitBark GPS and health trackers. If you don't have a tracker yet, you can easily get one at fitbark.com
TRACK YOUR PET IN REAL TIME WITH UNLIMITED RANGE
Stay connected with your pet wherever they are. Get background location updates throughout the day or start a live tracking session with real-time updates. Select a plan in the FitBark app to activate the cellular sim card embedded in your FitBark device.
GET ESCAPE ALERTS FROM YOUR SAFE PLACES
Create safe zones around your Wi-Fi networks, such as your home or daycare. Receive instant alerts whenever your pet leaves or enters these designated areas, giving you peace of mind.
VIEW YOUR PET'S LOCATION HISTORY
Discover your pet's daily adventures by exploring their location history. The timeline feature helps you understand your pet's movements and habits over time.
SHARE ACTIVITY & LOCATION
Easily share your pet’s activity and location updates with family members, dog walkers, or veterinarians. You can invite multiple caregivers to stay in the loop and ensure your pet’s well-being.
MONITOR ACTIVITY & SLEEP 24/7
Track every moment of your pet’s day, from activity levels to sleep quality. Monitor distance traveled, calories burned, and overall health. Set personalized health goals and compare your pet’s progress against breed, age, and weight peers.
LINK YOUR HEALTH TRACKER
Get active with your pet! Sync your Fitbit or Google Fit device to stay motivated. Join the FitBark leaderboard and engage in friendly competition with both human and furry friends.
MONITOR MOBILITY & PAIN
Work closely with your trainer or veterinarian to track changes in your pet's mobility. The FitBark Health Index can help detect early signs of discomfort, osteoarthritis, or other health issues.
MONITOR STRESS & ANXIETY
Check the Hourly View to see how your dog is doing when you're not around. Gain insights into your pet’s anxiety levels, whether they're home alone or under someone else's care.
MONITOR ITCHINESS & SKIN CONDITIONS
Use the nightly Sleep Score to track potential skin issues, such as dermatitis or flea allergies. Early detection can help manage and treat these conditions effectively.
TRUSTED BY EXPERTS
FitBark is used by dog parents and veterinarians in over 150 countries. Over 100 research institutions, including the University of Cambridge and the Mayo Clinic, trust FitBark for their studies.
FitBark is committed to keeping you and your pet safe, healthy, and connected. Reach out to us anytime at fitbark.com/contact

The citizens of Rivershire have been infected with a terrible disease that is slowly turning them into monsters. Because of your magical immunity, you are the only person that can go through mystery, adventure, fantasy and detective games, and heal the townsfolk and stop the infection from spreading across the entire kingdom! Gather eggs of mysterious creatures as you play new hidden object games mini-games and visit your hatchlings in the Medico Imperium Incubator!
Download one of the most amazing free hidden object games – Enchanted Kingdom: Fog of Rivershire! Play the game for absolutely free, but if you feel stuck or don’t want to solve a mini-game, you may buy hints to help you proceed quicker!

bluejetty:00021305:ios.name: Axxess Home Health
bluejetty:00021305:ios.summary: Axxess Home Health improves patient outcomes through built-in compliance features that incorporate clinical intelligence. Caregivers can save time and streamline mobile documentation with user-friendly notes and visit verification at the po
bluejetty:00021305:ios.description:
Axxess Home Health improves patient outcomes through built-in compliance features that incorporate clinical intelligence. Caregivers can save time and streamline mobile documentation with user-friendly notes and visit verification at the point of care.
Improve patient care communication and coordination with:
• Secure and real-time HIPAA-compliant messaging
• Simplified visit calendar and list views of past due, upcoming and completed visits
• Button to add new tasks and schedule patient visits (available to users with granted permissions)
• Comprehensive care plans and patient charts that include emergency and physician contacts, pharmacies, care team members, demographics, orders, medications, immunizations, notes, visit history and more
• Signature and voice recording capabilities with automated date, time and location captures for electronic visit verification (EVV)
• Electronic ID badge to verify the clinician’s identity when arriving at a patient’s home
Streamline documentation with:
• Discipline-specific assessments and notes that include all required fields for compliance with Medicare and organizational policies and procedures, with the ability to document everything from homebound status, medical equipment and supplies, emergency preparedness and travel mileage to vital signs, pain scales, labs and more
• Telehealth visit notes to monitor patients when in-person visits are not required
• Automated prompts, built-in narrative templates and an option to load previous notes (available to users with granted permissions) to save time entering patient data
• Real-time quality assurance validations to check for documentation errors and inconsistencies
• Ongoing access with or without an internet connection
Save time with:
• Single sign-on and security PIN to access visits for multiple organizations
• GPS mapping with turn-by-turn directions to patients’ homes
• Ability to upload photos and documents directly to patient charts
• Talk-to-text comment dictation to reduce typing time
• Quick access to help resources, training videos and tool tips to find immediate answers to questions
About Axxess
Axxess is the leading technology innovator for healthcare at home, focused on solving the most complex industry challenges. Trusted by more than 9,000 organizations that serve more than 3 million patients worldwide, Axxess offers a complete suite of easy-to-use software solutions that empower home health, home care, hospice, and palliative providers to make healthcare in the home human again.

bluejetty:00021544:ios.description:
Welcome to MyBluebird, your trusted mobility app for taxi booking, car rental, shuttle travel, airport transfer, and package delivery.
With MyBluebird, you can book Bluebird and Silverbird taxi rides, rent cars with Goldenbird, send packages with Bluebird Kirim, and enjoy intercity shuttle services with Cititrans, all in one app.
Discover Bluebird Prime, our newest elevated ride option featuring Toyota Innova Zenix and BYD E6 fleets for extra comfort and more space. Booking is also faster with Multi Select Fleet, allowing you to select multiple ride options at once and get matched with the nearest available driver more quickly.
Top Features
1. All-in-One Mobility Service
MyBluebird is your online taxi app for booking taxis, executive rides, car rentals, shuttle trips, airport transfers, and package delivery.
2. Faster Booking with Multi Select Fleet
Select multiple ride options at once and get matched with the nearest available driver more quickly.
3. Fixed Price
Know your fare upfront before booking, so your trip feels more transparent and worry-free.
4. EZPay Cashless Payment
No cash? Don’t worry! Hop in our taxi, and pay cashless even when you are already inside the taxi. Simply enter your taxi number in the MyBluebird app and pay digitally using your preferred payment method. 
5. Advance Booking
Schedule your ride ahead of time for airport trips, meetings, appointments, or other important plans.
6. Multiple Payment Options
Pay with cash, QRIS, credit card, eVoucher, Trip Voucher, GoPay, ShopeePay, LinkAja, DANA, i.saku, OVO, and other available payment methods.
7. Promos and Subscription
Enjoy promos, discounts, and subscription packages for more value on your rides.
8. EZPoint Loyalty Program
Earn EZPoint from your transactions and redeem them for rewards, promos, discounts, and exclusive offers.
Download MyBluebird today for safer, easier, and more convenient mobility with Bluebird Group.

bluejetty:00159152:ios.description:
Parkade reinvents how parking can work at private buildings, enabling parking to be managed through an app. 
Instead of property managers managing parking via spreadsheets or paper leases, Parkade digitizes a building’s parking operations and makes parking self-serve for tenants. Depending on what features your building choose to leverage Parkade for, tenants can use Parkade to: 
- Book short-term parking
- Book or manage long-term parking
- Open your building’s parking gate(s) 
- Report issues with your parking spot(s)
- Add or edit your vehicle records
- Book EV charging spots
- Book parking for a guest, giving them gate access and wayfinding tools
- Rent out or share your long-term parking spot with others
- Sublease a spot from someone else
Parkade brings your building’s parking into the 21st Century, making parking a snap for everyone! Note that it’s up to each building who gets Parkade access, as many buildings choose to limit access to tenants. At other buildings, Parkade can be used by the public to rent excess parking. 
Not sure if your building is right for Parkade, or are you a property manager/HR team member looking to set your building up with Parkade? Drop us a note at hello@parkade.com, and we'd be happy to chat!

bluejetty:00070724:ios.description:
Dive into the future of automobile manufacturing with Car Factory - AI Tycoon Sim! Are you prepared to revolutionize car production using cutting-edge robotic arms and AI automation?
Take charge of your own car factory and immerse yourself in the world of high-tech vehicle creation.
- Build, Automate, Dominate! -
Welcome to the world of Car Factory! As a visionary tycoon, you'll harness the power of AI and robotic precision to craft the most advanced vehicles on the market. From chassis to engines, experience the thrill of assembling each component using state-of-the-art robotic arms.
- Masterful Management -
Expand your factory, hire skilled engineers, and optimize your assembly lines for peak efficiency. As you progress, unlock new robotic technologies and boosters to accelerate production and skyrocket your profits. The future of car manufacturing is at your fingertips!
- Global Reach -
Maximize your car sales by strategically expanding your market reach. Open new outlets across the globe and hire talented sales agents to charm potential buyers. Utilize AI-driven strategies to attract a massive customer base and dominate the industry.
- Innovation Unleashed -
Experience the thrill of innovation as you unlock new car models with each level. From sleek electric cars to powerful SUVs, your factory will be a hotbed of cutting-edge automotive technology. Stay ahead of the curve and satisfy every customer's desire for innovation and style.
- Profit and Prestige -
Your ultimate goal: become the ultimate car manufacturing magnate. Strategize, optimize, and make shrewd decisions to rake in unprecedented profits. Rise through the ranks, secure your place as the industry leader, and bask in the glory of your automotive empire.
Get ready to transform the world of car manufacturing with the fusion of AI and automotive excellence. Download Car Factory - AI Tycoon Sim now and embark on a journey of innovation, strategy, and prosperity!

bluejetty:00040654:ios.description:
Small actions everyday create life changing behaviors. Our mental health tracker and self care journal helps you with goal setting and achieving personal growth! Remente acts as your life coach and provides a bunch of self help tools to achieve self improvement, healthy habits and well being.
Start now with developing healthy habits to improve your self control and live a healthy lifestyle with greater self love, more self help and less stress, anxiety and depression!
Daily Remente
A daily video session with a life coach explaining different concepts of self care and interactive guides for users to learn about and practice mental health and well being.
Goal Setting Guide
Create good life goals to achieve personal growth and development. Remente acts as your life coach and offers guides and tips for goal setting to form a sustainable lifestyle which results in self love and healthy habits. 
Day Planner
To learn self help and reach goals you need to plan. The day planner contains a smart and dynamic to do list which plans your day based on your life goals as well as long term goal actions and tasks for self improvement.
Mental Health Tracker
Tracking your life balance is important for your well being and self love and reducing stress and depression. The life assessment tool helps you determine where you should focus your personal development efforts to achieve self control, mindfulness and health.
Self Care Journal
Learn what makes you feel good with the Remente mood journal. By tracking your mood you will understand what consequences your habits have on your mental health. What habits increase your self care? Use the mood journal to find out! 
Insights
Integrate with Apple Health to see how your body and mind affect each other.
Expert Goal Plans
Remente has a library full of expertly crafted goal plans to coach your self improvement. They contain detailed plans, tips and information for how to succeed with common well being goals to achieve personal growth and a better lifestyle.
Courses & Articles
A curated collection of articles and exercises written by psychologists, business managers, life coaches and world champions in several fields. We cover a wide range of topics, e.g. sleep optimization, stress management, healthy habits, mindfulness and anxiety relief, self love or tips for better friendships, relationships, dating & sex.
We offer a premium subscription which contains extra features and content that will support your self improvement and personal growth even more. The purchase is handled by your iTunes account. The subscription can always be cancelled or changed by going to the iTunes settings and will be renewed 24 hours before it expires, identical to the one you last purchased. It is not possible to cancel an already purchased subscription.
Behind Remente are experts in the fields of psychology, coaching and mental training. With our mental health tracker and self care journal we've helped around 2.000.000 people so far with their goal setting and achieving anxiety relief, self control and well being. Allow us to improve your self help and personal growth and become a member of the Remente family.
Terms of Use:
https://www.remente.com/privacy-policy-terms-of-service/

bluejetty:00076636:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00076636:ios.description:
Just imagine a world with all historical legends.
King Arthur draws the Sword from the stone in the West, while Qing Shi Huang has unified China in the East. The eagles from the Mediterranean fly in the sky and the Viking horn from the North Sea resounds through Gaul. The battle without the limits of time and space is about to happen! The epic across time and space is about to begin! Come and write your own legend!
Game Features：
【Global Battles】
Forge alliances with players around the world to fight for territory. Come to enjoy global battles!
【Play to Win】
Era of Conquest offers a fair game environment. There are no purchasable resources or VIP privileges. Victory can only be won through troop restraint and skill choice. Players can collaborate with allies to use various tactics to occupy the Supreme Kingdom.
【Free Conscription】
Compared to traditional strategy games, Era of Conquest offers free, automatic conscription. What's more, when the conscription mobilization is turned on, the conscripting process will be accelerated. Players will not be bothered by the conscription that costs both time and resources any more.
【Open World Battlefield】
The simple game control empowers you to control troops to do whatever you want in the big scenes. The 120km * 120km vast map will give you a new experience in the multi-history world.
【Exciting Siege Battle】
Featuring quality graphics, the siege battle in Era of Conquest brings players a great sense of substitution. The new SRP technology supports the real 3D graphics and makes the game better rendered. Besides, the new DOTS technology empowers up to 6000 units to battle in the same screen, bringing unprecedented siege battle experience.
【Multi-History and Various Special Troops】
Hundreds of heroes and various special troops are at your service to help with your conquest. The secrets behind the original Treasure Map are waiting for your exploration. Sand table buff can be got in the time-limited Wonder competition.
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/EraofConquestEN
Discord: https://discord.gg/w35RuaRNxB
1.The following permissions are required during gameplay.
Even if you do not agree to optional permissions, you can still able to play the game. You can reset or revoke access permissions after allowing them.
2.Required Permissions
Storage (access to photos, media, and files): Used for installing the game and saving or loading data.
3.Optional Permissions
Camera: Used for profile avatars in-game & game community.
Notifications: Used for receiving information notifications and Ads notifications
Microphone: Used for recording microphone audio when saving videos.
4.How to Agree or Revoke Access Permission
- OS 6.0 or higher:
5.How to revoke by Permission Management: Settings > Select Personal Information > Select Access Permission Management > Select Related Access Permission > Select Applications > Select Agree or Revoke Access Permission
6.How to revoke by application: Settings > Applications > Select Applications > Select Permissions > Select Agree or Revoke Access Permission
- OS below 6.0: Access permissions cannot be revoked, please delete the application or update the OS.

bluejetty:00179815:ios.description:
Téléchargez gratuitement l'application franceinfo sur votre mobile et tablette pour suivre toute l’actualité et l’information en France et dans le monde. 
Retrouvez l'actualité essentielle en un coup d'œil, explorez les thématiques qui vous intéressent (politique, société, économie, sport, santé, faits-divers, culture, monde...) et naviguez dans nos univers web, radio et TV pour ne rien manquer des sujets qui font l'actu.
ALERTES ET NOTIFICATIONS SUR MESURE
Plutôt actualité économique et culturelle que sportive et scientifique ? Personnalisez vos notifications pour ne recevoir que l’actu qui vous intéresse.
DES INFORMATIONS PERSONNALISÉS
Accédez aux actualités que vous avez manquées dans 'Mon Info', votre espace personnalisé selon vos centres d'intérêt et vos régions préférées.
ACTUALITÉS EN TEMPS RÉEL ET L'INFO EN DIRECT
Avec franceinfo restez au cœur de l'information pour suivre toute l'actualité en direct. Accédez aux dernières news sous toutes ses formes : articles, live, vidéos, TV, Radio et JT.
• À la Une : accédez aux principales actualités du moment en France et dans le monde.
• Alertes info : recevez les alertes info en temps réel partout dans le monde pour ne rien manquer de l'actualité (Municipales 2026, guerre en Iran, crise climatique, présidentielle américaine...)
• Live : suivez l’info en continu toute la journée avec le live, réagissez et posez vos questions à nos journalistes qui vous répondent en direct.
• TV en direct : retrouvez la chaîne franceinfo en direct vidéo avec une information décryptée en continu, 7 jours sur 7, 24h sur 24.
• Radio en direct : écoutez la radio franceinfo, les journaux, interviews, débats et reportages, pour vous tenir au courant de toute l’actualité.
• À la Une : accédez aux principales actualités du moment en France et dans le monde.
L’INFO DÉCRYPTÉE ET ENRICHIE
Découvrez les sujets et news du moment, les faits-divers, les grands événements internationaux et les meilleurs contenus des rédactions pour mieux comprendre et décrypter les actualités françaises et internationales.
• Retrouvez nos reportages en vidéos verticales pour plus de confort et d’immersion.
• Grâce aux rubriques spécialisées (politique, société, économie, sport, santé, faits-divers, culture, monde, météo...), consultez l’actualité qui vous intéresse.
• Accédez facilement aux news, articles, dossiers, directs, replays, vidéos, infographies, diaporamas.
• Retrouvez aussi l'essentiel de l'actualité sportive en images et en vidéos, les derniers résultats et les prochains grands événements : Jeux Paralympiques d'hiver, Tournoi des Six Nations, Roland-Garros, Coupe du Monde de football, Tour de France et bien d'autres.
• Profitez aussi des nouveaux services gratuits : prévisions météo en direct et à 7 jours, les jeux en ligne avec le sudoku, les mots fléchés, le solitaire et bien d'autres à découvrir sur franceinfo.
EN REPLAY VIDÉO et AUDIO
Retrouvez l'info 24/24 et toutes vos émissions et reportages préférés en replay
• Retrouvez toutes les vidéos de la chaine d’actualité de franceinfo.
• Réécoutez tous les programmes et podcast de la radio franceinfo.
• Regardez le journal télévisé de France 2 et de France 3 partout dans le monde.
VOTRE AVIS NOUS INTÉRESSE
Vos retours nous sont précieux pour continuer à faire évoluer franceinfo ! Faites-nous part de vos remarques et suggestions sur ces nouveautés dans l’application via le menu « réglages > Contacts ».

bluejetty:00087226:ios.summary: The Depression Test is a powerful tool to evaluate depression and monitor treatment response.The test questions are based on Patient Healthcare Questionnaire-9 (PHQ-9), the most widely used and trusted questionnaire among mental health prof
bluejetty:00087226:ios.description:
The Depression Test is a powerful tool to evaluate depression and monitor treatment response.The test questions are based on Patient Healthcare Questionnaire-9 (PHQ-9), the most widely used and trusted questionnaire among mental health professionals. The test can be self-administered.
With Depression Test, you can:
- take the PHQ-9 test to screen for depression
- check the severity of your depression
- store the test results and monitor improvements over time
- keep a journal to track your mood
- educate yourself with short, informative articles on Depression
- feel better by using self-guided Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) to identify and reframe your negative thoughts 
- gain access to high quality depression resources 
The CBT exercises include A-B-C, Socratic Questions, Challenge Core Beliefs, and De-catastrophizing. The exercises will help you identify and challenge your cognitive distortions that lead to negative thoughts. 
Depression can be effectively treated. Don't wait until things get worse. Find out if you're depressed and then take action.
Disclaimer: This self-test should not be used as a replacement for professional treatment or guidance. You should consult a medical professional if you are concerned about your symptoms.

bluejetty:00061001:ios.description:
Cisco Jabber™ for iPhone and iPad is a collaboration application that provides presence, instant messaging (IM), voice, voice messaging, and video calling capabilities on Apple iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch. Escalate your Jabber calls into multi-party conferencing with Cisco WebEx® Meetings.
This application supports the following capabilities: 
• Integrated voice
• High-quality video with interoperability to Cisco video endpoints
• IM, presence
• Visual voicemail 
• One-tap escalation to WebEx meetings (cross-launches the Cisco WebEx® Meetings application) 
Device and Operating System Requirements:
The latest Cisco Jabber for iPhone and iPad Release is supported on iOS 18 and iPadOS 18.
iPhone models compatible with iOS18: https://support.apple.com/guide/iphone/iphone-models-compatible-with-ios-18-iphe3fa5df43/18.0/ios/18.0
iPad models compatible with iPadOS 18: https://support.apple.com/guide/ipad/ipad-models-compatible-with-ipados-18-ipad213a25b2/ipados
For more information about Cisco Jabber, visit: http://www.cisco.com/go/jabber

bluejetty:00027061:ios.summary:
The FOUNDATION FOR INNER PEACE, original publisher of "A Course in Miracles," has joined with CDE Solutions to bring you this app.

- Access to the Course's full "Workbook for Students,"
- BUILT-IN REMINDER ALERTS: The
bluejetty:00027061:ios.description:
The FOUNDATION FOR INNER PEACE, original publisher of "A Course in Miracles," has joined with CDE Solutions to bring you this app.
Features include:
- Access to the Course's full "Workbook for Students,"
- BUILT-IN REMINDER ALERTS: The alerts fully customizable and have also been conveniently preset with the specific text to be remembered for the day and the alert intervals suggested by the Course. 
- Journaling: The app will allow you to record your thoughts for each lesson in a journal. These journal entries will be saved to your device so that you can reflect on them throughout the year.
- Music: You have your choice of very beautiful high-frequency meditation music to play from within the app. This feature has been added to help you meditate and focus upon the lessons.
- Daily Reminder Text updates: You have the ability to edit the reminder text for the day. This is especially useful for lessons that ask you to fill in certain portions of the reminder text with your personal thoughts. 
- Random Button: Let’s say you are in a situation where you are needing some spiritual guidance. You can click the Random button and read the text for the lesson the gets randomly chosen as a way to get insight and guidance from the Holy Spirit.
- #/365 button: If you with your lessons to correspond exactly to the day of the year, simply click this button and that lesson will be selected.
- Reminder Setup Alerts: You have the option of having an additional alert go off ten minutes prior to your lesson start time that will remind you to select and setup your lesson for the day. This way you never miss a lesson.
You purchase the app ONLY ONCE.
About "A Course in Miracles":
The Course’s teachings are based on the practice of forgiveness as the key to inner peace and the remembrance of God. The "Workbook for Students", contained in this app, includes 365 lessons & reviews which are designed to train your mind in a systematic way to a different perception of everyone and everything in the world. This perception leads to inner tranquility and peace. As stated in the Introduction to the Workbook: “The exercises are very simple. They do not require a great deal of time, and it does not matter where you do them. They need no preparation.” You are asked only not to undertake to do more than one exercise a day. You might however choose to remain with a particularly appealing lesson for more than one day.

bluejetty:00065448:ios.description:
Fast, Easy and Safe Online payments - Myanmar's Leading Mobile Financial Service
WavePay, Mobile wallet application by WaveMoney enabling the inclusion of all users into the digital payment ecosystem, riding on the largest network of ~60,000 agents and 200,000+ merchants. WavePay is one stop solution for all your payment needs:
• Send money to your family and friends using mobile number, including to those who are not on WavePay APP
• Scan QR code and make instant payments at grocery stores, medical shops, electronic shops, restaurants etc.
• Top up or buy packs for your or your family and friends mobile.
• Pay your bills easily – Internet, Solar, Insurance, MFI loans etc.
• Link your bank or MPU cards and easily transfer funds in and out of the wallet easily.
Safe and Secure payments
• Protected with “One Wallet, One Device” (1W1D) feature that enables access of your account from only 1 device at any point of time, keeping your WavePay account safe & secure. 
• Set your PIN, which is a 4-digit number, It’s mandatory to set the PIN while creating your account and authorize all transactions using your PIN
• Additional security of a 6-digit secret code for money transfer to people who are not on WavePay app. Money can be easily collected at the nearest WaveMoney agent shop by providing a transaction ID and 6-digit secret code
Easy Cash-in and Cash-out services
• Easily Cash-in or Cash-out at your near Wave agent shops; more than 60,000 agents across the country are at your service all the time
• Link your bank accounts from our partner banks or any e-commerce enabled MPU cards for easily moving funds in and out of the wallet
Easy Airtime top up and bill payments.
• Top up or buy packs for your mobile and always stay connected with your loved ones. You can top up to any operator mobile number – ATOM, MPT, Ooredoo
• Make your internet bill payments across 30+ providers including ATOM, Ooredoo, Myanmar Net, 5BB, Fortune, Mahar Net, WeLink, Myanmar APN etc.
• Make your loan repayments across 40+ partners including – Aeon, Rent2Own, Early Dawn, Yoma Bank, Mahar Bawga,, Advans, Alliance, VisionFund etc.
• Make your Insurance payments of Prudential, Manulife, Capital Taiyo, Young Insurance, KBZ MS General Insurance etc
• Make your Solar bill payments of OV Solar, Solar Home, Sun King Solar
• Make your healthcare and telehealth service payments of PunHlaing Hospitals, MyanCare, myDoctor, Health4U, T-Fitness etc. 
Fast and reliable payments at Online stores
• Make your online shopping payments at Shop.com.mm, OwayFresh and many other trusted partners instantly using WavePay and avoid worries about cash on delivery. 
• Order your favorite food or groceries on FoodPanda and pay using the WavePay app
Book Hotels & Tickets for Bus, Flights
• Domestic or international; One-way or Round trip – Book your flight tickets on FlyMya, AirKBZ etc and make payments with your WavePay wallet.
• Book online bus tickets - MMBus Ticket, Oway, AungSan, AungMinGalar, Mandalay Gate. Check seat availability & get real-time updates.
• Book hotels before you travel – Memories Hotel, Memories Travel, Balloons Over Myanmar, etc. 
• Make hassle-free payments for your groceries, medicines, electronics and clothing purchases by scanning Wave QR at 200,000+ merchants. 
Contact Us
• WaveMoney Call Centre is available every day 8 AM-10 PM to provide any assistance. Call 900 from ATOM Numbers (free) or 097900090000 for other operator numbers
To become a business partner, agent? E-mail us at business@wavemoney.com.mm or call our call-center

Gunspell 2 is a popular RPG puzzle game with magic, guns, and Match-3 multiplayer. Prove yourself worthy in Match-3 duels using gems and jewels! Visit mysterious worlds full of magic & puzzles.
 KEY FEATURES: 
• Explore different worlds in story adventures and enjoy multiple quests. 
• Collect unique heroes, powerful items, dark magic and guns.
• Fight the first real-time online Match-3 battles. Climb ranks by winning in multiplayer.
• Uncover mysterious events & solve puzzles of ancient mages.
• Play puzzles with demons and dragons to accomplish your quests.
• Challenge – your skill to find and use powerful combinations of gems & jewels.
 GAMEPLAY:
• It is a unique RPG puzzle game, where you play turn-based Match-3 duel on the nice hexagonal board filled with skulls, gems & jewels. 
• Jewels store powerful magic and skulls can be used to damage directly.
• Charge your items by matching jewels of the same color & use magic for your advantage. 
• Every jewel holds one mana and there are multiple powerful combinations that may produce additional effects, like cross, angle or 4 in a row. 
 MULTIPLAYER:
• Fight in real time turn-based battles to progress in ranks & acquire grand rewards. 
 QUESTS & ADVENTURES:
• This time story tells not only about Gunspell adventures, but also about other cool heroes and their quests in another worlds. Collect them all and play their stories!
• We work on the new missions and heroes all the time and continue to add new story adventure every couple of weeks! 
 COLLECT & PROGRESS:
• As a good RPG puzzle game, Gunspell 2 provides endless possibilities to collect unique heroes, items and magic and combine them into powerful combinations.
 INSTALL:
• Enjoy multiple hours of Match-3 puzzles full of magic!
• Connect with the community at https://www.facebook.com/gunspell

bluejetty:00168755:ios.name: Amikin Village: Magic Sim RPG
bluejetty:00168755:ios.summary: Dive into a world of discovery and magic in 'Amikin Village,' a blend of strategy, survival, and RPG adventures. Hunt, craft, and battle alongside cute monsters in your quest to become a champion. Build and evolve in an open-world game fill
bluejetty:00168755:ios.description:
Dive into a world of discovery and magic in 'Amikin Village,' a blend of strategy, survival, and RPG adventures. Hunt, craft, and battle alongside cute monsters in your quest to become a champion. Build and evolve in an open-world game filled with stories, quests, and memes. Start your survivor's journey today!
● Amikin Allies: Collect 'Em All! ●
Adventure into the wilderness on a hunt for Amikins, mystical creatures with unmatched powers and endearing personalities. These faithful companions are essential to your survival and success, offering a blend of fun, strategy, and unexpected friendships that add color to your quest. Assemble your unique team and prepare for a journey filled with adventure games excitement and anime charm.
● Home Base Haven: Automate with Magic! ●
Transform your base from a mere shelter into a magical command center where your Amikins take charge. Their unique abilities simplify building and automating tasks, infusing daily life with a touch of magic and the ingenuity of building games. Witness your base evolve into a lively hub, all thanks to the innovative spirit of your Amikin allies.
● Power-Up Parade: Merge & Breed! ●
Tap into the evolution and growth of your Amikins by merging similar kinds to bolster their abilities, and breeding them to inherit top-tier traits. This strategic enhancement ensures your squad is battle-ready, elevating every Amikin to champion status. Engage in this rewarding process, drawing inspiration from the best RPG games.
● Epic Explorations: Fantasy Meets Sci-Fi! ●
Set off on a grand exploration across 'Amikin Village's expansive world, where secrets await and a unique blend of fantasy and sci-fi thrives. Arriving from another realm, you introduce a mix of technology and magic into this land, creating gameplay rich with discovery akin to the most immersive open-world games and adventure games.
● Meme Magic: Laughter Guaranteed! ●
'Amikin Village' blends the cuteness and whimsy of anime with the strategic depth of RPG games, all while packing a punch of humor with its meme magic. Revel in light-hearted adventures and chuckles over nods to popular culture, making your journey one filled with laughter and joy.
Are You Ready for an Unforgettable Adventure?
From the developers of "Westland Survival"'Amikin Village' calls to you, marrying the excitement of anime games, the depth of strategy games, and the charm of building games in a magical setting. Build your base, expand your Amikin team, and explore a realm brimming with daily discoveries. Download now and commence your legendary journey filled with magic, challenges, and the warmth of companionship. Your saga in the world of 'Amikin Village' starts today!
From the developers of "Westland Survival"

bluejetty:00089083:ios.description:
The lanterns that light up the streets and the Japanese umbrellas that color the roads.
Solve riddles and tricks to escape the old Japanese capital, Kyoto.
【Features】
・Adorable characters enjoyable for children of young ages.
・Easy to start for first players. Let’s challenge!
・There are Hints, so Don’t worry!
・Auto-save function!
・No need for paper and pen! Swipe left from the right edge of the screen to take notes!
【How to play】
Very easy operation method!
・Search by tapping the screen.
・Change the viewpoint by tapping the button on the bottom of the screen.
・Double tap the item button, it will enlarged.
・Use an item by dragging it.
・While one item is displayed, select another item by either tapping or dragging it to combine them.
・There is a hint button from MENU which is the upper left corner of the screen.
【Jammsworks】
programmer：Asahi Hirata
Designer：Naruma Saito
Produced by two of us.
Our goal is to produce a game that would be fun for the users.
If you like this game, please play other games!
【Provide】
Music is VFR：http://musicisvfr.com
Pocket Sound : http://pocket-se.info/
icons8：https://icons8.com/

bluejetty:00000549:ios.description:
Ready to play spot the difference? Grab your magnifying glass and get ready to hunt differences in a challenging, fun, and free puzzle game!
Your goal is simple: look at the pictures, find the differences, then tap each one you locate. Every level will present you with two beautiful photos that look almost the same. There are several small differences between them, however. It's your job to spot them as quickly as you can. It's easy to play casually, but tough to master!
Spot the difference games, often called an I-spy game, mystery search game, guessing games, or a hidden item finding game, are perfect for testing your difference-spotting and puzzle solving skills. They're easy to use on your touch screen device, making them perfect for casual and master players alike. All you have to do is tap and you're exercising your brain!
Compare different pictures across multiple modes, including solo spotting games as well as multiplayer photo hunts!
• Classic Mode: Find the differences between two pictures in this familiar yet fun mode. Change difficulty levels if you want a bigger challenge!
• Bonus Mode: A special clue-finding game where you can earn coins as bonuses for finding differences in the images.
• Night Mode: Use a special dark mode feature that changes image color themes. Use a flashlight/torch to highlight areas and spot the differences!
• Speed Mode: Find the hidden differences before the timer runs out. Hurry, the clock is ticking!
• Computer Mode: Think you can beat a powerful AI designed to find differences? Take on the computer in this challenging mode to see how good you are!
• Multiplayer Mode: Play online with friends with real-time one-on-one PvP puzzle solving battles. It's intense!
In addition to these fast, free, and fun picture spotting modes, you'll also find the following amazing extras:
- Over 5000 levels with thousands of differences to find
- Six different game modes to play
- A huge variety of gorgeous images, including HD pictures
- Hints to help you when you get stuck
- Online multiplayer with real-time puzzle solving
- Customize theme colors, look, and feel
- Zoom in to find even more differences
- Achievements and bonuses to unlock
Find the differences game is a great way to relax after a long day. You can also solve what's the difference puzzles as a way to train your brain or challenge yourself! With so many modes to enjoy, along with hundreds of picture pairs and daily free gifts, you'll never run out of fun thinking puzzles to enjoy.
Tons of find the differences levels are waiting for you! Download the free game today to enjoy all the single player and multiplayer levels, earn rewards for playing each day, and unlock fun extras as you solve casual and challenging find the difference puzzles!

bluejetty:00119413:ios.description:
Nordea ID app provides an easy and secure way to authenticate your identity.
With the app you can do your banking regardless of time and place. Begin by installing the app on your mobile device and go through the activation process. You shouldn’t rely on just one copy of the Nordea ID app. If your phone or tablet breaks down or gets lost, you will also lose the Nordea ID app and you will need to go through the activation process again. To avoid this, we recommend that you install the Nordea ID app on more than one mobile device.
With the Nordea ID app you can:
- log in to Nordea services and confirm actions
- confirm online payments in a secure way
- as a personal customer identify yourself in other service providers’ services (only in Finland and Norway)
- identify yourself when calling Nordea Customer Service. (only in Finland and Norway)
The app can’t be used on rooted mobile devices for security reasons.
Read more:
Finland: nordea.fi/IDapp
Norway: nordea.no/NordeaID
Denmark: nordea.dk/NordeaID

bluejetty:00200056:ios.description:
FAAwait provides real-time access to current air traffic delays at all U.S. airports. It utilizes a data feed maintained by the FAA that tracks departure and arrival delays, ground stops, and ground delays. To access this information, an active internet connection (WiFi or cellular) is required.
FAAwait does NOT provide status information for specific flights. But by monitoring airport traffic conditions, you can often anticipate delays that may impact your travel, sometimes before the airlines themselves officially update their schedules.
For more information on FAAwait, refer to the links below.
Note: This application is not provided or endorsed by the FAA.

bluejetty:00182438:ios.description:
Castle, the largest community of survivors, has fallen. 
Once a beacon of hope in the post-apocalypse, it now shares the same fate as the rest. Amidst the chaos, a small group of survivors managed to escape into the barren wilderness. 
You are the Commander of these survivors. While escaping the zombie horde that utterly destroyed your last sanctuary, you come across a strange building jutting out from the ground. Low on supplies and left with little options, you decide to take refuge in this building. So begins your campaign of survival in this zombie-infested world. 
【BUILD & CUSTOMIZE YOUR SHELTER】
Expand your shelter with numerous facilities such as the Satellite Nexus, Power Generators, the Mission Control, etc. Design the shelter’s layout whichever way you like! 
【HEROES AND SURVIVORS】 
Every hero and survivor possesses special life skills that helped them survive in the apocalypse. From chefs, doctors, and engineers to scientists, miners, and soldiers, it’s up to you to effectively utilize their skills! 
【TEAM COMPOSITION AND SYNERGY】 
Assemble a diverse team of heroes, each with their unique personalities and abilities. Formulate your favorite team combination to help you conquer even the most daunting of situations. 
【VENTURE INTO THE WILD】 
Journey outside the shelter and scavenge for valuable resources in the wastelands. 
Set up camps to act as forward operating bases and resource points. But be on guard! Zombies could attack at any moment! 
【ESTABLISH ALLIANCES WITH FRIENDS】 
Fighting alone is hard, so why not fight alongside friends? Join or create an Alliance and exterminate those pesky zombies with allies! Assist allies by accelerating each other’s constructions and tech researches. 
It’s a win-win situation either way! It's all or nothing now! Go forth, Commander, and embark on your adventure!

bluejetty:00062845:ios.name: Wikipedia
bluejetty:00062845:ios.summary: The official Wikipedia app for iOS helps you explore the world’s largest free knowledge project — ad-free and free of charge, forever. With 60+ million articles in nearly 300 languages, your favorite encyclopedia is always at your fingertip
bluejetty:00062845:ios.description:
The official Wikipedia app for iOS helps you explore the world’s largest free knowledge project — ad-free and free of charge, forever. With 60+ million articles in nearly 300 languages, your favorite encyclopedia is always at your fingertips.
Why you’ll love this app
Free, open, and ad-free
Wikipedia is written and verified by volunteers worldwide, supported by the nonprofit Wikimedia Foundation. No ads, no tracking — just knowledge you can trust.
Search smarter, discover more
Find the information you need without distraction. Search across 300 languages, explore trending and breaking news through a personalized feed.
Add knowledge to your Home Screen
Use widgets for quick access to trending articles, featured content, or the “Picture of the Day,” right from your Home Screen.
Read your way
Choose from light, sepia, dark, or pure black themes. Adjust text size and image dimming for comfortable reading anytime, anywhere.
Explore nearby places
Learn about landmarks and locations near you — or places you dream of visiting — through map-based article discovery.
Stay connected offline
Save articles to custom reading lists and access them offline — perfect for travel or learning without internet access.
Share and continue seamlessly
Share articles and images with friends, or use Handoff to keep reading across your Apple devices.
Get insights into your activity
See your own reading and contribution activity on Wikipedia with personalized insights that help you understand and celebrate how you use engage with Wikipedia.
Stay organized with tabs
Open multiple articles in tabs and switch between them with ease, just like in a browser. Compare topics, keep your place, and dive deeper without losing track.
Join the conversation
Read and reply to article discussion pages, and get notifications when discussions you follow are updated.
Contribute on the go
Manage your Watchlist to help keep Wikipedia accurate and up to date.
Additional Information
Feedback: In the app, go to Settings → Send app feedback.
Contribute to translations: https://translatewiki.net/wiki/Translating:WikimediaMobile
Source code: https://github.com/wikimedia/apps-ios-wikipedia
Privacy Policy: https://m.wikimediafoundation.org/wiki/Privacy_policy
Terms of Use: https://m.wikimediafoundation.org/wiki/Terms_of_Use
About the Wikimedia Foundation: https://wikimediafoundation.org/

bluejetty:00131733:ios.description:
The Jazzercise On Demand app will put joy back into your workout so you get the full-body results you desire. From exercise pros to workout newbies, JOD is designed for women (and men!) of all shapes, sizes and fitness levels to get fit anytime, anywhere. Join today for an instant mood boost + TRY FREE (cancel any time).
At home, outside, or on vacay, this workout app goes everywhere you do.
Busy mom? Choose from 10-, 20-, 30-, 40- and 50-minute classes so you can get a quick workout...on your schedule.
Not a dancer? Not a problem. JOD is suitable for all ages and fitness levels and combines dance with HIIT, Pilates, floor barre, kickboxing, yoga and strength training for sweaty, feel-good workouts every time.
Got weight loss goals? Burn up to 600 calories in 40 minutes + join a supportive community that will cheer you on along the way. Plus, each high-energy, FitPro-led class is set to pop music so you won’t even notice the burn...just the results.
WITH MORE THAN 200+ WORKOUTS, THE HUGE VARIETY OF CLASSES WILL HAVE YOU SWEATING, SMILING AND FEELING THE RESULTS QUICK WITH:
- Effective workouts designed to tone, lengthen and strengthen for that dancer’s body
- Strength training for long, lean dancer muscles
- Core-focused movements for toned abs
- High-Intensity Interval Training (HIIT) to kick your metabolism into high gear for maximum EPOC (Excessive Post-Oxygen Consumption
- Warm-ups and cool-downs for a healthier, more-rounded workout
- Dance Sculpt classes that use floor barre techniques to improve stability and mobility
- Restorative recovery stretch segments
- Low-to-no impact formats and modifications shown throughout each class
- Plus challenges, healthy recipes, weekly workout plans, a one-of-a-kind online community + MORE!
Your FitPro team are certified fitness experts who host the most fun dance parties ever. They’ll motivate and coach you through upper and lower-body workouts, core routines and full-body classes. Plus, all moves are medically reviewed to ensure they’re safe and effective.
Jazzercise On Demand XXX a Fitness Tracker for Apple Watch:
▷Monitor Stats during Workouts: View heart rate/calories burned on your watch & video player.
▷HEALTH App: Apple Watch integrates with Apple's Health app (Healthkit) to track workouts, duration, calories burned, heart rate, and active energy. You choose the data you want stored, and you can change it anytime in the Health app.
▷FITNESS App: Apple Watch integrates with Apple's Fitness App, and workouts contribute to your daily goals. View stats and share your activity.
▷Use your Watch as a Remote: Play, stop, & rewind videos without interrupting workouts.
-Already a Member? Sign-In to access your subscription.
-New? Try it for free! Subscribe in the app to get instant access. 
Jazzercise On Demand offers an auto-renewing Monthly or Yearly Subscription with a Free Trial. You'll receive unlimited access to content on all your devices. Payment is charged to your Apple ID Account at confirmation of purchase. Pricing varies by location and is confirmed prior to purchase. After the free trial, subscription automatically renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the trial period. Subscription automatically renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period. Cancel anytime in Account Settings. 
For more information see our: 
○ Terms of Service: https://www.jazzercise.com/terms-of-service
○ Privacy Policy: https://www.jazzercise.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00157139:ios.description:
The easiest, most affordable way to get car insurance from your phone. We cover your down payment interest-free—so you get auto insurance coverage today with flexible payments that fit your life.
OCHO uses powerful technology to make cheap car insurance a reality. Our smart app finds you the best quotes in minutes, covers your down payment, and sets you up with a payment plan designed around your payday. Plus, you can manage everything right from your phone: no paperwork, no long phone calls, no stress. Experience the power of smarter insurance. Download the OCHO app today.
WHY CHOOSE OCHO? 
- 0 Down Options: Some customers qualify for no-deposit coverage, everyone else gets a much lower down payment.
- Drive Now, Pay Over Time: We give you a custom flexible payment plan.
- More Time to Pay – Need extra days? No problem! Plus no late fees, ever.
- Instant Proof of Insurance – Get covered the same day.
- OCHO PriceCheck: Our unique tool checks your final price for you, to make sure you’re getting our cheapest quote. 58% of our customers save $600!
- Boost Your Credit – On-time payments can help build your credit score.*
WHAT OUR CUSTOMERS HAVE TO SAY:
“Totally legit and you don’t have to put any money down and they give your proof of insurance the same day.” Gloria K., Springfield, IL 
“They were really great and got me back on the road for 0 down. I would definitely recommend OCHO to anyone.” Thor Seth
“Love it. Helped with the down payment. Which is always too much to put down for car insurance. As a single mom I did not have to worry between down payment for car insurance and groceries for my children.” Addierene H., Gainesville, GA
HOW DOES OCHO WORK?
Say goodbye to big down payments and car insurance cancellations! We help finance your auto insurance at no extra cost, so you deal with us—not the insurance company. Enjoy lower or no down payments, flexible split payments, and choose your payment dates. Plus, we offer extra time to pay when needed, so you can stay insured. Break the cycle and pay with OCHO today! We make insurance shopping stress-free. 
WE CURRENTLY OPERATE IN: Arizona, Texas, Illinois, Georgia, Missouri, New Mexico, Washington State, Wisconsin. 
ABOUT US
Launched in 2021, OCHO’s mission is to revolutionize car insurance for hardworking people across the USA. Built by immigrants to help you beat the system, we offer more than just coverage—our policies are a pathway to financial resilience, giving you the breathing room you deserve.
APP FEATURES YOU’LL LOVE:
Find and compare auto insurance in minutes with our easy to use platform.
Get your credit score for free.
Select payments dates that fit in with your payday. 
Download your policy documents instantly.
Request a payment extension if you need more days to pay. 
Manage your payments and policy from your dashboard.
CURRENT INSURANCE COMPANIES WE WORK WITH: Progressive, Dairyland, Gainsco, National General, First Acceptance, Founders, Falcon, Aspire, Kemper Auto, Embark, Infinity, The General, Excepsure, Assurance America, Bridger, Bristol West, Unique Insurance Company, Clearcover. 
Looking for an app like Hugo Insurance? At OCHO, we do things differently. Hugo insurance offers pay-as-you-go insurance, which can leave you with risky gaps in coverage that may lead to you not having coverage and more expensive rates. With OCHO, you get continuous coverage and flexible payment plans—keeping you protected without the worry.
We are NOT a payday loan service, cash loan, personal loan app, or a platform for borrowing money. We don’t use telematics. 
Companies we are not affiliated with: The Lemonade, The Zebra, Root Insurance, Freeway Insurance, Direct Auto, Elephant Insurance, OTTO Insurance, All State, Safe Auto, Esurance, Nationwide, Gainsco Insurance, Geico Insurance, Go Auto Insurance, Liberty Mutual, AAA Insurance, USAA Insurance, State Farm, Fred Loya Insurance. 
Learn more at www.ocho.co

bluejetty:00119795:ios.description:
2nd Line offers you a second phone number without the need to swap SIM cards or carry another phone. The numbers provided by this app are real US, Canada, and Finland phone numbers. With this new number, you can call and text just like with your primary number, and you can receive calls and messages without keeping the app open.
The Best 2nd Phone Number App on the Store:
- Looking for a new phone line for calling & texting to any number in US, Canada, or globally?
- Need to protect your privacy and are looking for your own second phone number?
- Want a second or local phone number for dating & side projects?
- Want to call & text to your international friends & relatives at a very low and affordable cost?
--> Yes, 2nd Line provides a reliable all-in-one solution for new phone lines, privacy protection, second numbers for various purposes, and affordable international calling and texting.
Why choose 2nd Line?
- Trusted by millions of users, 2nd Line is the market-leading provider of private virtual phone numbers in the US, Canada, and Finland.
- Separate Number for Business or Work: Use a 2nd Line number for work to keep your personal and professional life separate. Avoid interruptions during your personal time or vacations.
- International Number for Overseas Business: Enjoy cheaper international calls with clear voice quality. Others can easily contact you with a real number.
2nd Line is designed for freelancers, businesspeople, entrepreneurs, and anyone in need of a second phone number. Use 2nd Line instead of your real number for dating, work, online shopping, or selling items.
What other awesome features does the 2nd Line app offer?
- Enjoy voicemail service.
- Record calls without limits.
- Block contacts or numbers and enable anonymous calling.
- Set up auto-replies for calls and texts.
- Multiple Phone Numbers: Choose as many custom phone numbers as you want to protect your privacy.
- Call & text any foreign number at the best rate.
- Transform your iPad or iPod into a real phone.
- Engage in text and chat with pictures, voice messages, and a wide range of emojis and GIFs!
Contact Us:
If you have any questions or feedback, please contact us using the Support feature in our app or email us at support@2ndlyne.com.
Subscription Plan:
2nd Line offers a subscription plan for premium numbers. Your subscription will automatically renew unless you turn off auto-renewal at least 24 hours before the current subscription ends. The subscription price varies depending on the period you choose, ranging from $5.99 per week to $69.99 per year. You can manage your subscription and auto-renewal settings in your account settings. 
Privacy Policy: https://2ndlyne.com/privacy-policy.html
Terms of Use: https://2ndlyne.com/terms-of-use.html
EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
*Important:
- Unlimited calls and texts are subject to fair usage. Please refer to our terms of use for more details.
- If Push notification is not enabled, you may not receive messages and calls

bluejetty:00177791:ios.description:
Trouble has come to Bikini Bottom! The evil "mastermind" Sheldon J. Plankton has once again hatched a plan to steal the secret Krabby Patty formula. This time he has enlisted his army of cousins to capture all of SpongeBob's friends! Play as SpongeBob on his epic, most side-scrolly quest through Bikini Bottom ever! Explore, collect coins and spatulas, and crush obstacles as SpongeBob races to rescue his friends, defeat Plankton's minions and take back the formula. Keep an eye out for your favorite Bikini Bottom residents...you never know who you might run into!
DIVE IN TO EXPLORE
-Immerse yourself in SpongeBob's universe in the craziest platform running game yet!
-Explore your favorite locations from Bikini Bottom to Glove World to the Chum Bucket
-Jump on trampolines, avoid the stinging jellyfish and zoom down zip lines in your epic adventure
RESCUE AND UNLOCK FRIENDS
-Unlock trapped allies to join on your epic underwater quest
-Journey together to collect coins, spatulas, and complete all the levels
-Interact with tons of familiar faces including Patrick, Sandy, Squidward and Plankton!
-Featuring the iconic voice cast of SpongeBob SquarePants! 
SHAPESHIFT AND CRACK PUZZLES
-Transformation machines morph SpongeBob into a variety of silly forms
-Unlock new abilities with each transformation and defeat countless obstacles
-Find puzzles and unveil secrets in every level!
DEFEAT THE BADDIES
-From Plankton to Jellyfish King, face the most dangerous villains known to man or sea creature in challenging boss fights 
-Outwit bosses and use their own weapons against them...all in the effort to take back the Krabby Patty formula!

bluejetty:00175354:ios.description:
Want a quick, easy, and affordable grocery shopping experience? Order ALDI from anywhere with the new and improved ALDI app. Find your local store, select pickup or delivery, fill your cart and just like that, groceries are just a click away. Download the app, sign in or create your account and get started today.
Features of the ALDI App:
 • Order Grocery Pickup & Grocery Delivery – Choose how you shop with either curbside pickup at your local ALDI or delivery to your home.
 • Weekly Ads – Check out this week’s weekly ad, including ALDI Savers and ALDI Finds, while also previewing next week’s Weekly Ads.
 • ALDI Finds – Discover limited-time only products at incredible prices.
 • Store Locator – Find your local ALDI, get directions, opening hours, services, and contact information.
 • Shopping List Tool – If you’d like to shop in store, save products to your virtual shopping list and use it as you navigate your local ALDI.
 • View Past Orders – Re-order a past grocery haul with a single tap or look at past orders and find the products you’ve already purchased.
 • Always Low Prices – Shop with confidence that you’ll be buying high-quality groceries at an affordable, always low price.
Start by downloading the ALDI App and connect it with your ALDI account. You can create one in the app or online. Save money on groceries from home or on the go with the ALDI App today!
About ALDI
At ALDI, we hand-select and curate high-quality products for you and your family. We can’t promise you’ll find ten choices of the same item, but we can promise you’ll find the best ones at the best price. At our core, we’re a grocery store offering low prices on high quality food, home goods, and other household items. We’re also a fun place to discover new items and explore healthy options.
ALDI Groceries
We offer groceries to fit everyone’s specific dietary interests, needs or concerns. From organic certified gluten-free products and our meat products that contain no antibiotics, added hormones or animal byproducts, we can fit everyone’s lifestyle.

bluejetty:00016315:ios.description:
DRAGON BALL Z DOKKAN BATTLE is the one of the best DRAGON BALL mobile game experiences available. This DB anime action puzzle game features beautiful 2D illustrated visuals and animations set in a DRAGON BALL world where the timeline has been thrown into chaos, where DB characters from the past and present come face to face in new and exciting battles! Experience the new story and save the world of DRAGON BALL!
DRAGON BALL Z DOKKAN BATTLE features a super refreshing and simplistic approach to the anime action genre! The epic anime-like battles feature simple yet addictive gameplay. Link Ki spheres during battle to attack your foes! Take your time and play at your own pace, it’s the perfect DB game to play on the go wherever you are! When you are ready and powered up, finish your enemies with powerful Super Attacks such as Super Saiyan Goku’s Kamehameha and many more to send enemies flying!
All of your favorite characters are here from all your favorite DRAGON BALL anime series! From DBZ to DBS, everyone’s favorite Saiyan, Goku and his friends are ready to battle Frieza, Cell, Beerus, Jiren, and more! Summon your favorite DB characters and create the ultimate dream team(s)! Train and Awaken DB characters to power them up!
Help return order to the DRAGON BALL timeline through Quest mode. Experience reimagined popular anime stories with DB characters new and old. Play in Dokkan Events and the World Tournament and face off against tough enemies! And for true hardened fighters, the challenges of Extreme Z-Battle and Super Battle Road await!
SIMPLE ADDICTING GAMEPLAY
• Featuring a new take on the action puzzle game genre
• Tap and link Ki Spheres to attack and enter Dokkan Mode to finish foes!!
• Play at your own pace, planning your battle strategy is key
FINISH FOES WITH SUPER ATTACKS
• Collect enough Ki Spheres to activate Super Attacks just like the anime
• From Goku’s Iconic Kamehameha attack to Vegeta’s Final Flash, all your favorites are here
• Experience them all in epic 2D illustrations and animations
YOUR FAVORITE DRAGON BALL CHARACTERS ARE HERE
• From DBZ to DBS, many popular DB characters are available
• Summon new and classic favorites such as Super - Saiyan God SS Goku, Vegeta, Krillin or rivals such as Frieza, Cell, Beerus, and Jiren plus more from the popular anime series
FORM YOUR TEAM OF POWERFUL WARRIORS
• Organize your DRAGON BALL team and create the strongest fighting force!
• Train your favorite DB characters and Awaken them to new realms of power!
A NEW DRAGON BALL STORY
• Bring order to the DRAGON BALL timeline
• Play the board game-style map and all-new story with your favorite Dragon Ball characters!
• Experience reimagined stories with DB characters new and old
Are you ready to go even further beyond? Download one of the best DRAGON BALL experiences available with DRAGON BALL Z DOKKAN BATTLE today for free!

bluejetty:00128638:ios.description:
1. Take control of your family's digital life with Family ScreenTime Manager. This easy-to-use app empowers you to monitor and manage screen time for each family member, ensuring a balanced, healthy relationship with technology. With robust family controls, you can safeguard privacy, set limits, and promote productive screen time while keeping your loved ones safe online.
Features:
Personalized Screen Time Limits: Set screen time limits for individual family members to encourage a balanced tech lifestyle.
Privacy Protection: Safeguard your family’s personal data by controlling access to apps, preventing unauthorized content, and setting privacy settings.
Give your family the tools they need for healthier digital habits while maintaining control over privacy. Family ScreenTime Manager ensures your family stays safe, balanced, and in control in an increasingly digital world.

2. Keep your memories safe and secure with PhotoVault, the ultimate app to protect your photos and videos in a private, encrypted vault. With PhotoVault, you can easily store, access, and manage your media files, ensuring your personal moments are kept safe from prying eyes.
Features:
Encrypted Vault: Store your photos and videos with encryption for maximum security. Only you can access your private media.
Easy Access: Quickly upload, organize, and view your files with an intuitive, user-friendly interface.
App Lock: Secure the vault with a PIN to ensure that only you can access your media.
Cloud Backup: Automatically back up your media to the cloud, so even if you lose your device, your files are safe and recoverable.
Hidden Media: Keep your sensitive photos or videos out of sight with hidden vaults, ensuring complete privacy.
No File Size Limits: Store as many high-quality photos and videos as you want without worrying about space limitations.
Keep your cherished memories safe and private with PhotoVault. Whether it’s personal photos, confidential videos, or important documents, you can rest easy knowing your files are securely stored.
3. More Features:
Confidential Contacts – Keep your private contacts secure.
Private Chat – Enjoy encrypted messaging for confidential conversations.
Secure Notes – Store important notes with added protection.
Card Storage – Keep essential card details organized and safe.
Account Manager – Safeguard and manage login credentials securely.

bluejetty:00082400:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00082400:ios.description:
Track your Indoor & Outdoor rides. 
Use any BLUETOOTH heart rate monitor or connect your APPLE WATCH for real-time feedback. 
Outdoor rides can track distance and routes. 
Indoor Cycling Watch Companion will give you killer insight into how hard your body is working during each exercise. 
Set and achieve your daily point goal to maximize your training and calorie burn. 
Use this app to track your indoor cycling classes such as Peloton, ClassPass, Flywheel, iFit, Apptiv, etc. You can also bring this into any studio workout such as SoulCycle, Equinox, 24 Hour Fitness, Planet Fitness, Crunch Fitness, LA Fitness, and more! 
Achieve your daily point goal to maximize your training and calorie burn. Seeing your zones in real-time on your Apple Watch provides great mid-workout motivation.
Each zone is associated with a unique color - there are 5 zones in total. Zone thresholds have been personalized to indoor cycling workouts. 
Tracking your indoor cycling workouts is super easy with our Watch Companion. Just click start and go! 
“Feel the buzz” - every time you earn a point, the watch will buzz with haptic feedback to let you know so you can just focus on your workout! 
Whether you are looking to improve fitness, get stronger, or burn more calories through zone training, the Workout Companion can help you achieve your goals!
FEATURES
- Support for connecting any Bluetooth heart rate monitor or using your Apple Watch
- Start & stop workouts on your iPhone or Apple Watch
- Monitor real-time heart rate intensity and other workout stats on your iPhone and Apple Watch
- See your points score as your work out and get a workout score after each workout
- Show your time spent in each heart rate zone
- Receive a summary email of stats after every workout
Whether you're cycling at home, cycling while listening to the radio or your favorite playlist, cycling at a studio or class, or even cycling in a live stream... this app is the #1 Watch Companion out there and can be used alongside any training program out there.
EMAIL SUMMARIES 
Users can opt-in to receive an (optional) email summary of every workout showing details stats such as calories burned, minutes in zones and points. 
PRIVACY
We value your privacy and never share or sell any user information. 
APPLE HEALTH INTEGRATION
- We read your biometrics from Apple Health for personalization
- We save your workout data to Apple Health
- All workouts count towards your Apple activity rings
APPLE WATCH REQUIREMENTS
The minimum requirement for the Apple Watch is a series 3 or later. 
BLUETOOTH HEART RATE MONITOR SUPPORT
Connect any standard Bluetooth heart rate monitor, armband, or chest strap. Use your OTBeat, Polar, Wahoo, or Garmin HRM. 
The Cycling Workout Companion is made by independent app company PK Fitness Apps Inc and is not affiliated with Peloton, SoulCycle, Flywheel, iFit, Cyclecast, Apptiv, Equinox, 24 Hour Fitness, Planet Fitness, Crunch Fitness, or LA Fitness. 
Terms of Service: https://www.workoutcompanions.app/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://www.workoutcompanions.app/privacy-policy

You can easily raise a cute gecko in your phone.
The smooth animation of the gecko's cute movements will heal you.

This game is an app to raise geckos in your phone.
It's very easy to take care of them. All you have to do is feed it and clean it!

Please enjoy watching the gecko grow day by day.
The game's contents
You can feed the gecko, clean it, and take care of it easily. The gecko grows a little bit every day.
Touch the screen, and the gecko will come to that place.
You can watch the gecko while listening to music.
You can give the gecko a name of your choice. (The name can be changed at any time.)
The size of the gecko is updated every second so that you can see its size in real time.
When you start the app, it will report how much it has grown since the last time.
Notifies you of the timing of feeding and cleaning.

bluejetty:00028708:ios.description:
Human Design App is the original Human Design app on the App Store. We have been building bodygraphs and birth charts since 2014, back when most people had never heard of an energy type.
So what is Human Design? Call it a personality test with unusual roots, one that goes deeper than any sixteen type quiz. It combines astrology, I Ching, Kabbalah, the Chakra system, and the neutrino stream. Your zodiac sign puts you into one of twelve boxes, and a horoscope written for millions can only say so much. Your Human Design chart goes much further. It is calculated from your exact birth time and place to create a deeply individual picture of how you are designed to move through life.
Find out if you should eat in a quiet place or when the sun is out. Should you make decisions quickly or sleep on it? Do you drink your coffee cold or hot? Do you have to prove yourself? Are you here to work or to guide others?
Enter your birth details and the app builds your bodygraph, your personal rave chart, in seconds:
• Your energy type. Generator, Manifesting Generator, Projector, Manifestor, or Reflector. Each moves through the world with a different aura, strategy, and authority
• Your defined and open centers, plus the gates and channels that shape how your energy operates
• Your profile and incarnation cross, the deeper pattern behind your life purpose
You vs. Community turns your chart into statistics. See what percentage of the population shares your energy type, authority, centers, channels, and gates, both overall and among people born in your year. Discover which parts of your design are common, unusual, or genuinely rare.
Then ask AI about any chart in the app. Get answers about your own bodygraph, composite charts, return charts, and transit charts in plain language, like having a Human Design reader in your pocket. Ask how tomorrow looks for you, what your transits say about the test you have on Monday, or what your composite chart reveals about you and your date.
Your chart is a snapshot of the neutrino imprint at the moment you were born. Learning to live your design is a practice of self discovery, mindfulness, and spiritual growth.
Already familiar with Human Design? Go deeper than a basic natal chart:
• Composite charts explore relationship compatibility. See how your bodygraph and your partner’s connect, which channels you complete for each other, and where attraction or friction begins
• Group charts map a family, group of friends, or business team in one visual analysis
• Dream charts show how your design operates while you sleep
• Current transits reveal how today’s planetary activations interact with your chart, creating a daily insight practice rooted in your actual design instead of a generic horoscope
• Time Travel moves your chart up to a year into the future or past, while Channel Forecast previews the gates and channels activating over the next 24 hours
• The I Ching Oracle deals a three-card reading in the spirit of tarot, built around the 64 hexagrams at the foundation of Human Design and the Gene Keys
• Numerology life path calculation adds another lens on your journey
• Return charts, including Saturn return, Chiron, Uranus, and solar returns, reveal the major cycles and turning points of a life
• Detailed interpretations of your authority, definition, channels, gates, incarnation cross, sleep pattern, eating and diet pattern, key sense, environment, perspective, awareness, and more
• Color, tone, and base detail for the deepest layer of your chart
Chart explanations are available in 13 languages. Advanced chart details and unlimited access to the app’s deeper Human Design tools are available with subscription.
Download Human Design App and meet your design today.

bluejetty:00068909:ios.name: Garmin Pilot
bluejetty:00068909:ios.summary:
*30 Days Free Trial on initial download!* 
Plan. File. Fly. Log.
Garmin Pilot is the most comprehensive suite of tools for the iPad designed specifically for general aviation and corporate pilots. Flight planning, charts, interactive map
bluejetty:00068909:ios.description:
*30 Days Free Trial on initial download!* 
Plan. File. Fly. Log.
Garmin Pilot is the most comprehensive suite of tools for the iPad designed specifically for general aviation and corporate pilots. Flight planning, charts, interactive maps, weather briefing resources and navigation capabilities; it’s all included. The app’s intuitive interface mirrors those on the newest Garmin touchscreen avionics so you can go seamlessly from preflight to inflight. 
Plan 
Garmin Pilot’s powerful capabilities start with pre-flight planning, providing pilots with the most comprehensive aviation weather information to make better-informed flight decisions. Pilots can check NEXRAD radar, visible and infrared cloud imagery, METARs, TAFs, AIRMETs, SIGMETs, PIREPs, NOTAMs, winds and temperature aloft, TFRs and lightning data. With Garmin Pilot, data can be displayed over Garmin’s interactive maps that support track-up navigation, VFR sectional or an IFR low or high en-route chart to visualize the weather for your route. Add text-based weather widgets and use the exclusive NavTrack feature to view weather along the planned route. 
File 
With Garmin Pilot, users can easily enter a flight plan and interactively edit it on the map. Pre-loaded forms make it quick to save and reuse data for frequently flown routes. And when the flight plan is ready, Garmin Pilot makes it simple to file, amend or close the flight plan via Leidos Flight Service or DUATS. 
Fly 
Garmin Pilot provides full en-route navigation capability on its moving map. Pilots can also navigate with Garmin’s patented panel, a GPS-driven instrument pack with a graphical HSI directional display and indicators for groundspeed, altitude and vertical speed. After takeoff, pilots can continue to view real-time weather in the U.S. and traffic information by wirelessly connecting to Garmin’s GDL 50 series portable ADS-B Receiver (sold separately). 
Log
Garmin Pilot includes a comprehensive electronic logbook that syncs with flyGarmin. The logbook automatically generates entries based upon GPS data collected during the flight, tracks currency, supports manual entries, endorsements and creates reports.
Garmin Pilot U.S. Standard: 
- Rich, interactive maps support Track-Up navigation
- Charts: VFR Sectionals, low and high IFR en-route, airport diagrams and approach procedures 
- Ability to view Jeppesen Terminal Charts (Jeppesen echart subscription required)
- Weather Maps: Animated radar, Infrared and Visible Satellite, AIRMETs, SIGMETs, Lightning, TFRs and more!
- Extensive text products: METARs, TAFs, Winds Aloft, PIREPs, AIRMETs, SIGMETs, Area Forecasts and NOTAMs 
- AOPA Airport Directory
- Weight and Balance
- Checklists
- Flight plan filing via Leidos Flight Services
- Garmin patented navigation panel 
- Terrain and Obstacles
- Smart Airspace
- Fast Find predictive Waypoint Entry
- Logbook
- Optional VFR Premium: Synthetic Vision (SVX), Terrain and obstacle alerting, and Garmin SafeTaxi® 
- Optional IFR Premium: VFR Premium plus geo-referenced Garmin FliteCharts® 
Garmin Pilot has regional offerings for Africa, Asia, Australia, Canada, Europe and Latin America. Features include:
- Worldwide Jeppesen NavData
- Rich, interactive maps support Track-Up navigation
- Radar and Satellite imagery for Western Europe, U.S., Canada and Australia
- Ability to view Jeppesen Terminal Charts (Jeppesen echart subscription required)
- Worldwide METARs, TAFs, AIRMETs, SIGMETs, NOTAMs and winds aloft
- VFR Flight Plan Filing
- IFR autorouting and Flight plan filing in Europe
- Terrain and Obstacles with alerting
- Synthetic Vision (SVX)
- Smart Airspace
- Logbook
- Optional VFR charts from DFS, IGN and NATS and IFR enroute charts from EuroControl
- Optional Garmin FliteCharts® and SafeTaxi® diagrams available on a country-by-country basis
*Note: Use of GPS running in the background may decrease battery life.* 
*Note: One subscription to Garmin Pilot may be used on three devices.*
