bluejetty:00135089:ios.description:
ICÁ - BẮN CÁ ONLINE THẬT ĐÃ TAY
iCá Zing Play là game bắn cá online giải trí miễn phí số 1 Việt Nam. iCa là cổng Game thuộc thể loại casual đơn giản dễ chơi, ko có đổi thưởng và hoàn toàn free với hình ảnh chibi dễ thương dành cho mọi lứa tuổi. iCa zingplay mang tất cả các đặc trưng của bắn cá siêu thị, nhưng thú vị hơn với dàn Boss siêu khủng và cá tính, hàng loạt kỹ năng độc đáo mà các game bắn cá siêu thị không có. 
Bạn không biết chơi ban ca hoặc chưa từng chơi bắn cá siêu thị? Đừng lo! i ca zingplay chơi rất đơn giản:
- Bước 1: Chọn mục tiêu muốn bắt. Cá càng lớn càng đẹp thì càng ăn xu được nhiều
- Bước 2: Nhấn hoặc giữ ngón tay trên màn hình để bắn liên tục (free fire)
- Bước 3: Di chuyển theo mục tiêu đã định để tăng cơ hội bắt được cá lớn.
GAME LÀ DỄ, TẢI NGAY THÔI !!
Khác với những game bắn cá siêu thị, ban ca doi thuong hay ban ca an xu, i ca zing play là game ban ca giải trí online free to play và có hàng loạt tính năng nổi bật:
- Game miễn phí hoàn toàn, người chơi có thể trở thành đại gia từ quà tặng khởi nghiệp, quà tặng miễn phí, quà tặng giftcode hàng ngày
- Quà tặng bao la, là Game online có nhiều mã quà nhất, với mã quà ngàn vàng mien phi mỗi ngày trên fanpage
- Bắn cá giải trí, săn boss đã tay với hàng loạt boss khủng. Trong thế giới i cá, bạn có thể thách thức thần long (ban ca rong), hay trải nghiệm hiệu ứng free fire lung linh từ boss Phượng hoàng lửa, hiệu ứng bắn 1 được 3 từ boss tam vĩ zingplay
- Combo free fire phượng hoàng lửa và bắn 1 được 3 để quét sạch cá trên bàn
- 12 loại súng độc đáo được thiết kế với ý tưởng là các loài cá trong i ca zingplay: cá chim, cá mực, cá đuối, cá vàng
- Âm thanh, hiệu ứng ăn boss đẹp mắt
Nếu bạn có thời gian rảnh, chần chừ gì mà không giải trí cùng iCa zing play!
Ngoài ra, icá zingplay còn có cổng game sự kiện online thú vị như:
- Bảng xếp hạng hàng tuần: thi đua để dành danh hiệu top 1 với hàng triệu người chơi khác được xếp vào nhiều nhóm thi đấu khác nhau
- Quà bao la với các siêu sự kiện: Sự kiện Vòng xoay kép, Du hành vũ trụ, Xin chào Việt Nam, Tiệm phở sao vàng,...
Cùng nóc khám phá ngay đại dương ica zingplay!
Chú ý:
- iCa Zingplay thuộc cổng game ZingPlay - là cổng game giải trí đa nền tảng đầu tiên tại Việt Nam, được phát triển bởi Zingplay Game Studios trực thuộc VNG. Những năm gần đây, phiên bản trên mobile của ZingPlay đã được ra mắt với hệ thống các game hấp dẫn nhất thuộc nhiều thể loại phù hợp với mọi tầng lớp người dùng.
- Icá Zingplay là game bắn cá giải trí, không phải ban ca doi thuong. Do đó, game không có tính năng doi thuong thành tien mat hay doi thuong doi the.
- Icá ban ca online là tựa game miễn phí không hỗ trợ các hoạt động doi thuong. Mọi hành vi lạm dụng iCá ban ca online vào việc doi thuong là nghiêm cấm.
- Trò chơi được cấp phép phát hành theo quyết định phát hành trò chơi điện tử G1 trên mạng số: 230/QĐ-PTTH&TTĐT do Cục Phát thanh, truyền hình và Thông tin điện tử cấp ngày 6/5/2026 (link: https://giayphep.abei.gov.vn/g1/132015)

bluejetty:00172176:ios.name: NBC10 Philadelphia: Local News
bluejetty:00172176:ios.summary: The NBC10 Philadelphia app is your trusted source for local news, First Alert Weather forecasts and breaking alerts. Stay connected with live coverage, Doppler radar, traffic updates and 24/7 news streaming tailored for Greater Philadelphia
bluejetty:00172176:ios.description:
The NBC10 Philadelphia app is your trusted source for local news, First Alert Weather forecasts and breaking alerts. Stay connected with live coverage, Doppler radar, traffic updates and 24/7 news streaming tailored for Greater Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, South Jersey and Delaware.
Get trusted local reporting, real-time weather updates and live coverage from NBC10 Philadelphia in one app. Follow stories across Philadelphia and the Delaware Valley, including breaking news, politics, elections, public safety, severe weather, traffic, transit, entertainment and urgent updates that affect your day.
Why use the NBC10 Philadelphia app?
If you live or work in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, New Jersey, Delaware or the Delaware Valley, the NBC10 Philadelphia app offers live local coverage, investigative reporting and real-time alerts to keep you informed throughout the day.
What can you do with the NBC10 Philadelphia app?
Follow Philadelphia local news and community
* Get instant push notifications for local, national and world headlines
* Read exclusive articles and watch video reports from NBC10 journalists
* Catch up on stories you missed in the integrated Alerts Center
* Follow key topics including local economy, public safety, transit and education
Follow elections and politics
* Follow complete coverage of electoral races in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, New Jersey, Delaware and local contests
* Track primary and general election results, ballot measures and local proposals
* Watch live election debates and analysis with NBC10 anchors
Stay ahead of the weather with live radar
* Check current conditions, hourly forecasts, 10-day projections, air quality and UV index
* Access live Doppler radar to track rain, snow, severe storms and extreme weather
* Add custom weather widgets to your Home Screen to quickly check forecasts for your area
24/7 live streaming and special coverage
* Watch live NBC10 Philadelphia newscasts and special coverage on demand
* Follow investigative journalism from NBC10 Investigators and consumer guidance from NBC10 Responds
Personalize your NBC10 experience
* Sign in with an NBCUniversal Profile to save articles and videos to watch later
* Manage alert preferences and newsletter subscriptions all in one place
Who is the NBC10 Philadelphia app for?
It is designed for residents and commuters across Philadelphia, Camden, Wilmington, Cherry Hill, Trenton, Reading, Allentown and the Delaware Valley who need real-time weather tracking, traffic and local news updates.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I customize news, election and weather alerts?
Yes. You can filter push notifications by topic and location, receiving only the severe weather alerts, breaking news, election updates or community notices you choose.
Can I watch live newscasts inside the app?
Yes. You can stream NBC Philadelphia News 24/7, live NBC10 newscasts, press conferences and special breaking coverage from anywhere.
NBC10 Philadelphia provides local news, First Alert Weather forecasts, live radar, severe storm alerts, traffic and 24/7 streaming for Greater Philadelphia, South Jersey and Delaware.

bluejetty:00078406:ios.description:
Breezily split expenses with travel companions. In seconds.
It takes mere seconds to create a new trip and add participants. When you split a bill, simply pop open the app, enter each participants costs, and the IOU’s are calculated and stored. 
And at any point, just request the Totals menu item to see the simplest number of payments for everyone to get even, or send a quick email to participants with the breakdown of costs.
Our customers say it all: 
5 Stars! "Works great - perfect app!" 
5 Stars! "Easy to use and fun" 
5 Stars! "Makes group travel a snap!"

- Categorize expenses with the touch of an icon

bluejetty:00035183:ios.name: Duomo: Daily Prayer & Bible
bluejetty:00035183:ios.summary:
Duomo isn’t another Bible app. Instead of giving you more content to consume, it guides you step-by-step to live the Bible through small, simple actions that lead to lasting spiritual growth.
If you feel spiritually distracted, overwhelmed
bluejetty:00035183:ios.description:
Duomo isn’t another Bible app. Instead of giving you more content to consume, it guides you step-by-step to live the Bible through small, simple actions that lead to lasting spiritual growth.
If you feel spiritually distracted, overwhelmed, or unsure how to stay close to God in daily life, Duomo offers a clearer path — one calm moment at a time.
WHY DUOMO?
1. Live the Word, don’t just read it
We don’t give you more content to consume. We give you daily actions that help you practice patience, gratitude, forgiveness, and faithfulness in real life—one small step at a time.
2. Experience Scripture with clarity
Duomo helps the Bible make sense for your season of life. When a verse clicks, it doesn’t just inform you—it transforms you.
3. Create habits that bring peace
Your personalized plan turns spiritual insight into daily rhythms: morning prayer, Scripture, reflection, an action to try, and gratitude.
Simple steps. Consistent growth. No pressure.
WHAT YOU’LL FIND IN DUOMO
Duomo guides you through the areas of life where your faith meets your lived reality — marriage, purpose, work, parenthood, healing, relationships, and more.
Your daily path includes:
- Daily prayers to begin with God’s presence
- Today’s Scripture with clear, practical meaning for your real struggles
- One small action to turn the verse into a habit
- A short reflection to reconnect with God’s love
- A daily quiz to deepen your understanding
- Chapter summaries and progress tracking to celebrate growth without shame
Every piece of the journey is crafted to quiet anxious noise, restore peace, and bring your life back into alignment with the heart of God.
WHO DUOMO IS FOR
- People seeking a stronger daily spiritual routine
- Those returning to faith after burnout or drift
- Anyone longing for peace, clarity, and a deeper connection with God
- Believers who want Scripture to shape their habits — not just their knowledge
Subscription Info
Duomo is a paid-access app. All features are available through in-app subscription. A free trial is offered so you can experience the journey before committing.
Walk the Path With Us. Wherever you’re starting — from spiritual drift, burnout, curiosity, or long-term discipleship — Duomo walks beside you.
One verse.
One action.
One day at a time.
Let’s grow closer to God together — step by step.
Privacy: https://goduomo.com/app-privacy
Terms: https://goduomo.com/app-terms
GET IN TOUCH:
Support: support@goduomo.com

bluejetty:00088513:ios.summary:
Dive into Naval Frontline — the only authentic WW2 Hardcore naval combat simulator on mobile, built exclusively for military enthusiasts and history buffs.
Unlike arcade-style sea battle games that turn warships into magic fast-firing tank
bluejetty:00088513:ios.description:
Dive into Naval Frontline — the only authentic WW2 Hardcore naval combat simulator on mobile, built exclusively for military enthusiasts and history buffs.
Unlike arcade-style sea battle games that turn warships into magic fast-firing tanks, we 1:1 restore the real performance of legendary WWII warships. Slow, deliberate main battery reloads, realistic ballistics, and true-to-history armor mechanics — every salvo you fire depends on your tactical calculation, not fast fingers or deep pockets.
Take command of iconic warships like the Yamato, USS Iowa, or Bismarck in 10v10 real-time PvP fleet battles. Victory here is won with formation positioning, lead time calculation, and team coordination, not mindless shooting. With meticulously detailed 3D models, dynamic weather systems, and full historical accuracy, experience the most immersive naval warfare on iOS.
Core Features:
• Tactical Naval Simulation: Feel the inertia of your main cannons, master armor angling (Angling) to bounce incoming shells, and calculate precise lead times for every salvo. This is a true test of strategy, not reaction speed.
• Legendary Historical Fleet: Collect over 150 meticulously modeled WWII warships, including battleships, carriers, cruisers, and destroyers. Every detail is recreated with full historical accuracy.
• Deep Team-Based Gameplay: Coordinate ambushes, focus fire on priority targets, and hold the line with your fleet. 15-minute full tactical battles, no 3-minute mindless arcade rounds.
• Stunning Historical Visuals: Perfect recreation of WWII combat environments. From muzzle flashes of main batteries to smoke effects after impacts, everything is fully optimized for iOS devices.
• In-Depth Customization: Upgrade your weapons, armor, and crew skills. Use unique historical camos and ship flags to preserve accuracy while showing off your personal style.
• Diverse Game Modes: Join real-time 10v10 PvP fleet battles, co-op historical campaigns, ranked seasons, and 7-minute quick skirmish mode for shorter sessions. Relive legendary battles like Midway, Leyte Gulf, and Coral Sea.
Join the ultimate WWII naval battle simulator! Download Naval Frontline now, and become a legendary fleet commander!

bluejetty:00030700:ios.description:
Introducing the MAGICSING app! 
Sing, shout, and dance to all of your favorite songs by accessing 
over 200,000 songs from all over the world!
The MAGICSING app is presented by ASSAWAVE Co., Ltd., the world’s number one karaoke manufacturer!
We are proud to introduce a mobile karaoke app based on MIDI technology. 
MAGICSING highlights the various elements of music and singing by allowing users to alter the tone, tempo, and melody so that the song can be tailored to each unique singer! 
It provides a voice search function and a wide-range of musical genres from gospel music to the latest pop songs. 
By using the streaming method, the latest songs are automatically updated so that it’s ready to play anytime and anywhere.
The MAGICSING app is also compatible with ASSAWAVE’s latest streaming-based MAGICSING karaoke machines, which work together to create a more lively karaoke experience. Refer to the MAGICSING karaoke manual to connect the app and the karaoke machine!
[Highlights]
* Provides an extensive music library of more than 200,000 songs in a variety of languages
* Supports key changes, tone, tempo, and melody
* Instrumental accompaniment with volume and control to match the users’ taste
* The latest songs are automatically updated
* MAGICSING can be used together with ASSAWAVE’s MAGICSING karaoke machines 
* MIDI-based music, rather than recordings. This service only uses a small amount of data; about 20 ~ 30 KB per song, so that you can get fast streaming and immediate music for fewer data.
* Professional musical notes.
* Touch drum funtion.
[Support]
* Contact "qna@magicsing.com” for song requests or any other inquiries.
Thank you for using MAGICSING!

bluejetty:00169900:ios.description:
This powerful app simplifies health monitoring and performance tracking. 
Go beyond just measuring heart rate and Heart Rate Variability (HRV) - seamlessly integrate blood pressure management, burnout prevention, recovery insights, sleep data, workout analysis, and more into your lifestyle.
YOUR PERSONALIZED HEALTH COMPANION:-
- Instant Heart Rate and HRV Measurement:
Measure your heart rate in 30 seconds and obtain precise HRV readings using your device's camera—breakdown HRV into metrics like Stress, Energy & Health.
- 24/7 Cardio and Stress Metrics:
Get personalized, round-the-clock insights into your cardiovascular health and stress levels.
- Blood Pressure Management:
Monitor your cardiovascular health by effortlessly logging and tracking blood pressure over time.
- Comprehensive Stress Management:
• Real-time Stress Monitoring: Track stress levels 24/7
• Personalized Stress Insights: Learn what triggers your stress and how it impacts your overall well-being
• Adaptive Stress Relief: Receive breathing exercises and actionable tips based on your current stress levels
• Stress Trend Analysis: Visualize long-term stress patterns and their correlation with your activities and lifestyle
- Burnout / Overtraining Prevention:
 Receive guidance on when to push or rest based on recovery metrics, we can help you know the difference. Our sophisticated algorithm takes into account all your key vital metrics.
- Personalized Workout Analysis (Apple Watch):
 Benefit from heart rate zones tailored to your unique physiology, cardio output, and post-workout recovery metrics to track fitness progress.
- Athlete-Focused Features:
• Prevent overtraining with personalised readiness scores
• Optimize workouts using adaptive heart rate zones
• Track detailed metrics like cardio load and recovery scores
- Sleep Quality Tracking (Apple Watch):
• Analyze sleep patterns
• Sleep deficit
• Bed-sleep ratio
• Sleep time HR, HRV & Respiration rate
• 5 Sleep zones including regenerative sleep stages to wake up refreshed for peak performance
• Ai detects any issue and suggests practical guidance
- Widgets & WatchFaces
• 50+ Health widgets including HR, HRV, Stress, Calories, Workout, Sleep etc
• 12+ Customisable WatchFaces
- Seamless Apple Health Integration:
Sync all health and fitness data effortlessly across Apple devices and apps.
- User-Friendly Interface:
Designed for simplicity, the intuitive interface ensures a hassle-free experience for users of all ages.
Whether you're an elite athlete pushing boundaries or someone striving for good health, this all-in-one companion empowers you with valuable metrics to track health, optimize performance, accelerate recovery, and prevent burnout for sustained progress.

bluejetty:00082709:ios.description:
ShineDay is a habit tracker for people who want a simple system they can actually stick with. Start with micro habits, build a steady routine, and turn small daily actions into real progress.
If you want an ADHD-friendly planner with less friction, ShineDay gives you a cleaner way to plan, check in, and keep your streaks going. It works well as a lightweight daily planner for personal productivity, focus, reminders, and recurring routines.
Why ShineDay works:
* Fast daily check-ins that take seconds
* Flexible goal tracking for yes or no habits, counts, and duration
* A lightweight planner for recurring routines and daily checklist items
* Streaks, stats, charts, and a yearly heat map to show progress
* Smart reminders based on time and location
* Home Screen and Lock Screen widget support for faster logging
* Focus tools, including Pomodoro sessions for work or study
* Notes and reflections for every habit
* iCloud sync and backup across devices
* Themes, wallpapers, and gentle motivation to help you stay consistent
Great for:
* Building better routines
* Staying on track with ADHD

bluejetty:00166762:ios.description:
Enjoy a seamless flight and hotel booking experience with IndiGo, India’s most preferred airline. Download IndiGo’s flight ticket booking app on your mobile through the Apple App Store and book your IndiGo flight tickets or hotels in a few taps.
IndiGo's air ticket booking app offers you a chance to book affordable flights to 90+ domestic & 40+ international destinations while enjoying exclusive app benefits. Not only that, you can also book hotels online with IndiGo and choose from 7 lakh+ options.
Special services:

 ● Enjoy extra legroom, more comfort, deep recline and other benefits with IndiGoStretch, IndiGo’s new business cabin
 ● Save on convenience fee when you book flights on goIndiGo.in or the IndiGo mobile app. T&C apply
 ● Skip the queue at the airport & board your IndiGo flight whenever you want when you pre-book Fast Forward
 ● Pre-book excess or additional baggage on the IndiGo airlines app and save up to 20%
 ● Choose a delicious meal for your next IndiGo flight from our exclusive 6E Eats menu
 ● Get priority check-in, anytime boarding, a seat of your choice and a snack combo when you pre-book 6E Prime
 ● Get ‘Delayed and Lost Baggage Protection’ starting at ₹95 for your IndiGo flights
 ● Luxury hotels booking or budget hotels booking, the IndiGo flight & hotel app has it all
IndiGo mobile app features made for you:
 ● Enjoy a flight & hotel booking experience that’s easy, fast and intuitive
 ● Avail exclusive fares & discounts
 ● Get deals throughout the year on the IndiGo mobile app
 ● Explore a personalised experience with the 'My Bookings' section
 ● Access your IndiGo boarding pass whenever you want
 ● Find useful visa information for your next international flight
 ● Use the ‘Flight Status Tracker’ to check your flight status seamlessly
 ● Find cheap and luxury hotels online easily
Why choose IndiGo?
 ● With over 2,200 daily flights, you can book low-fare IndiGo flight tickets to your desired destination using the IndiGo airline ticket booking app
 ● Fly to 90+ domestic & 40+ international destinations. Also book hotels online seamlessly
 ● IndiGo, in codeshare with Turkish Airlines, British Airways, Qantas, and more, offers flights to 40+ international destinations across USA, Australia, Europe and more
 ● You can get anything you want delivered with IndiGo CarGo
Special discounts
 ● Students can avail an exclusive discount of up to 10% along with 10 kg extra baggage allowance on their IndiGo flights
 ● Flyers above the age of 60 can enjoy a discount of up to 6% with Senior Citizen Fare

bluejetty:00036083:ios.description:
Welcome to the O'Reilly Auto Parts Professional Mobile App, your ultimate tool for streamlining vehicle service and parts management from your mobile device. Whether you're an auto repair shop owner, a service writer, mechanic, or any automotive repair professional, our app is designed to enhance your efficiency and simplify your work day.
**If you don’t have an O’Reilly Auto Parts Professional Account, you can request access from the app login screen or contact your local O’Reilly Auto Parts store for more details and assistance. **
Features of the O'Reilly Auto Parts Professional Mobile App:
The O’Reilly Auto Parts Professional Mobile App supports both English and Spanish. If you already have your phone settings defaulted to Spanish, the app will automatically download content in Spanish. This can save you time while using the app and prevent you from having to toggle to the language you prefer to use on the app. Users can also toggle easily from English to Spanish using the language preferences in the “More” tab. 
Efficient Vehicle Identification Our VIN scanner and license plate decoder tools make identifying vehicles simple and efficient. Quickly decode vehicle information, order parts, sync with your desktop, and manage your service needs more effectively using the tools available in the O’Reilly Auto Parts Professional Mobile App.
Seamless Parts Lookup and Ordering You can find the parts you need by searching using keywords, part numbers, and more, or by navigating with our simple catalog lookup. The O’Reilly Professional App provides instant access to our comprehensive catalog and real-time inventory, ensuring you get the right parts quickly and accurately – keeping you focused on your customers.
Interchange You can use interchange to cross-reference part numbers from original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), other brands, or even superseded part numbers to find the right part for the job every time. 
Place & Track orders Submit orders for delivery or pickup from your local O’Reilly Auto Parts store, see local store, hub, and DC availability and delivery times, and even track the status of your order or view previous orders in the order history and tracker view features. 
Send Quotes to Customers Quickly and easily send quotes to your customers via text message or email to simplify their service and minimize wait times before beginning repairs. 
Professional Support
Need Assistance? Contact our support team for any questions or help with your account at OReillyProSupport@oreillyauto.com, or call us at (800) 934-2451.
Download and Get Started 
The O'Reilly Auto Parts Professional Mobile App is available for download now. Log in with your existing O'Reilly Professional account, or sign up through the app, to start enjoying these features now.

DARIO CONNECT 
Dario Connect (formerly Twill Care) is a free social app that includes a variety of health-based groups to help our members support their physical and mental well-being. Some of the groups include MS, Pregnancy, Psoriasis, Type 1 Diabetes, Type 2 Diabetes, Weight Management, Heart Health, GLP-1 Management, and more! 
Each community is unique, but all feature the same level of support, guidance, and connection that make it easier for you to take charge of your health and wellness—based on your needs. 
THE APP WILL HELP YOU 
- Connect with people who share similar health concerns 
- Ask questions, swap advice, and learn what’s working for others 
- Share your ups and downs in a judgment-free zone 
- Offer recommendations and support to others who are navigating physical or lifestyle changes, living with a chronic condition, or looking to care for their mental well-being 
- Get information from board-certified health experts 
TAKE CHARGE OF YOUR HEALTH AND WELL-BEING 
- Get personalized content tailored to your interests or concerns 
- Read up on the latest treatments and remedies 
- Learn how to manage symptoms and complications 
- Discover tips and self-care techniques for navigating mental health, relationships, healthy eating, exercising, socializing, and general wellness 
- Track your symptoms and stress levels to monitor your overall health and well-being 
- Access audio meditations and science-based activities and games 
- Learn to prioritize your mental health and well-being through it all 
OUR COMMUNITY IS BETTER TOGETHER 
Dario Connect was designed to help people navigate their physical and mental wellness. We believe taking control of your health is easier when you have the resources you need. That’s why Dario Connect provides tools, information, and tips from experts and others like you—all at your fingertips. 
LEGAL

Terms of service: https://darioconnect.com/public/terms/

bluejetty:00089171:ios.description:
Notes, tasks, voice recordings, web pages, and files - all in one beautiful native iOS app. Your data stays on your device
Featured by Apple - "New Apps We Love"
4.8 stars from thousands of users
"Better than Notion for personal use - kind of like Notion, but native"
"Better than Evernote's and OneNote's mobile app"
"Best notes app. It does everything I could want"
- KEY FEATURES -
PRIVATE
All data stored locally on your device, owned by you. No account required to get started. Just open the app and write.
MODULAR
Every piece of content is an independent block. Capture texts, lists, to-dos, files, bookmarks, locations, and more - then arrange them however you want.
ORGANIZED
Folder-like system, tags, color coding, and search. Put notes inside other notes to build any structure you need - shopping lists, project plans, or an entire personal knowledge base.
TO-DOS
Flexible task and project system built right into your notes. Create checklists, set reminders, check items off. No need for a separate task app.
DRAG & DROP
Add content and move it around, anywhere you want. Designed for touch from day one - not adapted from desktop.
READ IT LATER
Save websites and articles to read later. Keep everything you find online in one place alongside your notes.
VOICE MEMOS
Record memos, meeting notes, lectures, and ideas. Right there next to your text notes, not in a separate app.
CLOUD SYNC
Back up your data and access it on all your devices. Works offline first - syncs automatically when you reconnect.
THEMES
Beautiful themes to personalize your space. Make the app feel like yours.
- PERFECT FOR -
- Shopping lists, grocery lists, daily checklists
- Quick notes, ideas, and thoughts
- Managing tasks and to-dos
- Organizing projects and personal knowledge
- Saving web links to read later
- Collecting recipes, travel plans, fitness tips
- Recording voice memos and meeting notes
- Keeping files and documents in one place
- Journaling and personal diary
- And much more
- UNIT PLUS -
A powerful free version is available for everyone. Upgrade to Plus to unlock:
- Unlimited blocks
- Advanced block types (audio, location, toggle)
- Passcode protection
- Save web pages offline
- Premium themes collection
- Unlimited uploads
- Unlimited devices
- Priority support
Unit is free. If you choose to upgrade to Plus, payment will be charged to your Apple account, and your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can choose to be billed monthly or yearly. You can turn off auto-renew in your Apple ID Account Settings any time after purchase.

Any Ringtones is your go-to app for making unique ringtones easily. It’s a simple to use ringtone maker, full of features that let you mix your favorite sounds into something special.
Key Features:
- Mix and Match: Start with a classic like Marimba, then add parts of your favorite song or even clips from beloved videos. Combine them to make a ringtone that's all you.
- Edit with Ease: Cut and change your ringtones until they’re just right, with our simple editing tools.
- Set Your Sound: Once you’ve made your ringtone, set it as your call, text, or alarm sound with just a few taps.
- Video to Ringtone: Transform any moment from your favorite videos into your ringtone, adding a personal touch to your phone.
- Large Sound Library: Dive into a big collection of cool and unique sounds designed to make your ringtone stand out.
- Easy Installation Guide: Follow our video tutorial for a quick and straightforward way to set your new ringtone.
Why Choose Any Ringtones?
It’s a perfect ringtone maker for users who want a fun and easy way to personalize their phone with sounds that express their individuality. Mix, edit, and set your ringtones, all in one place, including the option to create ringtones from video clips.
Try Any Ringtones now and make your ringtone truly yours!
Upgrade to Premium: access unlimited ringtones creation, unique contact photos, and enjoy an ad-free experience!

RELAX, SLIDE, AND SOLVE
Welcome to Cardscapes™, a unique puzzle experience that blends the classic sliding mechanics with the visual satisfaction of jigsaw puzzles. Move the cards, connect the pieces, and reveal stunning HD photography in a calm, stress-free environment.
This is not a traditional card game. It is a logic puzzle designed to soothe your mind and sharpen your focus.

UNIQUE SLIDE MECHANICS 
Forget about complex rules. Simply slide cards across the board to find their perfect spot. When matching pieces touch, they snap together satisfyingly, allowing you to move them as a single group.
PURE RELAXATION 
No timers. No move limits. No penalties. Immerse yourself in a peaceful puzzle session where the only goal is to complete the picture at your own pace. It is the perfect escape from daily stress.

Travel the world through puzzles. Assemble vibrant images of nature, animals, landscapes, and cozy interiors. Every completed level is a masterpiece waiting to be revealed.

Engage your spatial reasoning and logic skills. While the gameplay is relaxing, finding the right sequence of moves keeps your brain active and focused. Ideal for players of all ages who enjoy keeping their minds sharp.
WHY CARDSCAPES?
- Visual Therapy: The combination of smooth sliding controls and high-quality art creates a satisfying, tactile experience.
- Logic Meets Art: A fresh take on the genre that stands apart from standard card games.
- Mindful Moments: Designed to be played in short sessions to reset your focus, or long sessions to unwind completely.
- Discover the joy of bringing order to chaos.
Download Cardscapes today and piece together your perfect moment of calm.

bluejetty:00013704:ios.description:
Collect your books reading notes in one place by simply pointing your camera at the paperbacks. Managing your reading notes has never been so effortless!
KEY FEATURES
* Find books and add to your collection by scanning bar code, searching keyword, or entering book info manually.
* Take a photo of the printed text and save your reading notes in a flash, empowered by revolutionary Optimal Character Recognition (OCR) technology.
* Recognize texts in 45+ languages: English, Chinese, France, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, German, Italian, 
 and many more.
* Record your reading data.
* Save images directly as your notes.
* Organize your books by shelves.
* Create a table of contents for your books and navigate your notes by chapters.
* Set short title for your notes.
* Share your notes and thoughts with multiple elegantly designed templates.
* Search full-text and find your notes.
* Track your reading progress.
* Export your notes as PDFs or HTMLs.
* Support various iOS features such as Handoff, Multitasking, and Search.
* Website: https://shelfie.app
HIGHLIGHTS
* Access your notes anywhere: Everything is synced automatically and instantly across any computer, phone, or tablet. Once you create your account, your date stays in sync so that you always have the up-to-date version of your favorite quotes and inspirations (yeah we do not rely on iCloud).
* Advanced OCR technology based on Google: Fast and precise.
* Auto recognition of tables of contents: Take a photo of a book’s table of contents and we automatically turn it into chapters matched with pages.
* Simple, but powerful.

We offer monthly and yearly Premium subscriptions. App Store will renews the subscription during 24 hours before it expires. You can stop the auto renewal in the system settings of iPhone. Terms: https://yanwai.net/terms/en

- Receive Greyhound bus ticket details
- Refer friends to get you bonuses and incentives (when applicable)
- Message with recruiters in real-time
- Find safe parking spots for your semi nationwide

Track electricity, solar and electric vehicle usage

bluejetty:00084169:ios.description:
Live Transcribe + is an App to make it Possible to do Live Transcription and Captioning for Deaf and hard of hearing. 
Live Transcribe + is your own Personal Assistant for transcribing live speech and voice to text. Leveraging almost-instant Artificial Intelligence technologies, Live Transcribe + provides quality, instant speech to text and dictation, readable transcriptions with just a tap of a button.
Use Live Transcribe + to transcribe or live caption voice to text for classrooms, business meetings, doctor’s appointments, shopping, events, and more. Live Transcribe + speech-to-text app makes transcribing any live communication easy for friends, family, and organizations to be inclusive, accessible and ADA compliant! 
Built for simplicity and ease of use. (Not associated with Google.)
All The Features are Available Freely on the Live Transcribe + until transcription is done for 5 times, then the features will require a paid subscription. 
Simple to Use 
• Transcribe in real time (even when offline) with high accuracy 
• Scroll back to grab a quote or revisit a point
• Input audio via built-in mic or Bluetooth device
• Tap once and continuously transcribe from speech to text for as long as you’d like without limits (requires subscription after 5 times)
• Voice typing made easy
Capture Every Word
• Easily dictate on the mic and convert the voice to text using dictation
• The speaker can use bluetooth headphones for increased accuracy even in noisy environments
Easy to Read
• Focus on what’s being said
• Add new lines automatically or manually to break up the text
• Easily Read Text in Both Light and Dark Mode
• Export Text after dictation
Many Uses of Live Transcribe +
• Take meeting notes automatically
• Share meeting minutes and summary with teammates 
• Record and transcribe interviews, lectures, podcasts, videos, webinars, keynotes 
• Provide live captioning to deaf, hard-of-hearing, ESL people, and anyone with accessibility needs
To have access to the "Live Transcribe + Full Access" functionality, you can choose between a monthly and yearly auto-renewable subscription. This is a recurring transaction that will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase and will automatically renew unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the end of your subscription. Renewals will be charged the same cost within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage your subscriptions and auto-renewal can be turned off by going to your iTunes Account Settings after purchase.
Terms of Service (EULA) : https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://zerovik.com/privacy-policy-for-live-transcribe

Live Transcribe + is an App to make it Possible to do Live Transcription and Captioning for Deaf and hard of hearing. 

Live Transcribe + is your own Personal Assistant for transcribing live speech and voice to text. Leveraging almost-instant Artificial Intelligence technologies, Live Transcribe + provides quality, instant speech to text and dictation, readable transcriptions with just a tap of a button.

Use Live Transcribe + to transcribe or live caption voice to text for classrooms, business meetings, doctor’s appointments, shopping, events, and more. Live Transcribe + speech-to-text app makes transcribing any live communication easy for friends, family, and organizations to be inclusive, accessible and ADA compliant! 


Built for simplicity and ease of use. (Not associated with Google.)

All The Features are Available Freely on the Live Transcribe + until transcription is done for 5 times, then the features will require a paid subscription. 

Simple to Use 
• Transcribe in real time (even when offline) with high accuracy 
• Scroll back to grab a quote or revisit a point
• Input audio via built-in mic or Bluetooth device
• Tap once and continuously transcribe from speech to text for as long as you’d like without limits (requires subscription after 5 times)
• Voice typing made easy


Capture Every Word
• Easily dictate on the mic and convert the voice to text using dictation
• The speaker can use bluetooth headphones for increased accuracy even in noisy environments

Easy to Read
• Focus on what’s being said
• Add new lines automatically or manually to break up the text
• Easily Read Text in Both Light and Dark Mode
• Export Text after dictation

Many Uses of Live Transcribe +
• Take meeting notes automatically
• Share meeting minutes and summary with teammates 
• Record and transcribe interviews, lectures, podcasts, videos, webinars, keynotes 
• Provide live captioning to deaf, hard-of-hearing, ESL people, and anyone with accessibility needs

To have access to the "Live Transcribe + Full Access" functionality, you can choose between a monthly and yearly auto-renewable subscription. This is a recurring transaction that will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase and will automatically renew unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the end of your subscription. Renewals will be charged the same cost within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage your subscriptions and auto-renewal can be turned off by going to your iTunes Account Settings after purchase.


Terms of Service (EULA) : https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://zerovik.com/privacy-policy-for-live-transcribe

Walnote is your AI-powered solution to learn faster, retain more, and make studying fun. Key Features of Walnote: 
AI Video Summary & Transcription 
Transform YouTube videos and podcasts into accurate, concise summaries. Get video transcripts with a click and easily search for important points.
Audio Record & Transcription Record your own lectures or notes and instantly transcribe them with AI-powered transcription. You can also upload audio or video files for transcription, making it perfect for students, professionals, and anyone who needs to capture audio or video information. 
Interactive Flashcards & Quizzes
Take your learning to the next level by creating flashcards and quizzes based on video summaries and transcriptions. Reinforce what you've learned and track your progress. 
Customizable Notes

Boost Retention

Why Walnote? 
AI-Powered Accuracy Leverage the latest AI technology to generate accurate, reliable transcriptions and summaries in seconds. 
User-Friendly Interface 
Designed for simplicity and ease of use. Navigate through your notes, summaries, and quizzes effortlessly. 
Versatile Learning Tool 
Whether you're studying for exams, researching, or keeping up with podcasts, Walnote is the ultimate tool for efficient learning.

Download Walnote now and transform how you learn from videos, podcasts, and audio recordings. Say goodbye to information overload and hello to smarter studying.

bluejetty:00061813:ios.description:
Verizon One Talk:
Voice, video and messaging business solution
Your business is constantly evolving, so you need a phone and collaboration solution that can keep up. We have you covered for how you work today and in the future.
One Talk is a mobile-first business phone solution built for how you work today, allowing you to connect with customers, employees and others in the office or on-the-go. Easily manage 50+ business and user features from the Verizon One Talk web portal or mobile app.
One Talk includes multiple user device & app options:
* Smartphone Native Dialer. Connect mobile employees to the office and customers from their smartphone native keypad— all over the reliable and award-winning Verizon network. 
* Desk, conference, and cordless phones. Enhance calling and collaboration with a range of Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP) phones, including the nation’s first 4G cellular enabled desk phone, and accessories for your office-based employees. 
* Mobile App for smartphones and tablets. Enable employees using business-owned or personal smartphones and tablets (including other carrier devices) to access One Talk features from a single number. 
* Desktop App for computers. Easily make and receive voice/ video calls and SMS/text messages on your computer (PC or Mac®), similar to using your smartphone. 
One Talk has 50+ powerful features to enhance communications, providing:
* Anywhere calling. Provide flexibility and a better calling experience with business-grade features like Caller ID and Simultaneous Ring. 
* Easy collaboration. Boost your employees’ ability to collaborate more effectively with messaging (chat, SMS and IM) and video conferencing from BlueJeans by Verizon on a single unified app. 
* Engaging customer experience. Connect callers to the people they need with features like Auto Receptionist, Hunt Groups and more. 
Get started:
1. Subscribe to the Verizon One Talk service
2. Install the One Talk app.  Enter your One Talk phone number.  Request PIN 
3. An email will be sent to the email associated with your number with an activation PIN.  Enter your PIN and complete setup
4. Start using the One Talk App for calling, video and messaging.
One Talk Terms and Conditions Apply. See OneTalk.com for more information.

bluejetty:00061467:ios.summary: Nordnet's products and services are available in Denmark, Finland, Norway and Sweden. With Nordnet's award-winning app, investing in stocks, funds, and ETFs is easier than ever. In the app you can track your progress and what is happening o
bluejetty:00061467:ios.description:
Nordnet's products and services are available in Denmark, Finland, Norway and Sweden. With Nordnet's award-winning app, investing in stocks, funds, and ETFs is easier than ever. In the app you can track your progress and what is happening on the stock market. It's completely free to download and use the app.
• We offer trading in stocks, funds, and other securities at low fees on several of the world's largest exchanges.
• Discover new investments through top and theme lists, articles, and current campaigns.
• See discussions about investing and specific stocks and funds from our users.
• Follow your holdings and the stock market's development in real-time.
GET STARTED IN THREE MINUTES.
Create an account directly in the app. Deposit your money easily and secure to start trading and investing.
LOW FEES FOR TRADING AND INVESTING.
Always low fees regardless of how little or much you trade. Choose the commission class that fits your trading.
AUTOMATIC MONTHLY INVESTING.
Save automatically each month in funds. Get help choosing a fund plan that suits you.
WIDE RANGE OF STOCKS AND FUNDS.
Choose from thousands of stocks and funds on multiple exchanges around the world. Get inspired by other investors' stock holdings or choose funds based on your savings goals: sustainable, low fees, or highest returns.
REAL-TIME PRICE ALERTS.
Get a push notification when your watched stocks and other securities reach the level you have set.
WATCHLISTS.
Find your next investment through our watchlists. Choose industries that interest you and then get lists of instruments within those themes. Use it as inspiration to find new investments or to keep an eye on exciting companies. You can also create your own watchlists.
LISTEN AND READ REPORTS WITH QUARTR.
In partnership with Quartr, you can easily keep track of your favorite stocks by listening to company presentations during quarterly and annual reports. You can also download reports and presentations in text format.
INTERACTIVE GRAPHS.
Compare your investments with relevant indexes and see how you perform over time. See features for more advanced investors, such as trading volume and candlesticks.
SAFE AND EASY.
Log in with Touch-ID or Face-ID. Hide your balance if you, for example, want to log in in public environments.
ABOUT NORDNET.
We are a leading Nordic digital broker for savings and investments with over 2 million customers in Sweden, Finland, Norway, and Denmark.
Through innovation, simplicity, and transparency, we challenge traditional structures and give private savers access to the same information, tools, and services as professional investors. Welcome to Nordnet.

bluejetty:00091572:ios.name: NJ Child Support
bluejetty:00091572:ios.summary: The New Jersey Child Support Case Information application is the official child support mobile application for the State of New Jersey. It allows custodial and non-custodial parents to retrieve secure case information related to their child
bluejetty:00091572:ios.description: The New Jersey Child Support Case Information application is the official child support mobile application for the State of New Jersey. It allows custodial and non-custodial parents to retrieve secure case information related to their child support cases. Users are only authorized to view a case to which they are a party and utilize a member ID and PIN to access the information. Non-custodial parents are able to make payments directly through the app using a Visa or Mastercard, as well as set up and manage monthly recurring payments. The app also includes case details such as: dependent information; obligations and arrears; payment history; schedule and enforcement details; genetic test results; and any intergovernmental case materials. This application gives the same information and access as the web-based Case Information portal http://caseinfo.njchildsupport.org.

Advance ordering allows you to get your food when it's most convenient for you.

Order as little or as much as you want.

bluejetty:00024168:ios.description:
Build your child’s logic skills and develop observation skills with Puzzles for Kids and Toddlers! The kids puzzles are educational and full of fun. Play with the dino and solve jigsaw puzzles for kids and toddlers. Children will learn about Insects, Space, Farm, Underwater, Forest, Construction, City, Animals, Desert, and more! Kids will love these educational puzzle games!
A collection of colorful puzzle pieces for kids with a variety of kid's favorites like cars, fruits, vegetables, rainbows, plants, trees, trucks, spaceships, animals, and many others. These kids puzzles are excellent for toddlers 2, 3, 4, 5 year olds.
What will kids play and learn?
Jigsaw Puzzles
Shadow Matching
Tangrams
Sort by Shapes
Sort by Sizes
Puzzles for Kids and Toddlers includes the following themes:
1) Forest - Go on a jungle safari with friends. Solve animal jigsaw puzzles for kids. Discover monkeys, bears, pandas, and other animals on the way. Exciting tent puzzles for kids and toddlers to stay in! Lit the campfire and explore the treehouse kids puzzles!
2) Space - Dress up in the spacesuit and fly in your aircraft puzzle. Meet the astronaut and robots. Check out the Earth, Sun & Planets & Satellite with space puzzles for kids! Complete the puzzles of UFO, Rocket, Moon, Space Station, Stars & more. Loads of kids puzzles to create telescopes, space helmets, space tv, and meteor.
3) Farm - Ride the tractor and go on a farm journey. Find kids' animal puzzles like the horse, pig, dog, and more. Make the windmill, well, and fence with exciting jigsaw puzzles for kids and toddlers.
4) Ocean - Dive into the ocean and explore the underwater world! Meet the turtles, crab, and fish by solving fun puzzles for kids. Discover sea horses, dolphins, fishes, and treasure chests. A quest of exciting kids puzzles for ages 2, 3, 4, 5 year olds.
5) Sky - Hop onto the airplane! Join the bird puzzles for toddlers. Play with the toddler puzzles such as clouds and hot air balloons in the sky.
6) Construction Site - Gear up for building new constructions in the construction uniform. Complete the puzzles of dump trucks, cranes, cement mixers. Vehicle puzzles for kids! Have fun with puzzles for hammers, drill machines, bridges. Puzzles for toddlers ages 2-5 year olds to learn and enjoy!
7) City - Go around the dino city with friends. Hang out at the park and complete ice cream puzzles for kids. Explore the shops, police stations, and bus stops. Make the fire brigade, cars, and houses with toddler puzzles for kids.
8) Bugs - Have fun with the insects! Make butterflies, snails, and honey bees with toddler puzzles. Create flowers, mushroom houses, and anthills with puzzles for toddlers and kids ages 2-5 year olds.
9) Desert - Say hello to desert friends! Join the animal puzzles to complete the puzzles of camels, horses, vultures. Discover the regional cactus, coconut trees, and wells. Build the pyramids, tents, and bonfires with toddler puzzles for ages 2, 3, 4, 5 year olds.
10) CandyLand - Enter the magical world of Candyland! Drive the candy car, make delicious donuts, ice creams, and cupcakes with fun kids jigsaw puzzles. Complete the toddler puzzles like cake puzzles, unicorn puzzles for kids, and candy houses.

bluejetty:00178600:ios.name: Handwriting Practice App
bluejetty:00178600:ios.summary: Want to improve your handwriting and master cursive? Our handwriting and letter tracing app makes it easy and fun! Practice with a variety of cursive fonts, hand lettering styles, and tracing guides to build confidence and improve your penm
bluejetty:00178600:ios.description:
Want to improve your handwriting and master cursive? Our handwriting and letter tracing app makes it easy and fun! Practice with a variety of cursive fonts, hand lettering styles, and tracing guides to build confidence and improve your penmanship. Whether you're working on elegant script, bold block letters, or creative calligraphy, you'll find plenty of letter designs, inspirational quotes, and fun decorations to explore.
With step-by-step tracing tutorials, a high-tech tracing projector, and an interactive AR environment, you'll get hands-on practice that makes learning feel natural. Just grab a pen or stylus and start tracing! Hand writing & lettering is a fun and creative way to personalize notes, journals, and artwork. Experiment with different letter shapes, sizes, and styles to turn simple words into beautiful designs. All you need is a little practice—and this app is here to help!
Turn on AR drawing mode to see your hand lettering designs projected on the surface in front of you for effective handwriting practice. Look through the camera of your device, take a pencil and easily sketch and trace the letters onto paper. This is how the app makes drawing letters and hand writing easy with augmented reality and let you learn how to create lovely brush-lettered art designs in no-time.
Coming up with creative hand lettering ideas can be a real challenge. Use the hand lettering and tattoo design generator app if you need instant inspiration for fonts art. The app supports:
- Thousands of inspirational and fun quotes
- A huge collection of pretty aesthetic letter fonts, from romantic cursive brushstroke scripts and calligraphy to classic traditional serif font families or fun outlined fonts
- AR letter tracing projector: elevate your letter tracing skills with our advanced tracing projector. Easily follow and trace your favourite fonts, cursive writing, or even tattoo lettering designs in an intuitive, immersive AR environment
- Alphabet letter tracing tutorials guiding you through the abc
- Save your favourite hand lettering or tattoo designs in your own gallery
- Edit mode to change handwriting fonts and styles
- Learn to draw decorative elements, borders and background styles
- All letter fonts, AR drawing mode and the tracing projector are available offline
- Worksheets and handwriting practice alphabets/abcd's to practice writing
- Letter design edit mode: unleash your creativity and craft stunning letter designs with an extensive library of aesthetic fonts, styles, and brushstroke options. Drag & drop to reposition elements, rotate texts, change letter spacing, add or copy text and images
The pro-version of the app unlocks:
- All brush, cursive, outlined, hand writing and other artistic fun letter fonts
- The possibility to enter your own text or name

bluejetty:00030324:ios.description:
Pulse+: Your All-in-One News and Podcast App 
Stay ahead of the global conversation with Pulse+, your go-to source for independent reporting from The National Pulse. Explore a broad array of topics influencing your daily life with exclusive investigative journalism. Discover exclusive podcasts featuring influential voices such as Raheem Kassam's "The Campaign Trail," Austen Fletcher's "Fleccas Talks," and Steve Bannon's "War Room." Tap into the pulse of politics, breaking news, and elections, all free to download and available at your fingertips.
Radically Independent Journalism 
With Pulse+, you are not just informed; you're ahead of the curve. Immerse yourself in live updates, breaking news, and compelling investigations. Explore counter-narrative commentaries that dare to challenge mainstream reporting, brought to you by our dedicated journalists stationed across North America and Europe.
Stay Ahead with Tailored Alerts
Be the first to know with personalized push notifications tailored to your interests. Stay informed with concise morning and evening briefings that keep you up to date. Delve deeper into the stories on politics, business, and more, exploring subjects that matter to you.
Premium Features for Subscribers 
As a Pulse+ subscriber, you're privy to exclusive insights and analysis you won't get anywhere else. Unlock access to The National Pulse quarterly magazine for an insider's view of Capitol Hill. Enjoy subscriber-only podcasts and newsletters, providing unrivaled insights into Washington's behind-the-scenes.
Payment and Automatic Renewal Terms:
When you subscribe to Pulse+ via this app, payment will be charged by Apple to your Apple ID account upon confirmation of purchase. Your Apple ID account will be automatically charged for renewal at the applicable rate shown to you at the time of subscription. Monthly subscriptions are billed every calendar month, while annual subscriptions are billed every year, both within 24 hours prior to the end of the current billing period. Your subscription fee will be charged in advance. If you do not wish to continue your subscription, please ensure you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period by turning off auto-renewal in your iTunes account settings. You have the freedom to turn off auto-renewal at any time. Cancellation will take effect at the end of the current billing period.
By downloading the Pulse+ app, you agree to:
• The automatic renewal terms stated above.
• The National Pulse Privacy Policy: Visit https://thenationalpulse.com/privacy-policy for details.
• The National Pulse Terms of Service: Explore the fiery details at https://thenationalpulse.com/terms-of-service.
• Take advantage of exclusive promotional offers available to new subscribers. Please note that smartphone and tablet apps may not be supported on all devices. News subscriptions do not include e-reader editions. All prices are listed in U.S. dollars. Additional restrictions may apply.
We appreciate your support and hope you enjoy the immersive news experience offered by Pulse+. For any questions or assistance, please reach out to our dedicated customer support team at members@thenationalpulse.com.

Welcome Pivot Point Books, the ultimate eBook reader designed specifically for individuals studying or working in the hair, beauty, and wellness profession. Discover a world of knowledge and enhance your skills with our extensive collection of educational books.

1. Comprehensive Library: Gain access to an extensive library of educational books that cover a wide range of topics in the hair, beauty, and wellness field. Our collection, available through your school's digital educational package, will provide valuable insights, techniques, and industry trends to help you excel in your career.
2. Interactive Reading Experience: Immerse yourself in an interactive reading experience with our user-friendly features. Take notes and jot down important ideas or observations as you read, helping you capture key points and personalize your learning journey.

4. Text-to-Speech: Listen to your favorite books with our built-in text-to-speech functionality. Experience a hands-free learning experience by having the text read aloud to you, allowing you to absorb knowledge while multitasking or on the go.

6. Offline Access: Download your favorite books and access them anytime, anywhere, even without an internet connection. Study on the go, whether you're commuting or attending a workshop, and never miss an opportunity to expand your knowledge.
7. Search and Discover: Easily find specific information within books using our powerful search feature. Discover new titles and explore related content to broaden your understanding of the industry. Stay up to date with the latest releases and recommended reads from Pivot Point's renowned authors.
Unlock the full potential of your hair, beauty, and wellness career. Download the app now, log in with your educational platform email and embark on a transformative educational experience that will empower you to succeed in this dynamic industry.

bluejetty:00029139:ios.name: Ally – Collect and Backup
bluejetty:00029139:ios.summary: Ally – Collect and Backup is the number one iPhone Amiibo collection app with the ability to add amiibo to your collection by simply scanning their NFC tags. The app works with n2, blank ntag215 tags or Powertags so you can quickly restore
bluejetty:00029139:ios.description:
Ally – Collect and Backup is the number one iPhone Amiibo collection app with the ability to add amiibo to your collection by simply scanning their NFC tags. The app works with n2, blank ntag215 tags or Powertags so you can quickly restore your backups there.
The app works offline, so you can always get access to your fantastic Amiibo collection any time anywhere, while your amiibo are still at home.
Ally supports the dark iOS theme. The theme was designed from scratch and looks fantastic. Check it out.
The app works with 753+ amiibo, including such series as Animal Crossing, Mario, Metroid, etc.
Ally is built with privacy in mind. That means that no data is sent to developers or any other third party. Ally does not send any amiibo data anywhere. Ally does not have any tracking tools in the app. All your amiibo data is stored privately under your iCloud account, and only you have access to it.
Features:
– Owned collection with the ability to add new amiibo by scanning their NFC tags or importing amiibo from files
– Get details of all available amiibo
– View amiibo game usage Information
– View Super Smash Bros. Ultimate amiibo game data (Level, Experience, Attack and Defence)
– View Midna & Wolf Link amiibo game data (Level and number of hearts)
– Support of all 6 Power-Up bands
– Global amiibo search
– Advanced filters bar, so you can search by name, game or amiibo series
– Add or remove amiibo you are hunting for to your wishlist
– Search Amazon for the toys you want to buy
– The app allows you to manage your N2 and Amiiqo NFC tags fully
– NTAG215 support
– Power Tags support
– Browse games that support amiibo on Switch, 3DS and WiiU consoles
– View all amiibo supported by a game with all the features
– Beautiful and user-friendly design
– The app uses CloudKit, so your data is secure and available on all your iPhones
– Full support of the iOS Dark Theme
* DISCLAIMER
Ally – Collect and Backup is an unofficial app for collectors and fans of amiibo and is intended only to be used for informational and educational purposes.
Ally – Collect and Backup is in no way affiliated with Nintendo. amiibo is a registered trademark of Nintendo. All items, names and other aspects are trademarked and owned by their respective owners.
*SUBSCRIPTION
Subscriptions will be charged to your credit card through your iTunes account.
Subscriptions will automatically renew unless cancelled within 24-hours before the end of the current period. You can cancel anytime with your iTunes account settings.
The auto-renewal subscriptions may be turned off by going to the iCloud Account Settings after purchase.
For more information, see our terms: https://ally.ninja/terms.html and privacy policy: https://ally.ninja/privacy.html.

Pregnancy Milestones | Baby Milestones | Big Kid Milestones
Parents-to-be and new parents, Baby Pics is made for you.
Capture precious pregnancy and baby milestone photos with beautifully crafted artwork and personalized text.
Mark your baby bump growth, first kick, first smile, messy moments, first steps, or first day at school.
Add adorable artwork and treasure the moment forever.
How it works
1) Snap the moment or choose from your camera roll
2) Add adorable artwork
3) Personalize with text
4) Save and share
APP FEATURES
MILESTONE ARTWORK
1000+ handcrafted illustrations to mark every moment, from bump to big kid
PERSONALIZED TEXT
Add baby’s name, dates, measurements, or sweet notes using adorable fonts
FILTERS
Apply beautiful filters to give your photos that extra glow
SHARE
Quickly share your Baby Pics via social media, text, or email
ARTWORK CATEGORIES (just a sneak peek)
DATES – Weeks, months, birthdays, due dates and more
FIRSTS – First smile, first kick, first steps and more
PREGNANCY – Belly updates, twins, overdue, fun quotes
HOLIDAYS – Christmas, Easter, Halloween and more
ANNOUNCEMENTS – Pregnancy news, birth, gender reveals
DAILY LIFE – Chubby cheeks, sleepyhead, story time
HUMOR – Milk drunk, poop explosion, eviction notice
BIG KIDS – Big milestones for growing kids
FRIENDS AND FAMILY – Grandma love, siblings, family time
DOODLES – Borders, hearts, stars and playful scribbles
PRO AI – Wonder-Filled Creations, Powered by Magic
Bring your baby's moments to life like never before with Baby Pics PRO AI.
Create unforgettable keepsakes in just a tap:
• Amazing Animations
 Turn photos into soft plush toys, adorable cartoons, retro game sprites, and dreamy anime-style characters.
• Collectable Moments
 Transform memories into limited-edition keepsakes with themes like Superhero, Birthday, First Holidays, Space Cadet, Woodland Fox, and more.
• Baby Blockbusters
 Star your little one in a cinematic poster adventure. Choose from royalty, racing champs, sleepy legends, bedtime detectives and more.
• Storybook Stars
 Turn your child into the hero of their own illustrated storybook. Magical balloon rides, jungle naps, dragon tamers and sleepy space explorers, all tailored to your baby's age and features.
• Coloring Book Scenes
 Create black-and-white line art featuring your child in world landmarks, fantasy scenes, or seasonal fun. Perfect for printing and coloring together.
Every creation is based on your actual photo, with age-accurate features and real baby expressions. No avatars, no presets. Just magical memories, made personal.
More playful AI tools arriving soon.
• Magic Cut (All users)
Easily lift your baby from any photo — no editing skills needed. With one tap, place them into 60+ beautifully crafted scenes, including holiday moments and playful face-swap fun.
Follow us on Instagram @BabyPicsApp and tag #BabyPicsApp to be featured
Need help? Email support@babypicsapp.com

bluejetty:00117883:android.summary:
And on the way? The Fritz app!

bluejetty:00117883:android.description:
And on the way? The Fritz app!
Fritz is the young digital brand of Rundfunk Berlin-Brandenburg (rbb). You can find us on all relevant social media channels and online at fritz.de. Also on the radio inside. And in the FritzApp for smartphones and tablets. And you can get it here.
What's going on? what was going
With the FritzApp you can hear us in the live stream and send us messages directly to the studio. In the app you can also find out what is and was currently on our radio: from titles, artists, playlists, programs, moderators to current Fritz campaigns. You can save your favorite titles, audios and podcasts on the favorites list.
++ NEW ++ With our timeshift player you can now jump back to the last hours of the live stream. Back to the past, so to speak. Missed the show or news? No problem - just slide the timeline to the left or directly select the element you missed and want to listen to from the playlist. Have fun!
Talk to us!
The FritzApp has the Studiomessage inside - a messenger with which you can text us in full. We also take a nice photo, a video or a voice message.
read feed! listen to music streams! Download Podcasts! And the jingles!
Brand new is our feed, where you can read and hear things you shouldn't miss. You can also listen to the music streams of the last seven days. In addition, all FritzJingles and the current podcasts to listen to, subscribe to and download.
And otherwise?
The Fritz app is free. Tip: Listening to the radio is data-intensive (at 128 kbit/s around 60 megabytes per hour). If you want to hear us longer, you should have a data flat rate.
And now: Pampe Marinski from now twelve! Oh no, the other sentence: Load the FritzApp!

bluejetty:00033001:ios.developer: Pocket Games Entertainment Sp. z o.o.
bluejetty:00033001:ios.summary: Welcome to the 3D world of adorable kittens, where you can live the life of a cute little kitty! Step into this fun and engaging cat simulator, where you can create and care for your very own virtual pet. Your kitten is ready to explore a c
bluejetty:00033001:ios.description:
Welcome to the 3D world of adorable kittens, where you can live the life of a cute little kitty! Step into this fun and engaging cat simulator, where you can create and care for your very own virtual pet. Your kitten is ready to explore a colorful cartoon-style world filled with excitement, challenges, and adventures!
Game Features:
Create Your Own Kitten
Start by designing your own little kitten! Choose from a variety of cute and unique cat breeds, colors, and eye styles to make your kitty look just the way you want. Add fun accessories, skins, and costumes to customize your pet even more and make them stand out in the crowd. Wings, hats, and even tiny vehicles will make your kitten the most stylish pet around!
Care for Your Kitten
In this game, your kitten needs love and attention. Feed, clean, and play with your virtual pet to keep them happy and healthy. The more you care for your kitten, the stronger your bond will grow. Your kitty will be by your side as you explore new places, make friends, and take on exciting challenges.
Play Fun Mini-Games
A whole collection of mini-games awaits! Join your kitty on thrilling adventures, collecting coins and leveling up as you go. These games help you gain experience to level up your cat and earn currency that you can use to buy accessories and unlock special items.
Explore a Colorful 3D World
Wander through a vibrant 3D world that’s filled with exciting locations to explore. Run through open fields, climb rooftops, and find hidden treasures scattered across the world. Meet other animals like ratty friends and new furry buddies who’ll join you on your adventures. You’ll be amazed at the interactive areas and surprises that make every visit unique.
Join the Online Community
Connect with other players in the online mode! Chat with friends, join games together, and make new friends from around the world. Participate in fun challenges or relax and enjoy each other’s company in peaceful settings. You can even show off your kitten’s new look and stylish accessories to other players. The online world is full of friendly kittens just waiting to play and explore together!
Exciting Customization Options
Let your creativity shine! Choose from a wide range of accessories, costumes, and fun items to make your kitty look unique. Dress up your kitties with adorable outfits, magical wings, and quirky hats, or even give them a vehicle for an extra boost of style! With so many options, your kitties can have a new look every day.

Transform Your Selfies into Artistic Masterpieces!
Welcome to Avatar Maker, where your selfies are not just photos - they're the canvas for AI-driven artistry and fantasy.
【 Key Features】
- AI Photo Filter: Our AI filter takes a user's photo and changes everything but the face, shifting you into a whole new realm of fantasy! On a crowded beach? Not a problem - our AI filter will transport you to a tranquil forest or a fantasy world in a snap. Want to rock a different look? The AI can even alter your outfit. Remember, your face stays the same in the initial photo.
- AI Avatar Maker: Get a pack of art avatars tailored specifically to you. Our AI uses your selfies to build a unique model of your face and presents you in fascinating fantasy situations - from a pirate, a spaceman, to an Egypt queen!
- Regular Updates: We're always expanding our art and fantasy collections, ensuring you have fresh and exciting transformations to explore.
【Why Avatarro?】
In today's digital age, selfies are more than just pictures; they're a form of self-expression. Avatar Maker takes this to the next level by allowing you to express yourself in ways you've never imagined. Dive into a world where AI meets art, and every selfie is an opportunity for a new masterpiece.
【Join the Artistic Revolution!】
Don't let your selfies be ordinary. Elevate them into the realms of art and fantasy with Avatar Maker.
By using Avatarro, you agree to our Terms of Use (https://kallossoft.com/avatar-terms-and-conditions) and acknowledge our Privacy Policy (https://kallossoft.com/avatar-privacy-policy). Today with the My Marshfield Clinic app, you can:
• Schedule, cancel or reschedule appointments
• View upcoming and past appointments
• Prepare for your appointments with pre-check in
• Message your care team about health concerns and questions
• View conditions, diagnoses, vitals, immunizations and allergies
• View test results, including labs, microbiology, pathology, and radiology
• View clinical notes
• View referral details
• Refill prescriptions at a Marshfield Clinic pharmacy
• Assess your symptoms with a nurse using chat, video and call
• Pay a bill
• Do all of the above for yourself and those you care for
For most customers, sign up takes just minutes. Get access to great health care at your fingertips, download the My Marshfield Clinic app today.

Access to great health care shouldn't be complicated. That's why we're bringing you My Marshfield Clinic, as a new app. The app makes it easy to access features and information quickly and securely with optional fingerprint or face sign in, saving you time and hassle.

Today with the My Marshfield Clinic app, you can:
•	Schedule, cancel or reschedule appointments
•	View upcoming and past appointments
•	Prepare for your appointments with pre-check in
•	Message your care team about health concerns and questions
•	View conditions, diagnoses, vitals, immunizations and allergies
•	View test results, including labs, microbiology, pathology, and radiology
•	View clinical notes
•	View referral details
•	Refill prescriptions at a Marshfield Clinic pharmacy
•	Assess your symptoms with a nurse using chat, video and call
•	Pay a bill
•	Do all of the above for yourself and those you care for

For most customers, sign up takes just minutes. Get access to great health care at your fingertips, download the My Marshfield Clinic app today.

bluejetty:00096154:ios.description:
MyGrowth – your go-to app for microlearning!
Tired of mindlessly scrolling? Time to end doomscrolling and turn those spare moments into real growth. MyGrowth gives you quick, fun microlearning lessons you can read or listen to anywhere.
No heavy textbooks, no boring lectures — just bite-sized learning that fits your day. Whether you’re into Biology, Anatomy, History, Math, Art, Communication, or other themes, our microlearning lessons are built to keep you curious and help your knowledge stick.
Why you’ll love MyGrowth:
- Short daily bite-sized lessons — easy to start, hard to quit
- Read or listen — pick your vibe
- Learn easily with short videos every day
- Fun quizzes to lock in your knowledge
- Track your streaks and achievements for visible self-growth
- Fresh topics for expanding your general knowledge
Perfect for anyone who wants learning apps for adults that work. Just a few minutes a day can boost your focus, improve your memory, and help with self-improvement.
Instead of wasting another hour online, use MyGrowth to stop doomscrolling and fill your brain with something new. We believe microlearning is the easiest way to make learning a habit. Each microlearning lesson is designed for quick wins, but also for long-term self-growth. And with flexible formats, learning becomes part of your day without effort. Download MyGrowth today — and make every scroll count toward your knowledge and your goals.
SUBSCRIPTION
The app offers the following subscription plans: a monthly plan at $24.99 with a 7-day free trial, and a yearly plan at $69.99. After downloading the app, you can select the subscription option that best fits your goals.
Your MyGrowth subscription automatically renews at the end of each period (monthly, yearly, or according to the selected plan) unless it is canceled.
If you choose to cancel, you will continue to have full access to all features until the end of your current period. When a free trial is activated, the subscription fee shown on the payment screen will be charged automatically for the selected period unless the trial is canceled at least 24 hours before it ends.
Please note that removing the app from your device does not cancel your subscription. To manage or cancel your subscription, go to Settings → [your name] → Subscription → Select MyGrowth, then tap Cancel.
Privacy Policy: https://quiz.mygrowth.one/privacy-policy
Terms of Service: https://quiz.mygrowth.one/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00117645:ios.description:
Welcome to the world of Merge Farm! the newest farming and merge game from Gram Games.
Merge Farm! isn’t your average farming game. Use merging mechanics to achieve your task to grow your farm, and harvest delicious fruits and veggies. 
Plant tons of crops across your farm and merge those crops to grow bigger plants that produce more fruit and veggies! Take your massive harvest and sell them to grow your farm even further! What are you waiting for, let’s start merging your farm!
Merge Farm! Features:
Plant & Merge Crops:
• Plant crops of varying types on your field, as they become available.
• Merge similar crops, and they will grow or upgrade, providing a larger harvest.
• The bigger your plants, the more fruit and vegetables they will produce.
Manage Your Farm
• Farming is endless, which means you’ll need to manage your farm daily.
• Choose where to plant crops, place animals, and more.
• Decorate by placing garden gnomes, tractors and more around the farm.
Harvest Like a Farmer
• As all good farmers know, it takes time for crops to produce delicious fruit.
• You can harvest crops whenever, but keep an eye out for the orders from your traveling merchant at the top of the screen.
• Fill those orders to make money, buy more crops and grow your farm.
Think you can merge and harvest crops to build up your farm? Keep merging your crops to discover new forms and upgrades, and see how great your farm can grow.
Download Merge Farm! today and start farming!
Use of this application is governed by Zynga’s Terms of Service, found at www.zynga.com/legal/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00060743:ios.summary:
Basic Shapes help building the memory and cognitive skills as the brain starts to relate real world objects with the basic shapes.
Memorizing the 2D Shapes and 3D shapes helps the young minds to relate the real world objects with shapes th
bluejetty:00060743:ios.description:
Basic Shapes help building the memory and cognitive skills as the brain starts to relate real world objects with the basic shapes.
Memorizing the 2D Shapes and 3D shapes helps the young minds to relate the real world objects with shapes that develops communication skills, basic cognition and cognitive abilities and also helps in mathematics and geometry later in their age.
Shapes Flashcards & Activities is teaches the young minds about basic 2D shapes and 3D shapes using fun to learn interactive educational activities.
The app is baked with three activities that provides an ideal amount of knowledge about shapes. It helps to memorize the basic shapes (square, rectangle, circle, etc), advanced shapes (pentagon, hexagon etc) and 3D shapes (sphere, cylinder, cube, pyramid, prism etc) using mini games that keeps motivated to repeatedly use the app.
The first of them is a Shape Flashcard activity that uses spaced repetition technique. This technique teaches the shapes subconsciously in 8 months to 2 years. It presents the shapes in an adequate size on the screen and helps the parents and teachers to easily present basic shapes in the homes and in the classroom.
The app also has a drag and match shapes activity. It is a fun activity that not only teaches the basic shapes but also develops hand-eye coordination. This is suitable for 2 years to 4 years of age.
Touch the Shape is a fun and adaptive shapes quiz that keep asking to touch the required shape. 
The app works as an interactive first book of shapes that proves its value over time. It is far better to provide educational activity apps rather than uncontrolled youtube streaming.
The app is provided in 6 different languages and two voiceovers are provided for every language.
The app is an educational resource and is ideal to be used as a reinforcement tool to teach the shapes in Montessori, PreK, Nursery, kindergarten students.
—— Activities ——
Shape Flashcard
Drag and Match Shapes
Touch the Shape
—— Features —— 
- Carefully selected shapes and colors
- Multiple Fonts are provided
- Shapes Quiz
- Available in six different languages (English, French, Spanish, Italian, German and Russian)
- Carefully designed user interface.
- 2 Studio quality Voiceovers
- High Quality Pictures
- Animations and Sound
We at Holiday Educationist have a team of certified teachers onboard to consult and proof-read the apps' content for the optimum quality assurance.
