bluejetty:00159339:ios.description:
Discover a world of tranquility, focus, and wellness with Theta Waves, the ultimate app for sleep, meditation, relaxation, and personal growth. With a variety of sounds, including Theta Waves, Binaural Beats, Healing Frequencies, Rain Sounds, and White Noise, this app helps you unlock your potential and achieve balance in mind and body.
What is Theta Waves?
Theta Waves is designed to harmonize your brainwaves and guide you into states of relaxation, deep focus, or restful sleep. Whether you’re looking to relax after a stressful day, meditate more deeply, or focus on work, Theta Waves has something for everyone. With carefully curated sounds and visuals, the app helps you reduce stress, improve sleep, enhance creativity, and much more.
Key Features
1. Diverse Sound Library
Explore a vast collection of audio options, including:
- Theta Waves: For meditation and accessing the subconscious mind.
- Binaural Beats & Brainwaves: To enhance focus, creativity, and learning.
- Healing Frequencies: Support cell regeneration, reduce stress, and promote emotional balance.
- Nature Sounds: Immerse yourself in calming rain, ocean waves, and forest ambiances.
- White Noise: Perfect for blocking distractions and improving sleep.
2. Custom Timers
Set your preferred listening time, from short meditation sessions to full-night sleep aids. The app adapts to your schedule, giving you complete control over your experience.
3. Scientifically Backed Sounds
Using brainwave entrainment techniques, Theta Waves syncs your brain activity with specific frequencies to help you achieve your desired mental state—whether that’s deep sleep, focus, or relaxation.
How Theta Waves Helps You
- Sleep Better: Drift into deep, restorative sleep with Delta waves and soothing sounds.
- Relax Deeply: Let go of stress and tension with calming nature sounds and healing frequencies.
- Focus Longer: Boost productivity with binaural beats and alpha waves that keep you in the zone.
- Meditate More Effectively: Enhance your mindfulness practice with Theta and Delta waves designed for deep introspection.
- Unlock Creativity: Stimulate your subconscious mind for vivid visualizations and creative breakthroughs.
- Reduce Stress: Balance your emotions and promote a sense of calm with healing sounds.
- Boost Memory and Learning: Improve cognitive performance and mental clarity with brainwave entrainment.
Why Choose Theta Waves?
Theta Waves is more than just an audio app—it’s a complete tool for improving mental and emotional well-being. Designed with the latest in neuroscience and sound therapy, it offers effective, easy-to-use solutions for everyday challenges like sleepless nights, lack of focus, and stress.
Perfect for Everyone
Whether you’re a busy professional, a student, or simply seeking peace of mind, Theta Waves helps you:
- Fall asleep faster and wake up refreshed.
- Stay focused and productive for longer.
- Relax deeply and recharge after a long day.
- Meditate effectively and connect with your inner self.
Start Your Journey Today
With Theta Waves, better sleep, focus, and relaxation are just a tap away. Join thousands of users who have transformed their lives with the power of sound.
Premium Access
Unlock the full sound library and all advanced features with auto‑renewable subscriptions:
Monthly access: $9.99 / month
Annual access: $39.99 / year, Eligible new users enjoy a 3‑day free trial. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID if you do not cancel before the trial ends.
All subscriptions auto‑renew unless auto‑renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the current period expires.

bluejetty:00119842:ios.description:
***Thank you for viewing! Thank you for downloading!
This is the most difficult, unique and addictive puzzle game in the world! This game does not require any preliminary knowledge, but demands huge observations, great patience and challenging spirit! Everyone from children to adult people can fully enjoy it while testing and demonstrating his IQ.
***Game goal
Clear the board by removing two same tiles each time as quickly as possible.
***How to remove
Condition 1: If two same tiles are on the same row or column and there are no other tiles between them, tap to remove them directly.
Condition 2: If one tile can be moved to a new position where Condition 1 can be met by this tile and the other same tile, move this tile first and then tap the other to remove these two same tiles.
***Options
*You can change the color combination among three screen colors, three text-background colors, and two text colors.
*You have two chances for both Hints and Undo.
*You can announce your scores via Email, Facebook or Twitter.
*Supports Chinese, English, Japanese, Traditional Chinese, French, German, Italian, Dutch, Spanish, Russian and Swedish.
*Auto save game.
*Supports landscape. For free version, this can enlarge the play area. 
***Scores
Three types of scores will be reported to Game Center’s leaderboards, i.e., Best time, total numbers of Completion and total number of Stars. In addition, achievements have five levels and five glory stages.
***Related App
While ABC Solitaire tends to use your left side of brain. related Zhongyuan Mahjong (Solitaire) which adopts the same game rule tends to use your right side of brain, Tens of thousands of people have already been deeply addicted to Zhongyuan Mahjong (Solitaire), and the number are growing very fast. They are enjoying and challenging it day by day, again and again. You are also warmly welcomed to have a try of Zhongyuan Mahjong.

https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
****Banner Ads
In order to support feature improvement and sustainabity, banner ad is introduced. However, users can still play at offline mode and report offline scores to Game Center. 
Inn order to enable users to remove ads at a reasonable amount payment, auto-renewable subscription is inntroduced.

bluejetty:00031154:ios.description:
Boom Blocks is a block puzzle inspired by classic block games. Our puzzle game is incredibly relaxing and helps you train your brain! Increase your IQ by playing our block jigsaw puzzle!
Do you like block puzzle games? Do you love games with cubes and games that train your brain and attention span? Then you’re sure to love Boom Blocks, the best free block puzzle game!
Boom Block is a free puzzle game for lovers of jigsaw puzzles, block games, merge games and brain training games. It may seem simple at first, but the longer you play and the better you get, the more complex it becomes. Easy to play, hard to master!
Special features of the Boom Blocks puzzle game:
- A block puzzle for all ages inspired by classic block games
- Two modes: Endless and Levels
- Complete Levels and unlock amazing puzzles
- You can play offline. Enjoy the game wherever you are
- A completely free jigsaw puzzle game
How to play a block puzzle:
- Drag blocks onto the playing field
- Fill lines and columns to remove them from the field and earn points
- Place all the blocks on the field
Lifehacks for getting lots of points in this game:
- Train your brain to use empty space to make it easy to place the oncoming shapes
- Remove several lines/columns at a time to earn more points
- Differently shaped blocks have different best positions
You can make puzzle combos. Drag shapes onto the field and complete lines or columns. The removal of several lines or columns will show amazing animations and give you bonus points. The more lines or columns you remove at the same time, the more points you will earn.

bluejetty:00146885:ios.name: Epsy: Seizure Log for Epilepsy
bluejetty:00146885:ios.summary: Join the #1 app for epilepsy. With Epsy, seizure tracking has never been easier, think of us as your daily companion to help you track your seizures, meds routine, and everything else that matters. Then, share your data with your care team
bluejetty:00146885:ios.description:
Join the #1 app for epilepsy. With Epsy, seizure tracking has never been easier, think of us as your daily companion to help you track your seizures, meds routine, and everything else that matters. Then, share your data with your care team to help you accelerate your journey to your best possible treatment. 
We are on a mission to give the world a better way to live with seizures and epilepsy. Some of Epsy's recognitions:
*** CES 2021 Best of Innovation Award for Health and Wellness
*** CES 2021 Innovation Award for Software and Mobile Apps
*** Google Design Award 2020
*** Webby Awards 2021
*** FastCompany, Innovation by Design 2021
***UCSF Digital Health Awards 2021
With Epsy you gain a clearer view of your epilepsy, making it easier for you to spot patterns and trends. Your information can be shared with your healthcare team for improved conversations in every appointment, our goal is to make each day with epilepsy brighter than the last. 
Features included in the app:
RECEIVE MEDICATION REMINDERS & FOLLOW MED PLANS
Get medication reminders when your next dose is due. Use the app to set up your medication plan, get useful pill reminder nudges to help you remember and keep track of your meds as well as how they make you feel. You can also add as needed medications, along with any emergency medications used.
TRACK SEIZURES, SIDE EFFECTS, AURAS AND MORE
When you have a seizure or other relevant experience, open up Epsy and log the event. Doing this regularly helps you understand your epilepsy better, and makes the information more holistic. While logging a seizure you can add seizure types, notes, whether you used a medical device swipe or any emergency medications.
GET INSIGHTS AND FEEL MORE IN CONTROL
Gain clarity and get a sense of control with your epilepsy, by seeing how your condition changes over time. The more you log, the more Epsy can help you. Log meds, moods and more daily and after a week you’ll see useful stats in the Insights view. Get personalized insights and see trends on your seizures and side effects progress.
CONNECT YOUR EPILEPSY REPORT WITH YOUR DOCTOR
Got a doctor appointment coming up? It can be difficult to tell your doctor everything that happened since your last appointment, with Epsy you can share overview information with your healthcare team. Your physician can see overviews of everything you have logged for more informed conversations, without missing any important details. Getting you towards your optimal treatment as soon as possible.
LEARN MORE ABOUT SEIZURES AND EPILEPSY
Separate fact from fiction with a wide variety of useful, interesting articles Epsy is a community with stories from others living with epilepsy and a range of topics from lifestyle and wellness to alternative treatment options . Read reliable information to help you on every step of your epilepsy journey .
WORKS WITH APPLE WATCH
Use Apple Watch to make your logging even easier and faster.
WORKS WITH APPLE HEALTH APP
Epsy and Apple Health app work seamlessly together, enabling easier health tracking with your health and wellness information all in one place.
OFFERS iOS16 LOCK SCREEN WIDGETS
With the Epsy widget, you can have the important things for your day all in one place. Plus, it lets you log your meds and seizures, without you having to open the app.
Use Epsy for your daily medication reminders and your seizure tracking. Get to know your triggers, learn more about how your mood, sleep, diet, and other factors, can affect your condition. Share deep, personalized insights with your doctor: Show up for every appointment with all the information you need to advocate for yourself, by giving your healthcare team everything they need to know. 
Live better with Epilepsy with Epsy.
Works with iOS 16, Apple Health and Apple Watch.
Works with iPhone, iPad, iPod Touch. This app is optimized for iPhone 14 Pro, iPhone 14, iPhone 13, iPhone 12, and iPhone SE.

bluejetty:00144708:ios.summary:
Enhance your motorcycle life with greater convenience, peace of mind and enjoyment through Y-Connect.
By Connecting your smartphone with Y-Connect installed and your motorcycle, we provide greater motorcycling convenience and support your
bluejetty:00144708:ios.description:
Enhance your motorcycle life with greater convenience, peace of mind and enjoyment through Y-Connect.
By Connecting your smartphone with Y-Connect installed and your motorcycle, we provide greater motorcycling convenience and support your motorcycle through this application. In addition, this application provides a new level of enjoyment by connecting you with Yamaha users all over the world. 
*Functions vary depending on the connecting model. For details, please refer to the URL below.
https://global.yamaha-motor.com/business/mc/connectivity/
CONFIRMED COMPATIBILITY WITH
iOS 17 and UP
CONFIRMED USABLE DEVICES 
Smartphones 
*Compatibility/usability checks are conducted under set conditions. Please be aware that the app may not function properly with all smartphones or operating systems. 
NOTES ON USAGE 
• The app and its features are all free to use, but any fees resulting from downloading the app itself and any data transmitted while using it will be borne by the user. 
• The app can only be used with models equipped with a Yamaha Communication Control Unit (CCU). 
• You must connect your motorcycle to the app via Bluetooth before using the app. Refer to your motorcycle’s Owner’s Manual. 
• Only errors that generate error codes are detected by the app. 
• The app will not track your motorcycle if it has been moved from its last parking location. 
• The app uses your smartphone’s GPS and Bluetooth functions, which may drain battery life faster. 
• Some smartphones may be disconnected from the app due to battery or power-saving settings. Check your smartphone’s user manual or provider for details. 
• Creating an account with YamahaMotorID is required to use the app. 
WARNING! 
• Always stop the vehicle before operating your smartphone. 
• Never take your hands off the handlebars while riding. 
• Always concentrate on riding by keeping your eyes and mind on the road. 
• Read the owner's manual carefully before operating the vehicle. 
Y-Connect app asks for the following device permissions as needed:
• Camera: To scan vehicle’s QR code
• Contacts: To select from phone contacts where to send malfunction notice
• Location: To pair the vehicle and utilize the map
• Phone: To display incoming call on the meter panel
• Files: To change vehicle’s image

Used by more than 400,000 truck drivers and carriers across the U.S., Relay's
bluejetty:00147374:ios.description:
Relay's instant digital payments help truck drivers simplify how they pay for discounted fuel, lumper fees, scales, parking reservations, and other OTR expenses.
Used by more than 400,000 truck drivers and carriers across the U.S., Relay's solution removes the need for cash or checks to make payments. By downloading the Relay app, truck drivers can find and pay less for fuel at participating merchants, pay lumper fees at more than 90% of warehouses, pay for scales, and locate and book parking spots along their route.
PAY LESS FOR FUEL: Instantly use Relay's cardless digital payments to purchase fuel along your route. Relay's innovative payment solution ensures complete pricing transparency, requires no lengthy activations or card applications, and can provide substantial fuel discounts at participating truck stops.
PAY LUMPERS: Drivers can save 20+ minutes on the dock and get back on the road faster by using Relay for unloading payments. No more late-night phone calls or lost receipts. Relay removes the need to phone to verify fleet check numbers with dispatchers and gets drivers off the dock and back on the road faster. 
PAY FOR SCALES: Make digital payments for scales at CAT Scale locations and other merchant locations. 
PARK YOUR TRUCK: Locate and reserve overnight parking with Relay's GPS-enabled app. You can explore parking along your route, identify locations with open spots, book your reservation, and pay for parking, all from the safety and comfort of your cabin. 
Relay arms truck drivers with an intuitive mobile app that lets them seamlessly pay for OTR expenses at our merchant partners, secure and pay less for fuel, capture invoices, and save valuable service hours. We are committed to building modern, digital solutions and offering best-in-class 24/7 U.S.- based customer service to help streamline payment processes in an underserved industry. 
Download the app today. Share your ideas and feedback at info@relaypayments.com.

Coin Identifier: Scanner Value is the all-in-one AI-powered tool for identifying, valuing, and organizing coins.
With a smart camera scanner and real-time pricing, you can instantly recognize any coin, learn its details, and manage your entire coin collection with ease.
Perfect for both beginners and professional numismatists, this app delivers accurate results and keeps all your coin data neatly organized in one place.
Key Features
IDENTIFY COINS INSTANTLY
- Quickly identify any coin by simply taking a photo.
- The AI scanner detects the coin’s name, denomination, country, and year in seconds.
- Works for modern, rare, and collectible coins worldwide.
CHECK REAL-TIME COIN VALUE
- Instantly view the market value of any coin with live pricing data.
- Get accurate estimates based on collector trends and verified market insights.
- Perfect for selling, buying, or tracking your collection’s worth.
EXPLORE DETAILED COIN INFORMATION
- Discover in-depth details including origin, metal, mintage, and history.
- Learn interesting facts and background stories behind each coin.
- Ideal for educational use or professional research.
ORGANIZE YOUR COIN COLLECTION
- Digitally store, categorize, and sort your entire collection.
- Easily track what you own and monitor changes in value over time.
- Access your collection anytime, anywhere.
Enjoy a smart, accurate, and effortless coin identification experience.
Premium Subscription
Upgrade to Premium to unlock all features: unlimited coin scans, advanced AI recognition, real-time market values, and enhanced collection management tools.

- Weekly subscription (with 3-day free trial) at $7.99/week
- Yearly subscription at $29.99/year

– Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, at the same price of $7.99/week or $29.99/year.
– You can manage subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal in your Account Settings after purchase.

Out exploring on your snowmobile? Take your own mobile trail assistant for the ride!
**NEW THIS SEASON**
► Track your trips: leave breadcrumbs for easier backtracking, get statistics on your distance traveled, and much more!
► List your equipment: keep track of how much distance you covered with a specific vehicle and keep notes on each one.
► Evaluate the SnowTours: rate and see the ratings of the SnowTours near you to ensure the best possible experience!
► Subscription to Trails! Create a route, open a SnowTour, and subscribe to be notified and to know when your route or your SnowTour is opened or closed! 
*****
The Ontario Federation of Snowmobile Clubs (OFSC) brings an enhanced version of its web application to your pockets, making for a better riding experience than ever. Working both with and WITHOUT mobile data coverage, you will be able to enjoy the app’s functionalities no matter where you are on the trails.
This app gives you access to the following *OFFLINE* features, anywhere, anytime, even in areas without cell coverage:
► See your location on the map through your phone’s GPS signal
► View nearby restaurants, gas stations, hotels, parking and other services
► Access the trails conditions as per the last data connection available
► See the distance between you and a specific point
► Quickly save and load itineraries
Getting back to a zone with mobile coverage? Enjoy these additional *ONLINE* features :
► Keep an eye on updated trail statuses for the best riding experience
► Easily meet with friends by sharing your position with each other (no one else can see your location)
► Plan out an itinerary and share it with your group
Welcome to the GoSnowmobiling Ontario mobile experience and enjoy the ride!
Notes:
►Continued use of the GPS and location sharing running in the background can significantly increase battery consumption. It is recommended to toggle it off when not needed to improve autonomy.
The Pro Version is a 4.99$ CAD per year auto-renewable subscription. Payment will be charged to the iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s account settings after purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. The account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase.

bluejetty:00145431:ios.summary:
Do you thrive on the thrill of survival in futuristic robot RPG adventure games?
Step into the world of robot wars in Junkineering: a turn-based futuristic RPG where engineering meets irony and survival depends on your wits. Fight in chaot
bluejetty:00145431:ios.description:
Do you thrive on the thrill of survival in futuristic robot RPG adventure games?
Step into the world of robot wars in Junkineering: a turn-based futuristic RPG where engineering meets irony and survival depends on your wits. Fight in chaotic robot wars and robot shooting games, master every robot fight in intense robot games battles, and conquer a world shaped by apocalypse.
Assemble a squad of custom robots crafted from everyday junk, each brought to life by an AI-core brain. Dominate the arena in tactical robot wars, where every move defines your fate in this mix of survival, strategy, and post-apocalyptic irony.
POST-APOCALYPTIC SURVIVAL
Immerse yourself in a desolate wasteland scarred by an apocalypse. Resource scarcity and tech advancements create a narrative inspired by real-world challenges. Survival is not just a goal; it’s the essence of every clash in this unforgiving setting.
CRAFT AND COLLECT
Engineer your ultimate squad! Collect scrap, build robots with unique abilities, and upgrade them to face the fiercest enemies. Crafting is key to making your squad an unstoppable force.
DYNAMIC FIGHTING & AUTO-BATTLE
Engage in thrilling PvE battles. Balance strategic gameplay with chaotic unpredictability. Each fight is a test of skills: win through clever tactics or use the convenient auto-battle mode to let your squad crush enemies on their own!
TEAM-BASED STRATEGY
Form a squad of ironclad heroes and coordinate your actions to unleash devastating combos on your enemies. Surviving is much easier with a team you can trust.
TOWER PROTOCOLS & EPIC BOSSES
Challenge yourself in our unique Tower modes! Conquer 1,000 floors in the general Apex Protocol, or master the elemental Rock-Paper-Scissors mechanics in the Stoneborn (Rock), Scorchdoc (Scissors), and Shredbyte (Paper) Protocols. Defeat hordes of monsters and mighty bosses for valuable prizes, and complete daily quests to level up fast!
PvP ARENA & TOURNAMENTS
Test your tactical skills in asynchronous PvP battles against other players' squads! Participate in intense tournaments and championships, earn rare resources, and climb to the top of the leaderboards. Prove who truly rules the arena!
ENGINEERING WITH IRONY
Build not just robots, but legends! Experience a gameplay full of wit and surprises. The humor and irony woven into the narrative add a unique charm. Engineering isn’t just functional; it’s an art.
EPIC REWARDS
Unlock powerful new heroes, weapons, maps, and game modes. Collect rare loot and celebrate your triumphs. The more you fight and explore, the greater your legendary rewards.
Junkineering is more than just a game; it’s a clash of survival, engineering, and fighting spirit. Master the art of engineering and turn the junk of yesterday into the legends of tomorrow!
Are you ready to engineer your survival, conquer the apocalypse, and become a legend? Download Junkineering today and experience the ultimate RPG adventure!

bluejetty:00131837:ios.description:
iWeaveiIt is drawdown app for designing hand weaving patterns. It was developed by the same people who did WeaveIt for the PC Windows environment. The single purchase of iWeaveIt will download to both your iPhone and your iPad. 
The iWeaveIt app supports Apple’s human interface guidelines with many of Apple's features. It uses gestures and touches for draft manipulation. This makes the program easy to use on the iPhone, iPod and iPad. The many animations give the program pizazz. The result is a fun and enticing program to create and view weaving drafts. 
√ Zoom with gestures, double click and two finger click similar to Apple’s Map program.
√ Create and edit threading, treadling, and tieup for your drafts with multiple edit functions ( cut, copy, paste, flip, wrap, and change colors).
√ Supports lift plans.
√ Multiple levels of undo are available for editing.
√ Create custom color palettes.
√ Reads and writes WIF files. 
√ Export your pattern drafts as WIF files via email, iCloud or save to local storage and transfer with iTunes.
√ Import WIF files into iWeaveIt from email or internet (www.handweaving.net) with only one click. WIF files are recognized for iWeaveIt and load immediately.
√ Sync files using iCloud between all your devices (iPhone, iPod, iPad and Macintosh, Windows PC).
√ Print the draft to your air printer. You do not have to email or transfer your file to another computer.
√ View one repeat of the design or multiple repeats to get a feel for how the whole cloth will look.
Editing allows up to 8 shafts on iPhone and 24 shafts on iPad. 
The following modules are now included with the app at original purchase
√ Yarn and Project Management
√ Tracking your threading or treadling while you weave
√ Designer One -- Add Tabby, Turn Drafts, Find Floats,

bluejetty:00092707:ios.description:
At Honey Bee Stamps, we believe creativity should be sweet, joyful, and a little bit magical. Since 2015, we’ve been on a mission to celebrate and support your creative journey with the very best crafting supplies... designed to inspire and made to last.
Born in Oregon’s beautiful Willamette Valley, Honey Bee Stamps began as a dream project when founder Melissa Elliott combined her passion for paper crafting with her background in graphic design. What started as a small, family-run business quickly took flight, growing into a beloved brand known for quality, innovation, and heart.
Every product we create is thoughtfully designed to help makers like you bring your ideas to life. From our original clear stamps... made from premium photopolymer for crisp, beautiful impressions to our 100% steel dies, luxurious paper pads, 3D embossing folders, stencils, embellishments, and so much more, we’re here to spark your imagination and make crafting even more fun.
Whether you’re making heartfelt cards, keepsake treasures, or simply creating for the joy of it, Honey Bee Stamps is here to cheer you on every step of the way. Because at the end of the day, it’s not just about crafting... it’s about creating something beautiful, meaningful, and uniquely you.

bluejetty:00076072:ios.description:
IMS Care is your personal gateway to superior care management and enhanced patient experience. With convenient features designed to empower patients to take charge of managing their care, IMS Care makes your healthcare journey smoother and more efficient than ever.
As a HIPAA-compliant mobile app and online patient portal in one, IMS Care simplifies your healthcare processes, from effortless payment and medication management to seamless appointment scheduling and more. With IMS Care, a healthier you is just a tap away.
Take Control of Your Care With IMS Care
Effortless Appointment Booking:
Schedule appointments with ease at your convenience. Select your preferred provider and receive instant confirmation without the need to talk to a representative. Experience convenient appointment booking with IMS Care. 
Secure Communication:
Connect with your healthcare provider securely through our messaging feature. Say goodbye to phone tag and get quick, reliable responses to your health-related questions.
Proactive Document Delivery:
Accelerate your check-in process with proactive document delivery. Sign consent and other ad hoc pre-appointment forms from your mobile device, ensuring a fast, smooth experience.
Seamless Cross-Platform Experience:
IMS Care offers seamless synchronization across the patient portal app and web platform, providing a consistent and user-friendly experience, no matter where or how you access it.
Hassle-Free Access:
Experience the convenience of IMS Care with our simple, one-time password (OTP) login. Securely access your healthcare information by utilizing the convenience of a clinic ID or explore a range of alternative search methods.
Download IMS CARE today and embark on a journey to a healthier, more empowered you! Your wellness is our priority.

bluejetty:00185570:ios.description:
Brush, feed, take care of your horses and decorate each of their stables with divine decorations! Run far and fast across magnificent lands to recover and return to the Everbloom Tree all of its lost magical petals. Assemble the ten legendary Horse Guardians of Everbloom and join them on the most magical adventure to save their forest! Fun Endless racing horse games! 
AN EPIC ENDLESS RUNNER ADVENTURE HORSE GAME
• RUN with 10 Horse Guardians, each with their own mystical personality!
• EXPLORE the world’s breathtaking landscapes, from radiant rainforests to dusty deserts!
• GATHER all lost petals to bring the Everbloom Tree back to life
• USE the Guardians’ super powers to dash past obstacles, blast through them or even take flight!
• COLLECT Embers to awaken the full power of your Horse Guardians
• DRESS UP your Horse Guardians from head to hoof with mythical armor sets!
• GROOM your Horse Guardians with magical brushes and feed them to replenish their energy!
• ENHANCE your runs with epic trails made of furious flames, sweet snowflakes and more!
• DECORATE your stable with divine decorations for glorious rooms worthy of the horse heroes
• RACE through all of nature’s challenges, blizzards or sandstorms, day or night!
• ENDLESS RUNNER MODE: Gallop without limit, gather as many petals as you can and set your own record!
Play this fun endless running horse game for girls, boys and kids of all ages!

bluejetty:00144658:ios.name: Vocal Remover: Music Separator
bluejetty:00144658:ios.summary:
Vocal Remover: Your AI-Powered Music Studio
Unlock new musical possibilities with Vocal Remover — the all-in-one AI music editor that isolates vocals and instruments while displaying real-time lyrics. Designed for musicians, producers, DJs
bluejetty:00144658:ios.description:
Vocal Remover: Your AI-Powered Music Studio
Unlock new musical possibilities with Vocal Remover — the all-in-one AI music editor that isolates vocals and instruments while displaying real-time lyrics. Designed for musicians, producers, DJs, and karaoke lovers, Vocal Remover uses cutting-edge AI to deliver studio-quality music separation and the ultimate karaoke experience.
Main Features
• Advanced AI Separation: Effortlessly split voice, drums, bass, piano, and guitar with precision. Get perfect acapella and instrumental tracks every time.
• High-Quality Music Export: Export your tracks in excellent quality, compatible with MP3, FLAC, WAV, and M4A.
• Lyrics Display (NEW): Enjoy a karaoke-style lyrics view as you play or edit your music. Our AI model automatically detects, interprets, and displays the song’s lyrics — ideal for singing practice, karaoke sessions, and content creation.
• Chords & Song Key Detection (NEW): Automatically detect a song’s chords and musical key — ideal for musicians, singers, producers, and anyone learning or practicing music.
• Dynamic Backing Tracks: Create custom backing tracks for acapella rehearsals or music production, including drums, piano, bass, and more.
• Enhanced Music Clarity: Built-in noise reduction ensures crystal-clear audio output.
• BPM & Pitch Adjustment: Automatically detects BPM and lets you change tempo or pitch with precision — perfect for DJs, remixers, and vocalists.
• Smart Metronome (NEW): Practice with a synchronized metronome and choose between Half Time, Full Time, and Double Time to match the rhythm of your song.
How It Works
Choose any song from your Camera Roll, iTunes, Files app, or a URL.
Let Vocal Remover’s AI separate vocals and instruments into clean stems.
Adjust volume, mute stems, or enable lyrics view for a karaoke-ready experience.
Download your final mix or individual tracks in high quality.
Supported Imports
Import music directly from Google Drive, Dropbox, iCloud, or any public URL.
Fully compatible with MP3, FLAC, WAV, and M4A formats.
Beyond Basic Vocal Removal
• Instrument-specific isolation for vocals, drums, bass, piano, and guitars.
• AI-powered lyrics recognition and karaoke mode for synchronized lyric display.
Who It’s For
• Musicians & Producers: Transform your favorite songs into editable stems and practice vocals with visible lyrics.
• Performers & Singers: Use acapella tracks with live lyrics for rehearsals or performance prep.
• Content Creators: Produce unique remixes and videos using isolated vocals and karaoke-style visuals.
Elevate your music projects with Vocal Remover — your complete AI companion for music editing, karaoke, and vocal isolation.
DISCLAIMER
You must own the rights to any content you upload. You are responsible for ensuring you have permission to use copyrighted material.
AGE RESTRICTION
You must be 18+ or the legal age in your region to use the app.
Privacy Policy: https://vividup.tech/privacy-policy/
Terms & Conditions: https://vividup.tech/terms-conditions/
VOCAL REMOVER PREMIUM
Upgrade to Premium for unlimited song separation, lyrics display, and karaoke features. Choose from weekly or monthly plans. Pricing varies by region. Manage or cancel anytime in your account settings.

bluejetty:00119990:ios.name: Coloring Games: Painting, Glow
bluejetty:00119990:ios.summary:
Kids love fun coloring games, and this Coloring Game is one of the best free coloring book and painting apps for children!
Coloring Games is filled with fun, colorful, and creative drawing and painting tools that help kids of all ages enjo
bluejetty:00119990:ios.description:
Kids love fun coloring games, and this Coloring Game is one of the best free coloring book and painting apps for children!
Coloring Games is filled with fun, colorful, and creative drawing and painting tools that help kids of all ages enjoy creating art on your mobile device. There are multiple modes the whole family can enjoy, including paint by numbers, color by numbers, doodling modes, and free coloring books of all types. Whether your kid is a toddler or a preschooler, they're bound to have fun with this free coloring game!
Coloring Games was built specifically for children. It has an easy to understand interface kids as young as one year old can use. They'll have fun using the drawing, painting, and learning games at their disposal, while parents can watch the looks of joy on their faces as they color in the pages with a wide variety of paints.
There are a ton of coloring mini-games to play in Coloring Games, including:
1. Fun Paint - Tap to fill in the blank coloring book pages with a dozen bright and fun colors!
2. Color Fill - Use a wider variety of colors and options to paint the pictures, including stickers, glitter, crayons, and cute patterns.
3. Drawing - Draw on a blank slate with a full palette of colors ready to go.
4. Glow Pen - Paint with neon colors on a dark background. A fun way to create unique artwork!
5. Number Paint - Color-by-numbers to fill in an amazing picture, one paint shade at a time!
Coloring Games comes with a number of features that help adults monitor their child's progress. You can easily add profiles for each child, customize settings to make color activities easier or harder and more. Best of all, the coloring game is completely FREE to play. There are no ads, no in-app purchases, and no paywalls to fight with, just tons of safe, educational fun for kids.
Preschoolers, toddlers, families, and boys and girls of all ages will love the simple but engaging fun of Coloring Games. It's easy to start coloring with just a few taps on the screen, and maybe your child will create a miniature masterpiece!
Note to parents:
When creating this game, our goal was to craft a unique and fun experience perfectly designed for children. We're parents ourselves, and we know how ads and paywalls can get in the way of families enjoying playtime together.
Coloring Games is completely free. You won't find any in-app purchases or third party advertisements, just a great coloring book app you can play with your children. We don't want our kids consuming hundreds of ads while they learn, and we think other parents agree with that, as well!
Thank you for taking the time to experience fun learning and coloring apps with your children. Spread the word so more parents can share wholesome entertainment with their families, too!
Best wishes from the parents at RV AppStudios

bluejetty:00082934:ios.description:
EczemaLess is an Artificial Intelligence based app to help manage your Eczema. 
Note: 
• This app is meant for patients who have already been diagnosed with Atopic Dermatitis (Eczema).
• This app is to track triggers which might be causing Eczema flares, or treatments which work to keep Eczema down. We do not provide any diagnosis or treatment advice.
• EczemaLess is a classified as Clinical Decision Support (CDS) Software per the 21 Century Cures Act and is intended to only provide a recommendation to licensed health care professionals regarding tracking Eczema. It is NOT intended to be used by Patients for self diagnosis or self treatment. 
Our AI technology instantly analyzes your skin image and gives you a suggested severity rating for your Eczema. If you develop a skin rash due to Eczema flare use our tool to keep track of the pictures and create and track the care plan you use.
App Features
Insights:
• Intuitive graphs into how your Eczema tracks over time.
• Track and log the triggers which you suspect might be triggeting your Eczema.
• Track the various types of treatment and care regimens which you use is managing your Eczema.
Track: 
• Track the pictures of your Eczema severity.
• Measure and monitor your Eczema Quality of Life Index (POEM)
• Measure and track symptoms related to Atopic Dermatitis like Itchy skin, Dryness of skin and Sleep loss.
• Use the app to keep a picture log of your Eczema and get graphs on how your Eczema trends over time as compared to weather and other factors which you define.
Care Plan: 
• Use the combined approach to Eczema care using conventional treatment and habit reversal techniques.
• Learn the effective moisturizing strategy, proper use of topical treatments and how to prevent the itch-scratch cycle. This will enable you to holistically treat Eczema symptoms and keep flares down.
• Keep track of which treatment you use and how often you use them.
• Select from various types of treatment like moisturizers, dermatitis creams, steroids, medicines and bathing routines.
• Get graphs into which treatment you use and how your Eczema trends over time.
Triggers: 
• Log your food triggers. Use the AI-assisted food logging to log the content of the food which might be causing allergies.
• Select from a list of Triggers in various categories including Allergies, Environmental, Foods, Activities, Health Events, Products.
• Create your own custom trigger which you think might be causing a flare up in Eczema and start tracking.
• Load the results from an Allergy test and use the App for tracking an elimination diet on different type of food triggers for Eczema.
• Environmental Triggers like Pollen count, UV Index, Humidity, Air Quality and Temperature are automatically logged when a user Tracks their Eczema severity using "Log Now" option.
Share with Doctor:
• You can generate a report of your Eczema and share with your Dermatologist in your next visit.
• Ask your Doctor on how they can monitor your Eczema using the App.
How are we different from others / What makes us Unique?
While undergoing treatment for Atopic Dermatitis, it is very important for the individual to track his / her activities and treatment actions to ensure that the Care-plan which s/he is following is effective. 
Get graphs and reports on how your Eczema, trends, over a period of time and compare it with various triggers which you log. Compare your current condition with the previous using graphs and check different symptoms in the same period.
Generate Summary report about how your Eczema has been doing, you can decide to share this with your Dermatologist or Physician.

bluejetty:00156999:ios.description:
Your Personal Assistant for Government
Gov2Go is the easiest way to keep up with your government to-do list — property taxes, car tags, voting, and more. It’s a smart app that reminds you what's due and helps you take care of it. Never miss a deadline again!
Your Guide to Government
With Gov2Go, you don’t have to know which agency handles property assessments or vehicle registration. No more navigating government to get things done. All you need to do is share a little about yourself. We’ll handle the rest.
Personalized to You
Gov2Go learns about you and then carefully curates government information and services based on what you share. It knows your government deadlines, tracks them for you and tells you when it’s time to do something.
Secure & Private
Your data is secure. We will never sell it or share it with anyone. Information you provide is used only in the ways you allow. You’re in complete control of what you share and what conveniences you get in return. You can add or remove information at any time.
A Name You Can Trust
Gov2Go is offered by NIC, Inc., the people behind eGovernment. Over 3,500 government agencies (and counting) trust NIC with their payment processing and online services.

bluejetty:00144836:ios.summary:
Mimo AI Clinical Notes — finish your documentation in minutes, not hours.

bluejetty:00144836:ios.description:
Mimo AI Clinical Notes — finish your documentation in minutes, not hours.
Mimo is the AI documentation assistant for clinicians: therapists and counselors, physicians, nurse practitioners, wound care specialists, and the teams who support them. Record a visit, type, fill in a form, or import a paper note — Mimo turns it into a structured, complete clinical note that you review before it's saved, exported, or shared.
WORKS WITH YOUR EHR
The Mimo Extension inserts your finished notes into any web-based EHR or practice platform — no API integration project required. Write in Mimo on your phone or iPad, then send it to the chart from your browser.
WHY CLINICIANS CHOOSE MIMO
AI Scribe — Record or upload audio from a session or visit and get a finished SOAP, DAP, BIRP, or progress note in minutes.
You stay in control — Start with Audio, Text, or Form. Mimo drafts with AI only when you ask, and every draft is yours to review and edit.
Templates for any specialty — Built-in SOAP, DAP, and BIRP, plus custom templates for behavioral health, primary care, wound care, and more.
NEW — AI Template Builder: Generate a custom template for any specialty or practice. Describe the note you need, preview it in plain language, and refine it over time.
NEW — Import paper notes: Upload a scanned or photographed note and add its text straight into your note.
Clinical photos and attachments — Add images, audio, and PDFs to a note, such as wound photos or outside records, and tailor forms to your practice.
AI Compliance Checker — Check any note against Medicare, payer, and state-specific requirements and get a compliance matrix with an executive summary and risk levels.
Streamlined coding — Add CPT, ICD-10, and diagnosis codes with AI suggestions.
AI Clinical Assistant — Generate, summarize, enhance, and translate notes. Thousands of prewritten clinical sentences help you chart faster.
Wiley Resources — Wiley Treatment Plans, Progress Notes, and Homework side by side with your note, laid out for iPad.
Handwriting and dictation — Type, dictate, or write with a stylus.
Export and share — One-tap PDF export, print, or email.
BUILT FOR PRIVACY AND SECURITY
HIPAA-compliant. Sign in with Apple or Google, add two-step verification with an authenticator app, and unlock with Face ID or Touch ID. Drafts save as you work, so a dropped connection won't cost you a note.
WORK ANYWHERE
Sync across iPhone, iPad, and the web, with layouts that adapt to your screen.
THE RESULT
Cut your documentation time by up to 70% — and spend your evenings with people, not paperwork.
Questions or need help? Email Support@mimonote.com.
Download Mimo and get your hours back — one note at a time.

bluejetty:00123205:ios.name: Star Health
bluejetty:00123205:ios.developer: Star Health And Allied Insurance Company Limited
bluejetty:00123205:ios.summary: Star Health and Allied Insurance Co. Ltd is a publicly listed health insurance company based in India. The “Star Health” mobile app offers customers instant access to their policy details and related information, along with Health & Wellnes
bluejetty:00123205:ios.description:
Star Health and Allied Insurance Co. Ltd is a publicly listed health insurance company based in India. The “Star Health” mobile app offers customers instant access to their policy details and related information, along with Health & Wellness features from anywhere, at any time. The app also provides extensive information on a wide range of health, travel and accident insurance products tailored to suit its customers’ needs, with the added convenience of online purchase and renewal.
How do we cater to the needs of our customers?
The Star Health App offers effortless policy management and various health & wellness features such as Face Scan, Telemedicine, Health Risk Assessment (HRA), Step & Water tracker and more. Explore these features to enjoy seamless services and benefits.
Features & Benefits
Policy details and documents
Access policy details and documents like policy copy, Health ID Card, 80D certificate and more with a single tap. The app also facilitates easy claims intimation and status tracking.
Face Scan
Conduct a prompt health assessment easily using your smartphone. The face scan functionality lets you assess your stress levels, blood pressure, and respiration rate in minutes.
Telemedicine
This feature enables you to seamlessly connect with a wide range of expert doctors via video call or chat. It also allows you to schedule appointments at your convenience.
Steps & Water trackers
The step tracker monitors your daily step count to help you meet your fitness goals, while the water tracker enables you to track your daily water consumption and set hydration goals.
Health Risk Assessment (HRA)
Evaluate your health risks and receive personalised health insights on areas such as BMI, sleep patterns, and mental well-being. Just answer a few simple questions about your health and lifestyle to get a detailed assessment report.
Network Hospital Search
Locate your nearest network and non-network hospitals and labs through the app, ensuring quick and convenient access to the best available healthcare facilities.
Health Insurance Policy Buying
The app provides a seamless platform to explore a wide range of Star Health insurance plans, along with details of the required documents, empowering you to make well-informed decisions with ease to secure the health and well-being of you and your family.
Health Insurance Policy Renewal
Renew your policy effortlessly through the app’s seamless online renewal feature, designed to keep your coverage uninterrupted and hassle-free.

bluejetty:00187958:ios.description:
Descubra o poder da Renda Variável com o BTG Pactual Trader, o aplicativo que redefine a negociação neste mercado. 
Com uma interface intuitiva e recursos avançados, nosso app é a escolha certa para quem busca se manter informado e pronto para atingir os melhores resultados. 
Funcionalidades avançadas para traders: 
Modo Day Trade exclusivo: 
- Alavanque seus resultados com o ambiente Day Trade, nele você poderá operar ativos com mais de 100x de alavancagem 
- Análises de desempenho em tempo real e relatórios detalhados permitem um controle preciso sobre suas operações diárias. 
- A gestão de risco se torna simples com ferramentas integradas para definir limites e proteger seus investimentos. 
Análises e relatórios aprofundados: 
 - Com uma biblioteca rica em análises fundamentalistas e técnicas, o BTG Pactual Trader é um verdadeiro centro de inteligência de mercado. 
 - Relatórios detalhados e insights financeiros apoiam suas estratégias de investimento e negociação. 
Notícias e atualizações de mercado: 
 - Mantenha-se informado com um fluxo constante de notícias e atualizações mais relevantes do mercado. 
 - As notícias personalizadas garantem que você esteja sempre um passo à frente nas suas decisões de investimento. 
 - Acompanhe, ainda, todos os eventos corporativos relevantes para sua carteira. 
Cotações e análise gráfica avançada: 
 - Acompanhe as cotações em tempo real com uma variedade de opções de visualização, incluindo gráficos interativos e indicadores técnicos. 
 - Utilize ferramentas de análise gráfica para identificar tendências e padrões de mercado. 
Execução de ordens com confiança: 
 - Envie ordens de compra e venda rapidamente, com opções avançadas como ordens de stop loss e ordens no gráfico de ativos. 
 - A gestão de risco se torna simples com ferramentas integradas para definir limites e proteger seus investimentos. 
Monitoramento completo de operações: 
 - Verifique o status das suas ordens em tempo real e ajuste suas estratégias conforme o mercado se movimenta. 
 - O detalhamento de posições oferece uma visão clara do impacto das suas operações no seu portfólio. 
Sistemas de análise de fluxo: 
 - Acesse informações completas sobre o fluxo de negociação dos ativos, permitindo uma análise de mercado mais precisa. 
 - Tome decisões informadas com dados atualizados sobre os movimentos de compradores e vendedores. 
Maximize seus resultados com o BTG Pactual Trader!
Com o BTG Pactual Trader, todos os perfis de investidores em renda variável encontram uma plataforma completa. 
O aplicativo oferece um conjunto robusto de ferramentas que atendem desde traders que valorizam a análise técnica e a execução rápida de ordens até investidores que buscam construir uma carteira de dividendos.
Baixe agora e eleve suas operações de investimento ao próximo nível.

bluejetty:00037161:ios.description:
Embark on a Dream Puzzle Adventure!
Join the adventurous Captain Jack, the wise archaeologist Clever, and the cheerful fisherman Max on a magical journey to the Dream Island!
Simple Yet Addictive MERGE Puzzles
• Tap and MERGE items found during the trio’s adventure!
• Complete iconic landmarks on the Dream Island to progress through Jack’s epic journey!
Challenging and Strategic BLAST Puzzles
• Match and BLAST colorful puzzle pieces—it’s simple to start, but challenging to master!
• Create explosive power-ups by matching 5+ pieces and unleash massive combos.
• Strategically plan your moves to overcome unique obstacles in each puzzle.
• Use boosters to conquer tricky BLAST levels and achieve victory!
The Thrilling Tale of Captain Jack’s Trio
• Meet mischievous Jack, thoughtful Clever, and optimistic Max as they embark on an unforgettable quest.
• Discover how Jack and Max became allies and why Clever joined their MERGE and BLAST adventure!
• Follow their dream-filled journey to the enchanting Dream Island and experience their exciting stories firsthand!
Capture Memories on the Dream Island
• Collect puzzle pieces during your MERGE adventure to complete your album.
• Relive memories of Jack’s journey across the magical Dream Island!
Compete for Glory
• Join exciting competitions like Pony Race, League Cup, and the All-Star Arena!
• Compete against players worldwide to prove yourself as the ultimate MERGE and BLAST champion!
Rich Rewards Await
• Claim daily rewards and enjoy generous prizes in puzzles and competitions.
• Low on hearts or energy? Earn more through events and special game modes!
Game Features
• Available on iPhones, iPads, and more!
• Regular updates with fresh MERGE, BLAST, and puzzle content.
• Play offline anytime; internet is only required for competitive modes, purchases, and cloud saving.
• Free to play with optional in-app purchases for additional items to help gameplay.
• Ads are included, but they’re entirely optional—you can choose to watch ads for extra rewards.
• Suitable for players of all ages but recommended for ages 13 and up.

For over 15 years, MILLIONS have trusted Glucose Buddy to track blood sugar and manage diabetes. We’ve earned our place as the #1 diabetes app.
EVERYTHING YOU NEED IN ONE PLACE
- Track blood sugar (glucose levels) throughout your day
- Log meals and carb intake with a food database
- Record medication, insulin, and daily health metrics
- Monitor weight, activity, and long-term A1C trends
No complicated setup. Just consistent, reliable tracking.
BUILT FOR REAL LIFE
- Understand what causes blood sugar spikes and drops
- See trends across glucose, carbs, insulin, and activity
- Log everything quickly in one place
- Add notes to connect habits to results
WHAT THEY’RE SAYING
“I’ve used this for years… it helps me keep a check on my numbers and share them with my doctor.” — CineTigre
“I’ve used the subscription version for years… to track weight, blood sugar and blood pressure.” — Debt king
Ranked #1 Diabetes iPhone Application by Manny Hernandez, Founder of TuDiabetes.com
As seen on American Diabetes Association's Forecast Magazine, NYTimes, Wired Magazine, DiabetesMine.com, MedGadget.com, Mendosa.com, Diabetes Health Magazine, JDRF Newsletters and MobiHealthNews.
MAKE REPORTING EFFORTLESS
- Export reports as PDF or CSV
- Share glucose logs and A1C trends with your doctor
- View daily, weekly, and monthly summaries
SIMPLE & DEPENDABLE
Glucose Buddy focuses on what matters most:
- Reliable blood sugar tracking
- Clear, easy-to-use logging
- Consistent performance you can trust
HIGHLIGHTS
- Log blood glucose, meals, and medication in one entry
- Track glucose, insulin, weight, and A1C trends
- Meal IQ insights for better food choices
- Food database for carb tracking
- Notes and tags for personalization
- Activity tracking + Apple Health integration
- Dexcom integration
- Supports mg/dL and mmol/L
IMPROVE YOUR BLOOD SUGAR CONTROL
- Follow a 12-week plan to better manage your diabetes
- See what impacts your blood sugar and why
- Take control of your A1C with actionable insights
UNLOCK DEEPER INSIGHTS WITH PREMIUM
- Know your long-term progress with an automatic A1C calculator
- See clearer patterns with advanced graphs
- Customize reports for you and your doctor
- Filter entries and use custom tags for more personalized insights
- Log more efficiently with enhanced features
- Enjoy a clean, ad-free experience
Plus, get complimentary access to other Azumio apps like Fitness Buddy and Calorie Mama – trusted by over 100 million people worldwide.
Subscription
- Monthly or yearly plans
- Auto-renew unless turned off 24 hours before renewal
- Manage in Account Settings
Privacy Policy: https://www.azumio.com/page/privacypolicy
DISCLAIMER
For informational purposes only. Not a medical device or substitute for professional advice.
NOTES
GPS use may impact battery life. Agamatrix Jazz Wireless 2 integration available in the US only.

bluejetty:00090705:ios.description:
Master Every Drop with SoleInsider
SoleInsider is your all-in-one sneaker release tracker for upcoming drops, live countdowns, release calendars, sneaker news, resale insights, and community opinions.
Whether you’re hunting a grail, tracking the latest Jordan release, or trying to stay ahead of every major drop, SoleInsider gives you the information and tools to make better decisions before release day.
RELEASES & COUNTDOWNS
• Live Countdown Timers — see exactly how long until your most-wanted sneakers release, down to the second
• Release Calendar — browse upcoming sneaker and streetwear drops by date
• Sneaker Database & Search — find upcoming and past releases from Nike, Jordan, adidas, Yeezy, New Balance, Supreme, Palace, and more
• Release Details — view retail prices, release information, product images, brands, and purchase options
• On This Day — discover sneakers and memorable releases from sneaker history
• Past Releases — look back at previous drops and explore the history behind the sneakers you missed
COMMUNITY
COP or DROP — vote on every release and see what other sneakerheads think before you decide
Comments — join the conversation and share your opinion on the latest drops
Top Sneakers — discover what’s trending, ranked by real COP votes from the community
Favorites & Watchlist — save the releases you care about and keep your must-have sneakers organized
Account Sync — sign in to sync your saved releases across devices
NEWS & CONTENT
Sneaker News — stay up to date with the latest headlines from across the sneaker world
Editorial — read original stories about sneaker culture, design, collaborations, and the people behind the drops
Brand Pages — browse releases from your favorite brands in one place 
Release History — explore important sneakers and the stories that shaped sneaker culture
PRICING & MARKET DATA
Market Terminal — browse live resale pricing information for supported releases
Lowest Ask Data — compare current market asking prices
Premium Tracking — see how resale prices compare with retail
Price Sorting — find the lowest-ask, highest-ask, most recent, or highest-premium sneakers
SPORTS
Live scores for the sports and culture connected to sneaker releases, including:
• NBA 
• NFL 
• MLB 
• NHL 
• WNBA 
• NCAA Basketball 
• NCAA Football 
• MLS 
• Premier League 
• UEFA Champions League 
BUY YOUR NEXT PAIR
• Buy Now Links — jump directly to StockX, GOAT, eBay, and other partner sites when you’re ready to shop
• Compare Your Options — use release details, retail pricing, and market data to make a more informed decision
GO AD-FREE
Watch a short video to temporarily remove banners and interstitial ads for three days, free.
Whether you’re tracking one grail or following every major release this month, SoleInsider gives you the data, community, and tools to stay ahead of release day.
Download SoleInsider and never miss your next drop.

bluejetty:00187304:ios.description:
What is Raiffeisen Mobile Banking (RMB)?
Raiffeisen Mobile Banking is an application designed to facilitate users' transactions with the Bank. Through the application, you can access your accounts, manage them, make payments, and perform other services. In addition to basic services, you can manage your cards, communicate with the Bank, view current offers, manage your Raiffeisen Invest portfolio, and much more.
Main Features of Raiffeisen Mobile Banking (RMB):
• Overview of accounts with a detailed display of transactions
• Review transaction details, expenses, and spending habits
• Confirmation of completed transactions
• Overview of credit card installments
• Transactions between own accounts and accounts of individuals and legal entities in Raiffeisen Bank
• Transactions to accounts of individuals and legal entities in other banks in BiH
• Transactions to accounts abroad
• Quick payment "Pay to contact"
• Public revenue payments
• Review and cancellation of orders
• Ability to save and view samples for payment
• Checking balances and payments into Raiffeisen Invest funds
• Activation and deactivation of standing orders
• One-click card blocking and unblocking
• Use biometric authentication for secure access
• Hide account details on your dashboard for discretion
• Online application for Bank products
• Communication with the Bank via RAIA Virtual Assistant
• Locate ATMs and branches with geographical positioning
• Currency converter
• Savings or loan calculator
• Exchange rate list
Benefits of RMB - Raiffeisen Mobile Banking:
• Guaranteed confidentiality with state-of-the-art security technology, including PIN and biometric login
• 24/7 account access, independent of branch hours
• Save money with favorable payment fees
• Save time by avoiding queues
Is it safe to use RMB - Raiffeisen Mobile Banking?
Raiffeisen Mobile Banking uses the latest protection and security technologies. Access to the Raiffeisen Mobile Banking application is secured by biometrics or a unique PIN that you generate during the first login, ensuring the protection and privacy of financial transactions. Additional security is provided by a software token that is automatically installed on the mobile device along with the application. To protect your accounts, the application automatically logs out after a short period of inactivity.

bluejetty:00021329:ios.description:
Ark IDs is the most popular Ark admin commands and spawn codes website, and now we’re available on the app store! Find out about our features below.
Admin Commands
—
Find documentation for every Ark console command in an instant with our up-to-date admin commands database. Each command is complete with working examples and generators. The command generators allow you to adjust all of the parameters in app, outputting a working command for you to enter in-game.
Scroll through them all individually, search by name, or use our filters to find commands from specific categories.
Item IDs
—
Use our item ID and GFI code list to search through over 1,000 Ark items and find the information you need to spawn them in-game. Use the settings to see an item’s spawn command, GFI code, item ID, or blueprint. Adjust the filters to view items from specific DLCs and categories.
Creature IDs
—
Our creature and dino ID list contains all creatures from Ark and DLCs. Simply search for a creature and get the command to spawn it in-game. Use the filters to view creatures from specific DLCs and categories.
Additionally, this list provides you with the option to use either the Summon, SpawnDino or SDF command, and allows you to customize the parameters (spawn distance, creature level and whether or not the creature can be tamed), so you don’t need to faff about in-game.
Color IDs
—
The Ark IDs app comes with a full list of all Ark color IDs allowing you to color your dinos.
Use the list to get a color’s ID, or tap a color to place it into the setTargetDinoColor command generator, which will output a working command for you to use on dinos in-game.

With People Sandbox Workshop you can unleash your imagination and embark on a captivating journey in this exhilarating physics-based game! Experience the thrill of complete control as you navigate through a virtual world where creativity knows no bounds. Customize your ragdoll characters and witness the awe-inspiring realism of physics simulations, as they move, twist, and tumble with uncanny lifelike quality.
Delve into dynamic environments teeming with thrilling challenges and enticing opportunities. Craft amusing scenarios and chaotic situations using an array of props, obstacles, and interactive objects. From pushing and pulling to throwing and catapulting, every action elicits uproarious reactions and sends limbs flailing in hilariously comical ways.
Immerse yourself in realistic physics simulations that flawlessly replicate ragdoll movements and reactions. Explore diverse environments, each offering a unique playground for your creativity. Experiment with an assortment of interactive objects and obstacles, pushing the boundaries of their movements and interactions.
Unleash the full extent of your imagination through immersive and creative play. Share your hilarious and entertaining creations with friends and family, spreading the joy far and wide. People Sandbox Workshop is the ultimate game to unlock your inner child, providing countless hours of laughter, relaxation, and entertainment in a stress-free virtual playground.

bluejetty:00114311:ios.summary: Embark on an exciting journey through the world of Mahjong with Mahjong Sprint - Tile Match! Experience a fresh and fast-paced take on the traditional tile-matching puzzle game. Whether you're a Mahjong enthusiast or new to the game, Mahjon
bluejetty:00114311:ios.description:
Embark on an exciting journey through the world of Mahjong with Mahjong Sprint - Tile Match! Experience a fresh and fast-paced take on the traditional tile-matching puzzle game. Whether you're a Mahjong enthusiast or new to the game, Mahjong Sprint offers a fun and challenging experience that will keep you coming back for more.
Game Features:
Classic Mahjong with a Twist: Mahjong Sprint combines the timeless appeal of Mahjong with a fast-paced, competitive edge. The goal is simple: match tiles and clear the board before time runs out. But with each level, the puzzles become more intricate, and the clock keeps ticking—keeping you on your toes!
Endless Levels of Fun: With thousands of levels to explore, you'll never run out of new challenges. Each level offers a unique puzzle design, with a variety of difficulty settings. Whether you're looking for a casual game to unwind or a brain-teasing challenge, Mahjong Sprint has something for everyone.
Engaging Power-ups and Boosters: Unlock exciting power-ups and boosters to help you clear the board faster. Use hints, shuffle tiles, and activate special abilities that will give you the edge you need to complete even the most difficult puzzles.
Beautiful Visuals and Themes: Immerse yourself in stunning visuals with a variety of beautifully designed tile sets and backgrounds. From serene landscapes to vibrant, colorful themes, each level offers a visually pleasing experience.
Relaxing and Addictive Gameplay: The smooth and satisfying gameplay will keep you hooked for hours. With easy-to-learn mechanics and gradually increasing difficulty, Mahjong Sprint offers the perfect balance of relaxation and excitement.
How to Play:
Match Tiles: Find and match two identical tiles to clear them from the board. Be strategic and plan your moves to make the best use of time.
Clear the Board: The objective is to clear the entire board by matching tiles, but be quick! You need to complete the puzzle before the timer runs out.
Use Power-ups: Don’t forget to use your power-ups to speed up your progress. Use shuffle tiles, hints, or clear multiple tiles at once to gain an advantage.
Progress Through Levels: As you complete each level, you’ll move on to even more difficult challenges. With new designs, tile sets, and obstacles, every level brings a new adventure!
Why You'll Love Mahjong Sprint - Tile Match:
Challenging but Relaxing: The fast-paced nature of Mahjong Sprint will keep you engaged, while the relaxing tile-matching gameplay lets you unwind and clear your mind.
Unique Puzzle Designs: Every level brings a fresh challenge with new layouts and configurations, making each puzzle feel new and exciting.
Free to Play: Mahjong Sprint - Tile Match is free to play, with in-app purchases available for those who want to unlock extra content faster. Enjoy the game at your own pace, without any pressure to spend.
Join the Fun:
Ready to become a Mahjong master? Download Mahjong Sprint - Tile Match today and start your journey! Whether you're looking to relax, challenge yourself, or compete against friends, this game has everything you need. Let the tile-matching adventure begin!
Start playing Mahjong Sprint - Tile Match now and enjoy endless hours of puzzle-solving fun!

bluejetty:00155993:ios.description:
Now your CharterWest accounts and cards are at your fingertips with CharterGo Mobile Banking. It’s secure, simple and convenient. Plus, it’s free!
With Mobile Banking you can:
• View account balances
• View your most recent transaction
• View your account statements
• Transfer funds between accounts
• Transfer funds to make a loan payment
• Transfer funds to/from your accounts at other financial institutions
• Find a CharterWest ATM or bank location
• Receive account alerts via email or text message (message or data rates may apply)
• Pay your bills, pay and manage contacts, bill capture (via CheckFree Bill Pay)
• Make mobile deposits
• Manage your CharterWest Visa Debit Cards, including:
- Control when and where your cards can be used based on location, merchant type and spend amounts.
- Get more information about your card transactions, such as logos, maps, street photos and contact information.

- Track all the places that store your card information for online or recurring payments.
In order to enable certain features, the application needs access to the following on your mobile device:
Location Services – To locate the nearest ATM/Branch location relevant to your current location.
Camera – To allow for the use of Mobile Deposit
Contacts – To easily select contacts that you may want to pay via Bill Pay (requires enrollment in Bill Pay)
This application will not access any of your call logs.

bluejetty:00179153:ios.description:
The Air NZ app – your trusted travel companion – lets you:
• Take control of your flight bookings – change your seat, add a bag, manage your meals, and more.
• Check in online, from anywhere, and access your digital boarding pass in the app, or add it to Apple Wallet.
• Scan your digital boarding pass to print bag tags at the kiosk, board your aircraft, and if you're eligible, enter the Air New Zealand lounge.
• Hold up to 9 boarding passes for your group or family under the same booking. Bookings with infants can't currently be supported.
• Have real-time flight info at your fingertips with up-to-date gate and seat info, boarding and departure times, and more.
• Receive notifications with key flight information – you'll never miss a beat.
• Order coffee from your phone, and we'll let you know when it's ready to collect. Air New Zealand lounge access required.
• Purchase travel-related services such as travel insurance, parking, airport taxis and shuttles, hotels, and rental cars.
• Track your Airpoints Dollars™ and Status Points balances, view your benefits and latest activity, or access your digital Airpoints™ card straight from your phone, plus find Airpoints Partners to help you earn Airpoints Dollars every day.
• Access and use your digital Koru card when you have a Koru membership.
• Access quick links to book or change flights on the fly.
• Stay organised – add flight details to your calendar, and share them with others.
Things not as effortless as they could be? We'd love to hear from you. Use the 'Help and Feedback' menu in the Air NZ app to see your options.
By downloading, installing and using the Air NZ app, you agree that you have read, understood and agree to our Website and App Terms of Use at airnewzealand.co.nz/website-terms-of-use and our Privacy Policy at airnewzealand.co.nz/privacy.

Experience Propane Management Like Never Before with the MyPropane App – the ultimate tool for taking control of your propane usage!
- Sleek & Intuitive User Interface: Navigate with ease through our clean, user-friendly design. Whether you’re tech-savvy or a first-time user, the app is built for simplicity and efficiency.

- Instant Notifications: Receive timely push notifications and email alerts when your propane levels dip below 30% or 20%, so you're never caught off guard.
- Interactive Map View: Get a bird's-eye view of all your connected propane tanks with our easy-to-use map feature, making it simple to manage multiple tanks in different locations.
- Connect Multiple Tank Monitors: Whether at home or for your business, MyPropane allows you to monitor multiple propane tanks simultaneously, offering seamless control all in one place.
- Direct QR Code Connection: Effortlessly sync your tank monitor with a quick scan of a QR code, giving you instant access to your tank’s real-time data.
- Step-by-Step Installation Tutorial: Setting up your MyPropane Tank Monitor is easier than ever with our in-app tutorial, guiding you through the installation process in just a few steps.
Take the guesswork out of propane management—download the MyPropane App today for smarter monitoring, timely alerts, and complete peace of mind! Pair it with the LOGI Propane Tank Monitor for an unmatched propane experience. Make every drop count!

bluejetty:00068755:ios.description:
Meet the United app
From planning, to booking, to day of travel, we’ve got you covered.   
On our app you can:  
• look for flights across our global network and book them easily 
• check in for your flight and get your boarding pass before you get to the airport 
• change seats, or flights, if something better becomes available 
• make sure you’re prepared for your trip with our Travel-Ready Center 
• add your bags, drop them at bag drop shortcut and track them along your journey 
• get real-time updates on boarding progression so you know when it's your turn to board 
• view flight updates, transfer time and gate info all in one place to feel prepared for your connection 
• see live updates on your lock screen and Apple Watch 
• use our built-in Terminal guide and airport maps to find your gate and navigate the airport with ease 
• watch movies, play games and pay for inflight snacks and drinks while you’re in the air 
• enroll in MileagePlus or manage your MileagePlus account and use your miles to book award travel in our app 
• use high-speed inflight Wi-Fi enabled by Starlink which is now available on select flights, free for MileagePlus members 
• talk, text or video chat with an agent if you have any questions 
• figure out your next move if your flight is delayed or canceled

Manage your Tbaytel services safely and securely right from your phone with the new myTbaytel app! 
With this app, it’s never been easier to view and manage your Tbaytel account information, from anywhere in the world.
myTbaytel allows you to:
• View, download and pay all your Tbaytel bills
• Set bill and payment reminders directly from the app
• View your Tbaytel mobility data usage
• View your Tbaytel mobility roaming usage
• View your Tbaytel service package and features
• Locate the nearest Authorized Tbaytel dealer
Please note, business accounts are not able to register using the myTbaytel app at this time.
The myTbaytel app supports iOS 10.0 and above. If you are using an older version of iOS, please visit Tbaytel.net/myTbaytel from your mobile browser to manage your account information.
myTbaytel requests the following permissions from your device:
• Calendar – to set billing reminders 
• Phone – To launch the phone application to dial numbers listed in the app
• Storage – To save pdf copies of your Tbaytel bills
• Location – To use your location to locate the nearest dealer, and deliver geotargeted push notifications or advertising banners.
Like using myTbaytel? Please take a moment to rate us and tell us what you think.

bluejetty:00045608:ios.name: Dreamy Garden
bluejetty:00045608:ios.summary: Welcome to Dreamy Garden, a captivating blend of township puzzles and enchanting flower gardens, all in stunning 3D animation. Immerse yourself in a gorgeous garden emulator for endless fun and delightful mystery. This game is not just an e
bluejetty:00045608:ios.description:
Welcome to Dreamy Garden, a captivating blend of township puzzles and enchanting flower gardens, all in stunning 3D animation. Immerse yourself in a gorgeous garden emulator for endless fun and delightful mystery. This game is not just an escape—it's a family adventure you won't want to miss!
Features:
Township Match: Combine the art of dreamy triple match with the thrill of township puzzles solving, creating a unique gameplay experience.
Enjoy the stunning scenery: Start on a journey through beautifully designed garden capes, the scenery of the hill, and the valley, each more mesmerizing than the last.
3D Animation: Dive into a world brought to life with vivid 3D animations, adding an extra layer of immersion to your gaming experience.
Farm and Family: Build and cultivate your very own virtual farm, creating cherished memories for your in-game family.
Mystery Adventures: Unravel mysteries hidden within the game, adding an element of intrigue to your Dreamy Garden escapades.
Mahjong Flower Triple Tiles Match: Engage your mind with intricate mahjong match challenges, combining strategy and relaxation for an immersive experience.
Flower Tile Puzzles: Solve delightful dreamy flower-themed tile puzzles, each one more intricate and beautiful than the last.
Multi-Level Escapes: Progress through levels, unlocking new and more captivating gardens capes, each a unique work of art.
Daily Challenges: Test your skills with new puzzles and quests every day, ensuring every session is fresh and engaging.
When you encounter a tricky dreamy flower tiles puzzles, make use of boosters to breeze through and continue your floral adventure through the garden.
Social Interaction: Connect with fellow garden enthusiasts, tips, and share your own beautifully designed flower gardens capes.
Discover a wide variety of distinct dreamy flower tiles from around the world, each waiting for you to triple-match dreamy flower tiles and bloom in the garden.
How to Play Dreamy Garden:
Match Tiles: Begin by triple-match dreamy tiles puzzles to create cascades of same flower color and progress through the game.
Solve Puzzles: Township puzzles will challenge your wit and creativity, offering a blend of strategy and fun.
Craft Your Escape: Design and construct your garden paradise, customizing every aspect to suit your unique style.
Build Your Farm: Tend to your farm, grow crops, and raise livestock, transforming it into a flourishing hub of activity.
Hone your match flower tiles puzzles skills with quick and strategic choices to earn rewarding bonus points in this special game!Let the Dreamy Garden take you on an unforgettable journey through a world where magic meets reality.
